title: Google Tag Manager (third-party script) and the cookie banner load on karaoke pages that show customer PII
evidence: RootLayout renders ConsentScripts, <TagManager gtmId='GTM-KZ2QCHTT' default> and <CookieBanner/> for every document except the checkout (useOutsideCheckoutDocument only excludes isCheckoutPath). next.config.ts CSP for all paths but /odeme allows script-src https://www.googletagmanager.com, so /admin gets it. The booking page shows names, e-mails, phones and (refund roles) IP and browser string. .cookie-banner is position:fixed z-index 200, above admin toasts (z-50).
impact: Whatever the GTM container is set to run executes in the admin origin next to customer PII and the admin session; until consent the banner covers the bottom of admin pages and their toasts.
verdict_note: Confirmed, and I raise the severity. src/app/layout.tsx:16,187,203,206 renders ConsentScripts, TagManager (GTM-KZ2QCHTT by default) and CookieBanner for every document. site-tags.tsx:32-36 excludes only isCheckoutPath (checkout-document.ts:25-27, '/odeme' only). next.config.ts:43,49: CSP_SOURCE covers /admin and script-src allows https://www.googletagmanager.com. The admin is a child of this root layout. Admin URLs carry customer e-mails (/admin/musteriler/[email], linked from karaoke/[id]/page.tsx:107), and those go into GTM/GA page_location. Anyone who can publish the GTM container can run JS in the admin origin and drive the panel as the signed-in admin (refunds, settings). .cookie-banner (globals.css:9406-9408, fixed, z-index 200) sits above the admin toasts (z-50). This is PII plus an admin-takeover path, so high. No public page links to /admin, so a document-scoped exclusion is enough.
fix: src/components/laffogato/site-tags.tsx: make useOutsideCheckoutDocument also return false for paths starting with '/admin' (rename it, for example useTagsAllowed). Then ConsentScripts, TagManager and CookieBanner skip the admin. Optionally send /admin a narrower second CSP from src/proxy.ts (script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline', connect-src 'self'); with two policies both are enforced. Do not change the /odeme nonce CSP or CSP_SOURCE's /odeme exclusions. Keep tests/security-headers.test.ts and vercel.json parity. Owner: SHELL.
fix_original: Skip TagManager, ConsentScripts and CookieBanner for paths under /admin (site-tags.tsx) and send /admin a CSP without third-party script hosts. Owner of the fix: SHELL.
root_cause_fix: site-tags.tsx: a separate predicate skips ConsentScripts, GTM and CookieBanner on /admin documents; isCheckoutPath unchanged.

title: Google Tag Manager, consent scripts and the cookie banner run inside the authenticated admin panel
evidence: Root layout renders ConsentScripts (layout.tsx:187), TagManager (203; GTM_ID = NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID || 'GTM-KZ2QCHTT' at line 16, so an empty env var cannot disable it despite the comment) and CookieBanner (206) around every /admin page. useOutsideCheckoutDocument only skips pathname === '/odeme' (lib/security/checkout-document.ts:25-27). Site CSP covers /admin (CSP_SOURCE excludes only /odeme and /odeme/paynkolay) and allows script-src 'unsafe-inline' https://www.googletagmanager.com and connect-src google-analytics. Admin URLs/titles carry customer PII: /admin/musteriler/[email] with title 'Admin · Müşteri <email>' (musteriler/[email]/page.tsx:88-91), FilterBar ?q= search terms. `.cookie-banner { position: fixed; z-index: 200; bottom: 18px }` (globals.css:9406-9412) is shown until a choice exists (cookie-consent.tsx:121) and sits above admin toasts (toast.tsx:138 z-50) and the bulk bar (bulk.tsx:198 z-30).
impact: Anyone able to publish the GTM container can run arbitrary JS (Custom HTML tags pass the CSP) inside an owner's session on pages full of names, addresses and phones, and can call admin server actions; GA4/Meta tags (layout.tsx:13-14 says they are managed in GTM) receive admin URLs and titles containing customer e-mails. Which tags actually fire is GTM configuration, not code (unproven). On a new device the cookie banner covers the bulk action bar and toasts.
verdict_note: site-tags.tsx:32-36 `useOutsideCheckoutDocument` only checks isCheckoutPath (checkout-document.ts:25-27, `=== '/odeme'`). The root layout (layout.tsx:186,203,206) therefore renders ConsentScripts, GTM and CookieBanner on every /admin document. layout.tsx:16 `NEXT_PUBLIC_GTM_ID || 'GTM-KZ2QCHTT'`: an empty env var cannot disable GTM, contrary to the comment at :15. CSP_SOURCE (next.config.ts:43) covers /admin and allows 'unsafe-inline' plus googletagmanager.com. Customer e-mails show up in admin titles and URLs: musteriler/[email]/page.tsx:90 has title `Admin · Müşteri ${email}`, and proxy.ts:104 keeps the original `?q=` on the login URL. The .cookie-banner is z-index 200 (globals.css:9406-9408) and sits above the bulk bar (z-30) and toasts (z-50). Which GTM tags fire depends on the container config, which is not provable from code.
fix: src/components/laffogato/site-tags.tsx: also return false when the document was loaded at '/admin' or under '/admin/' (a separate predicate). Do NOT change isCheckoutPath: proxy.ts:72 uses it for the nonce CSP and the checkout guard uses it too. Add /admin cases to tests/checkout-document.test.ts. Optionally skip RevealMotion for admin. An admin-only CSP is a second step: tests/security-headers.test.ts:46 asserts exactly one CSP rule and :60 asserts /admin/kasa is under CSP_SOURCE, so a new next.config rule must update that test deliberately. Two enforced CSPs intersect, so adding a narrower /admin/:path* policy without GTM works without touching CSP_SOURCE. /odeme nonce CSP untouched.
fix_original: In site-tags.tsx make useOutsideCheckoutDocument return false for pathname.startsWith('/admin') too (no ConsentScripts/TagManager/CookieBanner; also skip RevealMotion in layout.tsx), and give /admin its own CSP without googletagmanager (exclude it from CSP_SOURCE in next.config.ts, add an admin policy) with a test like tests/security-headers.test.ts.
root_cause_fix: site-tags.tsx: a separate predicate skips ConsentScripts, GTM and CookieBanner on /admin documents; isCheckoutPath unchanged.

title: A refusal that changes the booking vanishes with its dialog: no message, no toast (incl. refund sent / POS did not answer); the dialog can later reopen by itself
evidence: Every karaoke action calls revalidate(id) also on refusal (actions.ts 147, 202, 215, 247, 283), so the page re-renders under the open dialog. The dialog is a portal owned by its trigger (action-modal.tsx 229-234) and the trigger exists only while karaokeActionPlan offers it. On refund_unknown cancelKaraokeReservation leaves the row paymentStatus 'refunding' (karaoke-payment.ts 1485-1492, 1573-1578) and the plan has no cancel for a refunding row (lib/admin/karaoke-panel.ts 417-421), so ConfirmButton key 'cancel' unmounts with its dialog. Confirm refused with wrong_status/raced/payment_open removes plan.confirm; slot_taken turns it into {disabledReason} and ActionModal returns its disabled branch (167-195) instead of the portal. A refusal is rendered only inside the dialog (412) and toasts are sent for ok results only (286). `open` state (161) survives the disabled branch, so when the button is enabled again by a later re-render the old dialog remounts unasked. Harness with the real components (audit/karaoke/render/out): dlg-control.json refusal without state change -> dialogStillOpen true, refusalVisible true; dlg-refund-unknown.json row moves to refunding -> dialogStillOpen false, refusalVisible false, toasts []; dlg-list-wrongstatus.json same for row-menu Onayla; dlg-list-ok.json success -> toast shown; dlg-ghost.json slot taken then freed -> ghost dialog 'Rezervasyonu onayla' open without a click.
impact: The operator presses 'İptal et ve iade et', waits for the POS, and the dialog simply closes with no toast; the sentence telling them the refund was sent but not answered and must be checked in PayNkolay is never shown. A confirm that lost a race also closes silently. Later a 'Rezervasyonu onayla' dialog can pop up by itself.
verdict_note: Confirmed on cf30307. The code is byte-identical to the audited tree: git diff f9bfc84 cf30307 touches only action-form.tsx, order-actions-ui.tsx and audit.ts. Path: actions.ts:215 calls revalidate(id) after cancelKaraokeReservation returns refund_unknown. karaoke-payment.ts:1573-1578 leaves the row in paymentStatus 'refunding'. karaokeActionPlan (lib/admin/karaoke-panel.ts:417-421) then gives cancel=null and adds refund/settle, so the ConfirmButton key='cancel' (components/admin/karaoke-panel.tsx:135-150) unmounts together with its portal dialog. action-modal.tsx:286-290 toasts only result.ok, and the refusal is rendered only inside the dialog (412-419). Ghost dialog: useState `open` (161) lives above the disabledReason early return (167-195). After slot_taken the button turns disabled and the portal unmounts while open stays true. When it is enabled again on the same page, the dialog remounts and calls showModal() without a click. Partial mitigation: refused refunds roll the row back to paid (runRefund 1112-1131), so their dialog stays. After refund_unknown the page shows the refund_pending notice (karaoke-panel.ts:264-267) and staff get an alertMoney mail. Only the sentence written for this exact moment is lost. Root cause: a dialog owned by a trigger that depends on the plan, plus refusals that are never toasted. The same pattern exists in other kit areas that revalidate on refusal.
fix: components/admin/ui/action-modal.tsx: (1) In ModalDialog keep the latest refusal in a ref. In the unmount cleanup, if the dialog was not closed by the user and the latest state is a refusal, call toast.show({tone:'danger', message}). Error toasts stay until closed. (2) In ActionModal reset `open` when disabledReason appears (adjust state during render or use an effect). Keep revalidate on refund_unknown, because the row did change. Skipping revalidate is fine only for refusals that wrote nothing (not_found, invalid reason).
fix_original: In components/admin/ui/action-modal.tsx also push refusals to the toast stack (errors stay until closed) or render the dialog outside the plan-dependent subtree; reset `open` when disabledReason appears; optionally skip revalidate on refusals that changed nothing in app/admin/mobil/karaoke/actions.ts.
root_cause_fix: ActionModal: toast the last refusal when the dialog unmounts unclosed; reset `open` when disabledReason appears.

title: Order table overflows its card at 768-1366 px and pushes the '⋯' row-action column off screen
evidence: Measured with the compiled CSS and real components (fixture rows with realistic names): 820px wide: table 823-850px in a 770px wrapper, ⋯ right edge 832-859; 1024px (iPad landscape): 850 vs 718 (+132), ⋯ at x=1115; 1280px: 1026-1100 vs 974 (+52..+126), ⋯ right edge 1291-1365; 1440px fits. Widths at 1280: No 157 (nowrap '#n DİKKAT'), Tarih 130, Müşteri 288 (max-w-[16rem]), Kanal 120, Tutar 105, Durum 175, actions 76. Wrapper is `overflow-x-auto` (data-table.tsx:270) so with 50 rows the horizontal scrollbar is at the bottom of the table. The comment at orders-list.tsx:264-266 ('the ⋯ column stays in view from lg up') is false.
impact: On tablets and 1024-1366px laptops the only per-row action control is invisible until the operator scrolls the table sideways (scrollbar ~50 rows down).
verdict_note: Re-measured in headless Chrome (local Poppins) on the auditor's SSR page. globals.css and the table code are unchanged on cf30307. 820px: wrapper clientWidth 770 vs table 851, '⋯' column at x 799-876. 1024px: 718 vs 851, ⋯ th at x 1055-1132 (viewport 1024). 1280px: 974 vs 1104, ⋯ th at 1308-1385. 1440px: fits (1134/1134). Widths at 1280: No 157, Tarih 133, Müşteri 288, Kanal 120, Tutar 106, Durum 176, actions 76. The comment at orders-list.tsx:264-266 is false. The order page still has every action, but the row control is off screen at common tablet and laptop widths. Same overflow also causes ORD-M01.
fix: In ui/data-table.tsx: make the actions th/td `sticky right-0` with a background that follows the row (hover and selected states), and add `relative` to the scroll wrapper (line 270, see ORD-M01). In orders-list.tsx: let the No cell's date wrap or drop it below xl, narrow Müşteri to max-w-[12rem], show Kanal only from 2xl. Re-measure at 820/1024/1280.
fix_original: Make the actions th/td sticky right (`sticky right-0 bg-[var(--admin-surface)]`) in ui/data-table.tsx; narrow Müşteri to max-w-[12rem], show Kanal only from 2xl, let Durum badges wrap.
root_cause_fix: DataTable: scroll wrapper `relative`; actions th/td `sticky right-0` with a background that follows hover/selected rows. Areas then trim their own columns.

subtasks.what: orders-list.tsx columns: date wraps, Müşteri max-w-[12rem], Kanal from 2xl; re-measure 820/1024/1280

title: Manual orders are always 'Kargo' parcels: a counter/phone order cannot be finished without a fake tracking number, and the shipping fee is always added
evidence: ManualOrderForm has no delivery choice (components/admin/manual-order-form.tsx:243-279). createManualOrder calls finalizeOrder without fulfillment/kind/shipping (store.ts:2748-2800), so the row takes db/schema.sql:1322 `fulfillment text not null default 'shipping'` and insertOrderRow charges `f.shipping ?? { mode: "settings" }` (store.ts:2209, flat fee under the free threshold). For a parcel orderActions offers only `ship` from paid/preparing and `complete` only from shipped (lib/admin/order-actions.ts:366-374); shipOrder refuses an empty number 'Takip numarası olmadan kargoya verilemez.' (lib/admin/order-ops.ts:817-825); bulk 'Kargoda / Hazır' skips parcels without a number (bulkRefusal).
impact: The page promises 'Telefon / mağaza siparişini manuel gir' (siparisler/yeni/page.tsx:42) but an in-store/pickup sale can only be closed by typing a fake tracking number (a customer with an e-mail then receives a 'kargoya verildi' mail with it) or it stays in 'Açık' and the nav badge forever; an in-store sale under the free-shipping threshold is charged the flat shipping fee.
verdict_note: cf30307: createManualOrder calls finalizeOrder (store.ts:2785-2797) with no fulfillment, kind or shipping. orderFulfillment() (order-channel.ts:45-53) maps a missing value to 'shipping', and db/schema.sql:1322 defaults the column to 'shipping'. insertOrderRow charges `f.shipping ?? {mode:'settings'}` (store.ts:2209). computeTotalsWithShipping 'settings' then adds the flat fee under the free threshold (order-pricing.ts:299-300). orderActions offers only `ship` for a parcel in paid/preparing, and `complete` only from shipped (order-actions.ts:366-374). shipOrder refuses an empty number (order-ops.ts:820-825), and bulkRefusal skips parcels with no number (order-actions.ts:509-514). The form has no delivery field (manual-order-form.tsx:243-279). High because it is about money (wrong shipping fee) and the order cannot be completed.
fix: Add a 'Teslimat' choice (Gel-al / Kargo / Kurye) to manual-order-form.tsx and manual-order-schema.ts, default Gel-al. Thread `fulfillment` and `shipping` through createManualOrderAction (siparisler/actions.ts:526) into CreateManualOrderInput and finalizeOrder (store.ts:2748-2797). Pickup: {mode:'fixed', minor:0}. Kurye: shippingModeFor('delivery', settings). Kargo: {mode:'settings'}. Remove or adjust the 'Kargo ve vergi ayarlardan' hint (manual-order-form.tsx:237-240). No mobile API change.
fix_original: Add 'Teslimat' (Gel-al / Kargo / Kurye) and a shipping toggle to manual-order-form.tsx + manual-order-schema.ts; pass fulfillment and shipping {mode:'fixed', minor:0} for pickup from createManualOrderAction into createManualOrder/finalizeOrder (store.ts).

title: Manual order form wipes the typed customer block on every refused submit and hides most field errors
evidence: Posts with `<form action={formAction}>` (line 104); customerName/customerEmail/customerPhone/shippingAddress/status/promoCode/internalNote are uncontrolled (250-306). react-dom 19.2.4 calls requestFormReset for every <form action> (node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js:5263-5277), so a refused submit ('Yetersiz stok', 'Ürün bulunamadı', 1-letter name) clears them; the repo's ActionModal avoids exactly this (ui/action-modal.tsx:299-301 comment). createManualOrderAction returns fieldErrors for every zod issue (siparisler/actions.ts:517-523) but the form renders only items/customerName/customerEmail (115-117, 250, 259), via Field `hint` in grey #8A7A64 (4.16:1) and without aria-describedby. Phone/address/promo/note inputs have no maxLength while the schema caps them (manual-order-schema.ts:49-53) -> 'Formdaki uyarıları gider.' with nothing marked.
impact: Operator retypes the whole customer/delivery block after any server refusal and often cannot see which field is wrong.
verdict_note: manual-order-form.tsx:104 uses `<form action={formAction}>`. customerName/Email/Phone, shippingAddress, status, promoCode and internalNote are uncontrolled (250-306). react-dom 19.2.4 startHostTransition calls requestFormReset$1 before every form action (react-dom-client.production.js:5263-5277). ActionModal documents and avoids exactly this (ui/action-modal.tsx:299-301). The reset is worse than reported: `<Select name=status defaultValue='paid'>` goes back to 'Ödendi'. So after a 'Yetersiz stok' refusal on an order entered as 'Ödeme bekleniyor', re-filling the name and submitting creates a PAID order (paidAt set, store.ts:2234-2236) that nobody paid. That is a money defect, so high stays. Only items/customerName/customerEmail errors are rendered (115-117, 250, 259), in grey #8A7A64 (4.16:1). Phone/address/promo/note have no maxLength while the schema caps them (manual-order-schema.ts:49-53), and the email max(160) has no Turkish message (zod default English). Same root cause as other React 19 form-reset findings.
fix: Submit with onSubmit + startTransition(() => formAction(new FormData(form))) like ActionModal, or make every field controlled. Render each fieldErrors[k] in --admin-danger-ink under its field with aria-describedby. Mirror the schema maxLength on the inputs and give every zod rule a Turkish message. Optionally show stock (see ORD-M03).
fix_original: Submit via onSubmit + startTransition like ActionModal (or control the fields); render every fieldErrors[k] in red under its field with aria-describedby; mirror the schema max lengths on the inputs.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Kasa 'E-posta ile' adds the stamps again on every submit
evidence: The e-mail kind has no single-use token (lib/mobile/counter.ts:489-491) and redeemCounterTokenAction has no repeat guard; after the green receipt the address stays in the field and 'Damga ver' stays enabled (till-console.tsx:182-207, only setState). The customer page guards this same double submit for 3 minutes (musteriler/[email]/actions.ts:44-60, REPEAT_WINDOW_MS).
impact: A second press or Enter after the receipt gives the member another 1-5 stamps (free drinks).
verdict_note: redeemCounterToken's email kind has no token to burn (counter.ts:489-491) and loops addCounterStamp N times (counter.ts:532-534). redeemCounterTokenAction has no repeat guard. After the receipt the address stays in the field and 'Damga ver' is disabled only while pending (till-console.tsx:182-207). A second click or Enter gives 1-5 more stamps. The customer page guards the same double submit (musteriler/[email]/actions.ts:44-60, REPEAT_WINDOW_MS). Raised to high: stamps duplicated through normal UI use.
fix: In kasa/actions.ts, for kind 'email' refuse when the member's last counter stamp is younger than 3 minutes (same query as addCounterStampAction), unless an explicit 'tekrar' flag is sent. Add that checkbox to the e-mail tab. In till-console.tsx clear the e-mail field and keep 'Damga ver' disabled while a receipt is shown (until 'Yeni işlem'). redeemCounterToken is admin-only, so no mobile API change.
fix_original: Apply the REPEAT_WINDOW_MS guard (with an explicit 'tekrar' override) to kind 'email' in redeemCounterTokenAction and clear the e-mail field after success.

title: Any orders role (Personel) rewrites an order's customer e-mail/phone/address; the audit row keeps no before/after
evidence: saveOrderDetailsAction gates on `orders` only, works on any status (completed/refunded too), accepts a blank e-mail, and logs payload {fields:'customer_delivery'}; its own comment (480-481) says an e-mail change moves the order into another member's history.
impact: An order can be moved to another member or its delivery address changed with no record of what it was.
verdict_note: saveOrderDetailsAction (siparisler/actions.ts:468-500) gates on `orders` (staff included, roles.ts), works on any status, accepts a blank or any valid e-mail and audits only {fields:'customer_delivery'}. updateOrderDetails overwrites the columns (store.ts:4574-4593), so the original e-mail, phone and address exist nowhere afterwards. Worse than reported: member history is read by customerEmail (customerOrdersByEmail used by lib/mobile/orders.ts and lib/customer/member-orders.ts). A typo moves the order, with its address and phone, into another member's app and account. PII exposure plus unrecoverable data, so high.
fix: Put old and new values in the audit payload (audit is owner-only, so keep the old e-mail in full so it can be restored). Allow e-mail changes only for canAccess('customers') (owner/manager), and only while the order is open. Staff keep name/phone/address edits on open orders. Show a confirmation when the e-mail changes.
fix_original: Store old/new (masked) values in the audit payload; restrict e-mail changes to owner/manager or open orders; ask for a reason.

title: Promo edit page always crashes: a plain closure is passed to the client PromoForm
evidence: Server page builds `const action = (prev: PromoActionState, formData: FormData) => updatePromoAction(id, prev, formData);` (23-24) and passes it to PromoForm (33), which is "use client" (components/admin/promo-form.tsx:1). Next 16.3.8's RSC compile (scratchpad/audit/people/swc-check2.cjs) leaves it a plain arrow (0 registerServerReference). Serializing <PromoForm action={closure}> with the Flight server Next ships (audit/people/flight-repro.cjs, node --conditions=react-server) fails with "Functions cannot be passed directly to Client Components unless you explicitly expose it by marking it with \"use server\""; the same element with a bound server reference serializes fine. Reached from DataTable rowHref (promosyon/page.tsx:104, desktop code cell + phone card title) and ActionMenuLink "Düzenle" (:160). Every other edit page binds (musteriler/[email]/duzenle/page.tsx:24-25 even comments "NOT a plain arrow closure"). Identical on origin/main 2d0c023, so production is affected.
impact: Every way into editing a promo code shows "Bu ekran yüklenemedi … Önce tekrar dene"; retrying never helps. Value, expiry, limit or minimum of a code can never be changed; only delete + recreate (losing usageCount).
verdict_note: Confirmed on cf30307. src/app/admin/promosyon/[id]/duzenle/page.tsx:23-24 builds a plain arrow `(prev, formData) => updatePromoAction(id, prev, formData)` (no "use server"). Line 33 passes it to PromoForm, which is "use client" (src/components/admin/promo-form.tsx:1). I re-ran the auditor's flight-repro.cjs against this tree's next 16.3.8 compiled Flight server. The plain closure gives `onError: Functions cannot be passed directly to Client Components unless you explicitly expose it by marking it with "use server"`; the bound server reference serializes. The page is reached from promosyon/page.tsx:104 (rowHref) and :160 (Düzenle). Severity lowered from critical: the list's Pasife al and Sil still work and no money or data is lost, but promo editing is fully dead. Same root cause (F) as PEO-M01: the member address edit page has the same closure pattern.
fix: promosyon/[id]/duzenle/page.tsx: `const action = updatePromoAction.bind(null, promo.id);` (as musteriler/[email]/duzenle/page.tsx:25 does). Add a static test that fails when a server page passes an inline `(prev, formData) =>` closure as a client prop. It should also cover src/app/uye/hesap/adreslerim/[id]/duzenle/page.tsx (PEO-M01). Be aware that fixing this re-enables updatePromo, so ship PEO-M03 alongside.
fix_original: In promosyon/[id]/duzenle/page.tsx use `const action = updatePromoAction.bind(null, promo.id);`. Add a test that renders/serializes the page so closures passed to client props fail CI.
root_cause_fix: Server pages bind server actions (.bind) instead of passing inline closures to client forms; a static test scans src/app for the pattern.

title: A refused save wipes what the operator typed (React 19 form reset) in every PEOPLE form
evidence: These forms use useActionState + `<form action={formAction}>` with uncontrolled defaultValue fields. React 19 resets such a form when the action finishes regardless of the answer (Next's compiled react-dom: startHostTransition → requestFormReset$1(formFiber) before every form action). Browser test with the project's React 19.2.4 (scratchpad/audit/people/visual/reset/): name "Ayşe Yılmaz"→"Ayşe Yılmaz Demir", phone→"0532 000 00 00", role cashier→manager, action answers {error} → afterwards name="Ayşe Yılmaz", phone="", role="cashier" while the error shows; a controlled input keeps its text. The repo documents exactly this in action-form.tsx:207-211 and action-modal.tsx:299-301 and avoids it there; these forms were never moved.
impact: Member edit: the field error sits under a field that jumped back to the stored value, all other edits lost. New promo: "Bu kod zaten kullanılıyor." empties code/value/min/limit/expiry. New panel user: "Bu e-posta zaten kayıtlı" or short password clears e-mail/name/password and resets Rol to Kasiyer (retry can create the wrong role). Coupon grant: type back to %, values cleared. Stamp: note cleared exactly when the server asks to tick "tekrar". Barista grant: e-mail cleared.
verdict_note: Confirmed; root cause A. All of these use useActionState plus `<form action={formAction}>` with uncontrolled defaultValue fields: customer-form.tsx:29,34; promo-form.tsx:32,38; kullanicilar/user-forms.tsx:75-82,138-188,244-250; customer-coupons.tsx:39,112-124; customer-stamps.tsx:49,67. React 19 resets such forms after every action. The repo documents this at action-form.tsx:207-211 and action-modal.tsx:299-301 and avoids it there. The money impact is worse than the audit says. New promo refused with 'Bu kod zaten kullanılıyor.': valuePct silently goes back to "10" (or valueFixed to "50,00"), usageLimit to "0" (unlimited), expiresAt to "" (never) and isActive back on. Only `code` is visibly empty, so the retry creates a different, unlimited code. Coupon grant: Tür (uncontrolled Select defaultValue="pct") goes back to %, so a retyped '15' becomes 15% instead of 15 TL. High is justified (coupons, roles).
fix: Smallest safe fix: in each listed component, dispatch from onSubmit with e.preventDefault() + startTransition(() => formAction(new FormData(form, submitter))), as ActionForm does. This keeps the current {error,message,fieldErrors} state shapes, so tests/admin-customer-actions.test.ts, admin-staff-actions.test.ts and admin-campaign-mail-actions.test.ts stay valid. Fuller fix: move to ActionForm/FormFieldError/FormMessage with ActionResult (actionError + fieldErrorsFromIssues), updating the tests that assert `state.error` / `state.message`.
fix_original: Move customer-form.tsx, promo-form.tsx, user-forms.tsx, customer-coupons.tsx, customer-stamps.tsx to ActionForm + FormFieldError + FormMessage + SubmitButton (actions answer ActionResult via actionError + fieldErrorsFromIssues), or at least dispatch from onSubmit with startTransition like ActionForm.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Member address edit page passes a plain async closure to the client AddressForm and always crashes (same root as PEO-01)
evidence: The server page builds `const boundAction = async (prev: AddressFormState, formData: FormData) => updateAddressAction(id, prev, formData);` (26-27) with no "use server" and passes it as `action` to AddressForm (46). AddressForm is "use client" (src/app/uye/hesap/adreslerim/address-form.tsx:1). It is the same pattern that flight-repro.cjs proves fails on this tree's next 16.3.8 Flight server ('Functions cannot be passed directly to Client Components'). The page is linked from src/app/uye/hesap/adreslerim/page.tsx:78, and the code has been unchanged since 482badd.
impact: Every member who taps 'düzenle' on a saved address gets the error page; addresses can only be deleted and re-added.
fix: `const boundAction = updateAddressAction.bind(null, id);` (updateAddressAction is in the "use server" src/app/uye/actions.ts). Cover it with the same static closure test proposed for PEO-01. Customer-facing; no API or legal change.
plan_note: One-line wiring fix in a customer page (src/app/uye/...); not in either in-flight branch (feat/site-home-karaoke-art touches only adreslerim/page.tsx).
root_cause_fix: Server pages bind server actions (.bind) instead of passing inline closures to client forms; a static test scans src/app for the pattern.

title: A refused product save silently resets every select and checkbox, and the next save changes the product
evidence: The wizard posts through <form action={formAction}> (useActionState, line 138/918). React 19 resets a form after its action finishes. Controlled <select> options carry no defaultSelected, so the reset falls back to the first option, and checkboxes fall back to their mount value. action-form.tsx:207-211 documents this reset and avoids it by dispatching from onSubmit, but the wizard does not. Proof, real React 19.2.4 in Chrome (harness audit/catalog/harness, scenario #urunler-duzenle, product 'Moka Pot 3 Cup' in cat=gear): when the server refused a price, the DOM showed cat 'beans', img 'cream', backdrop 'auto', vessel ''. Toggled featured went true->false and isActive went false->true. The next accepted save posted cat='beans', although nobody had touched the category.
impact: The operator fixes a typo in price, tasting notes or variants and saves again. The product moves to 'Çekirdek' and loses its Sahne, Kap biçimi and Görsel ton choices. A product just set to Pasif is saved as Aktif again. The summary card still shows the old values, so nothing warns.
verdict_note: The catalog code on cf30307 is identical to the audit tree f9bfc84; the only diffs are action-form.tsx (a rename), order-actions-ui.tsx and audit.ts. product-wizard.tsx:918 uses `<form action={formAction}>` with useActionState at :138. In react-dom 19.2.4 (next/dist/compiled/react-dom), recursivelyResetForms runs fiber.reset() after all commit mutations. React's 'reset' event only dispatches handlers and restores no controlled state. initSelect/updateOptions with a value prop never set defaultSelected, so reset picks the first option. Affected: cat :375 (categories sorted, beans first), img :743 (cream), backdrop backdrop-field.tsx:193 (auto). Checkboxes isActive :388, featured :818 and isNew :824 fall back to their mount defaultChecked. FormData on the next save reads the DOM, so the wrong category, scene and active flag get saved. Shared root cause RC-A with CAT-13, CAT-17 and CAT-09.
fix: product-wizard.tsx: keep useActionState but dispatch by hand like ActionForm. Use onSubmit with preventDefault, then startTransition(() => formAction(new FormData(e.currentTarget, submitter))). redirect() still works, as it does for ActionForm. Do not wrap the wizard in ActionForm: the product actions return ProductActionState {error, fieldErrors}, not ActionResult. Add a jsdom test that a refused save keeps the cat, img and backdrop selects and the isActive and featured checkboxes.
fix_original: In product-wizard.tsx, dispatch by hand like ActionForm (onSubmit + preventDefault + startTransition(() => formAction(new FormData(form, submitter)))) or wrap the form in ActionForm. Add a test that a refused save keeps select and checkbox values.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: 'Ürünü kaydet' does nothing when a required field on an earlier step is empty
evidence: Steps 1-4 are display:none on step 5, and name, tag, desc and price are required (stock fields have min=0). 'Sonraki adım' (989-996) validates nothing. The browser cannot show a validation bubble on a control that is not rendered, so it cancels the submit and only writes to the console. Proof in Chrome (harness #urunler-yeni): after moving through steps 1->5 and clicking 'Ürünü kaydet', no submit event fired and 0 action calls were made. invalid events fired for name, tag, desc and price, and the console showed "An invalid form control with name='name' is not focusable." four times. Focus stayed on <body> (screens/wizard-step5-390.jpg).
impact: The operator cannot create a product and gets no reason why, so the button looks dead. A negative stock typed on step 2 or 3 has the same effect.
verdict_note: product-wizard.tsx:952-960: in wizard mode every step except the current one is a Card with display:none (:958). name (:297-301), tag, desc and price are `required`, and the stock fields have min=0. 'Sonraki adım' (:989-996) only calls setStep. The form has no noValidate. Chrome's interactive validation shows a bubble only on a focusable invalid control, logs 'not focusable' for the rest and cancels the submit, so nothing is visible on step 5. An operator who skips 'Etiket' (required, no mark) cannot create a product and gets no reason. Tabs mode (the edit page) shows the bubble and is fine. It is high because a core control is unusable with no feedback.
fix: product-wizard.tsx: on 'Sonraki adım', run checkValidity()/reportValidity() over the current step's controls and stay on the step if any fail. On submit, add an onInvalid capture on the form, or check before dispatch: find the first invalid element, setStep to its step, then reportValidity() after render. Mark step pills that hold invalid or server-refused fields. Can be done together with the CAT-01 manual dispatch.
fix_original: Before 'Sonraki adım', call reportValidity() on the current step's fields. On submit, find the first invalid control, setStep to its step, then call reportValidity(). Put an error mark on the step pills that hold errors.

title: Editing a product overwrites live stock and variant stock with the values from when the form was opened
evidence: The edit form keeps 'Stok adet' and each variant's stock in state, initialised from the product when the page loaded. updateProductAction passes stock and variants to updateProduct, which writes next = {...existing, ...input}. Orders decrement products.stock and the variant JSONB stock under a row lock (db/schema.sql:270-316 claim_order_stock). Manual corrections use adjust_product_stock precisely because a read-modify-write 'lost one of the two writes ... the direction that oversells' (db/schema.sql:1025-1032). The product edit is exactly such a read-modify-write, and it records no stock move.
impact: Any sale, cancel restock or manual correction made while an edit tab is open is undone when the operator saves a price or text change, which leads to overselling. The Stok page, whose copy says every change is recorded (stok-hareketleri/page.tsx:51), stops matching the real stock.
verdict_note: store.ts:1024-1047 updateProduct builds next = {...existing, ...input} and writes .update(next). urunler/actions.ts:61 and :69 put stock and variants (with stock) into input from the form state, initialised at mount (product-wizard.tsx:179, 187-189). claim_order_stock (db/schema.sql:270-316) decrements products.stock and the variant JSONB stock under a row lock. adjust_product_stock exists because a read-modify-write lost writes in the overselling direction (schema.sql:1022-1029). No stock move is recorded, so stok-hareketleri no longer adds up. Same area as CAT-14 (RC-E).
fix: Do NOT just make stock read-only with a link to Stok: Stok cannot adjust variant stock (CAT-14), so that would remove the only way to set it. Post hidden stockAtOpen and per-variant stockAtOpen. In updateProductAction/updateProduct, drop stock and variants[].stock from the update when they equal the snapshot. When they changed, apply only the delta: products via adjust_product_stock plus recordStockMove('manual_adjust', note 'Ürün formu'); variants through a new atomic SQL function in a migration, or refuse the save if the DB value moved since open. Files: src/lib/admin/store.ts, src/app/admin/urunler/actions.ts, src/components/admin/product-wizard.tsx, db/migrations (if a variant function is added). Add tests.
fix_original: Make stock read-only on the edit form with a link to Stok. Or post the stock the form was opened with and apply only the difference through adjust_product_stock, with a stock move. Do the same for variant stock. Never write stock or variants[].stock from a snapshot.

title: A ₺0 price, or a variant discount larger than the price, is accepted, and baskets of such items are settled as paid
evidence: moneyToMinor accepts an empty value or '0' as 0. Variant deltas are signed, and only |delta| is capped. menuItemFieldsSchema accepts '0' for both M and L. The line price is Math.max(0, price + delta) (store.ts:1907-1910), and cafe lines use item.priceMinor (lib/mobile/order-pricing.ts:87-97). A zero total is auto-settled as paid on the web (app/odeme/actions.ts:485-509) and in the app (lib/mobile/orders.ts:602-610). The app's shop feed publishes the negative variant price (lib/mobile/menu-mapper.ts:408).
impact: One slip, such as '0' left as a placeholder or '-400' on a 320 ₺ product, gives the item away, and the order lands as Ödendi. Neither the form nor the server warns; the wizard summary just shows '-'.
verdict_note: product-schema.ts:127-140: moneyToMinor accepts '0' (and empty as 0) for the required price. Variant deltas are signed, and only abs > CATALOG_MONEY_MAX is refused (:206-220). menu-item-schema.ts:41-48 accepts '0' for M. store.ts:1907-1910 prices a line at max(0, price+delta). commerce.ts:22-26 charges no shipping when the net is 0. odeme/actions.ts:485-509 settles totalMinor===0 as paid (provider 'free'), and so does mobile/orders.ts:602-610. menu-mapper.ts:408 publishes priceMinor+delta, which can be negative, to the app. No guard anywhere refuses a 0 price.
fix: product-schema.ts: refuse price < 1 kuruş under 'price', as a separate required-positive transform; keep moneyToMinor for the optional compareAt and cost, because tests/admin-catalog-money.test.ts expects 'keeps an empty optional price at 0'. Refuse any variant whose price+delta < 1 kuruş under 'variants', naming the variant. menu-item-schema.ts: refuse M = 0. Keep L empty, '-' or '0' meaning single size; do not refuse it. Do not touch the zero-total settle in odeme or mobile, which 100% promos need. Add tests.
fix_original: In product-schema and menu-item-schema, refuse a price below 0,01 TL under its field (product, menu M, and menu L when given). Refuse any variant whose price + delta is below 0,01 TL and name the variant in the message.

title: Deleting the last story period / app slide / announcement / post brings the bundled seed rows back on the next cold start
evidence: contentResource.ensure (store.ts:6355-6371) and ensureAppContentSeed (6685-6713) upsert the seed whenever countRows(table) === 0; memoizeUntilRejected (src/lib/db/health.ts:79-93) memoises per server instance only, so each fresh Vercel instance re-checks. Awaited by every list/get/create/update/delete (6731, 6752, 6801, 6818, 6835, 6963, 6984, 6995, 7012, 7052, 7062, 7086, 7127, 7147, 7164; contentResource 6376-6429), including the public reads. Seeds: 4 story periods (6491-6505 from data.ts:946-972), 4 slides (6591), announcements 'Hafta sonu 24:00'e kadar' / 'Yeni: Çıtır Latte' (6658-6683), posts incl. 'Hafta içi 09:00-11:00 arası tüm içeceklerde ikincisi yarı fiyatına' (6890-6923). Announcements also feed member notifications (src/lib/mobile/notifications.ts:340, 430); posts feed /kampanyalar and /api/mobile/v1/app-content. Press is safe (PRESS = [] at data.ts:944).
impact: The delete dialogs promise 'kalıcı olarak silinir'. When the operator removes the last row (announcements are short-lived by design), a later cold start re-inserts the seeds: every phone and /kampanyalar shows a half-price promo the till does not honour, a 24:00 weekend closing that contradicts the real 02:00, and a retired product, also in the notification feed, without anyone being told.
verdict_note: On cf30307, store.ts:6355-6371 (contentResource.ensure) and 6685-6713 (ensureAppContentSeed) upsert the seed rows whenever countRows(table)===0 (countRows at store.ts:546-553). The memo is per instance only (health.ts:79-93). Every list/get/create/update/delete awaits it, and so do the public reads: listActiveAppSlides at 6743-6748, the app-content route, kampanyalar/page.tsx:54 and notifications.ts:430. The post seed at 6890-6905 includes 'Hafta içi 09:00-11:00 arası tüm içeceklerde ikincisi yarı fiyatına'. The announcement seed at 6658-6683 includes 'Hafta sonu 24:00'e kadar'. Story periods reseed from SEED_STORY.heritage. Press is safe because PRESS=[] (data.ts:944) and its rows were retired by migration, not deleted. Root cause R-SEED.
fix: In src/lib/admin/store.ts, stop seeding 'when empty'. Either drop the runtime seed for these tables (prod is already seeded) or gate it on a persistent marker (a settings key such as seeded:<table>) instead of the row count. tests/admin-content-deletes.test.ts:204-206 mocks the count query as 'seeded', so update those mocks. Add a test: delete all rows, reset the memo, list again, expect [].
fix_original: Seed once, not 'when empty': move seeds to a migration or record a persistent seeded:<table> marker (settings row) and test that instead of the row count, in store.ts contentResource and ensureAppContentSeed. Add a test: delete all rows, reset memo, list again, expect [].
plan_note: Same store.ts seed mechanism as CAT-04; one fix. tests/admin-content-deletes.test.ts mocks updated in catalog-data.
root_cause_fix: Seeds gated by a one-time marker, never by countRows()==0; setCounter never lowers; products/menu/category seed never runs in production.

title: 'Varsayılana döndür' hard-deletes the custom legal text on one click: no confirm, no toast, no undo
evidence: hukuk/page.tsx:68-75 is a plain <form action={resetLegalDocAction}> with GhostButton type=submit. hukuk/actions.ts:59-73 returns void (no ActionResult, no setAdminFlash). src/lib/legal/store.ts:160-169 issues a DELETE. The audit row stores only { reset: true } (actions.ts:69), not the text.
impact: One mis-tap next to 'Düzenle' replaces the published, lawyer-reviewed KVKK / mesafeli satış text on /hukuk/<slug> and in the app with the coded default; the custom Markdown is unrecoverable. The only feedback is the pill silently turning 'Varsayılan'.
verdict_note: hukuk/page.tsx:68-75 is a plain <form action={resetLegalDocAction}> with a GhostButton and no confirm. hukuk/actions.ts:59-73 returns void, with no ActionResult and no flash. lib/legal/store.ts:160-169 DELETEs the override row. The audit row stores only {reset:true} (actions.ts:69). The legal role is owner-only (roles.ts:85), but one mis-tap still loses the custom text, drafts included, for good.
fix: Use ConfirmButton (tone danger). resetLegalDocAction must take the ModalAction shape (prev, formData) and return actionOk/actionError. Before the delete, copy the removed row into a history/archive row so it can be restored. Prefer that over putting up to 60 KB of Markdown into the audit payload. Files: hukuk/page.tsx, hukuk/actions.ts, lib/legal/store.ts.
fix_original: Use ConfirmButton (tone danger, title '<belge> varsayılana dönsün mü?', description 'Yayındaki özel metin silinir, /hukuk sayfası kodlu metni gösterir.') and make resetLegalDocAction return actionOk/actionError. Keep the removed row (copy body into the audit payload or soft-delete/archive) so it can be restored. Files: hukuk/page.tsx, hukuk/actions.ts, lib/legal/store.ts.

title: 12 forms on <form action> + useActionState wipe everything typed whenever the server refuses
evidence: React 19.2.4 resets every <form action={fn}> before running the action regardless of its answer: node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js:5263-5277 (requestFormReset$1(formFiber); return action(formData)), dev build 8940-8958; the repo documents it in components/admin/action-form.tsx:207-210. Affected: icerik/content-form.tsx:23; mobil/canli-durum/venue-status-form.tsx:67 (refusal actions.ts:39-42); mobil/ayarlar/app-config-form.tsx:195, 258, 341, 413, 515, 613, 669, 728, 780 (refusals: version regex, ETA order, reminder sales words actions.ts:240-248, store URL host, SHA-256, Team ID, closeHour); components/admin/legal-doc-form.tsx:42 (refusals: title>200, summary>600, effectiveDate>60 with no maxLength on any of them, legal-schema.ts:9,13,16; publish with <20 chars).
impact: The error shows and every field of that form snaps back to the stored values: one over-long 'Özet' discards a whole edited legal Markdown body; one 'indirim' in a reminder resets all four reminders; free tables > total resets the venue numbers. Operators re-click Kaydet and save the old values believing the change went through.
verdict_note: React 19.2.4 is installed. react-dom-client.production.js:5263-5277 (startHostTransition) calls requestFormReset$1(formFiber) before the action runs, whatever the action returns. The repo documents this at components/admin/action-form.tsx:207-212. Still on <form action={useActionState action}>: icerik/content-form.tsx:23, mobil/canli-durum/venue-status-form.tsx:67, the 9 tab forms in mobil/ayarlar/app-config-form.tsx, and components/admin/legal-doc-form.tsx:42. Real refusals exist: the version regex (ayarlar/actions.ts:98-102), reminder sales words (240-248), freeTables>totalTables (canli-durum/actions.ts:39-42), and the legal summary>600 or body>60000 limits with no maxLength (legal-schema.ts). Root cause R-RESET, shared with CON-04, CON-21 and CON-22.
fix: Dispatch these forms the way ActionForm does: onSubmit with preventDefault, then startTransition(() => formAction(new FormData(form))), so no reset happens. The app-config, venue and content actions return {message, error}, not ActionResult. Either adapt them to ActionResult and use ActionForm, or apply the same onSubmit pattern locally. Keep app-config's hidden-pane design. Files: content-form.tsx, venue-status-form.tsx, app-config-form.tsx, legal-doc-form.tsx.
fix_original: Drive these forms like ActionForm (onSubmit + startTransition(() => formAction(fd)), which does not reset) or keep values controlled; show field errors under fields (FormFieldError) instead of one line in the save bar. Files: content-form.tsx, venue-status-form.tsx, app-config-form.tsx, legal-doc-form.tsx.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Catalog buttons ignore their size and weight classes and mix shapes
line: 267-274 (button reset) vs 6138-6144 (admin-root rule); call sites urunler/page.tsx:158-169, products-list.tsx:202-208, 360-420, menu-list.tsx:181-188, stok-hareketleri/page.tsx:100-111, magaza-hero/page.tsx:96-108, product-wizard.tsx:923-946, bulk.tsx:202-214
evidence:
button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer } is unlayered, and the admin-root rule rolls back only color, background, border, padding and text-decoration. As a result, text-xs, text-sm and font-medium on buttons have no effect. Measured in Chrome at 390 px:
- urunler filter: the 'Sıfırla' link is a 12px pill, while 'Uygula' is a 16px weight-400 rounded-xl button (declared text-xs font-medium).
- Product and menu rows: 'Düzenle' is a 12px pill, while 'Sil' and 'Tükendi' are 16px rounded-xl.
- Stok filter: 'Uygula' is 16px rounded-xl and 'Sıfırla' a 14px pill.
- Hero list: 'Düzenle' is a 40 px pill and 'Sil' a 44 px rounded-xl.
- Wizard step pills render at 16px (declared 12px), so at 390 px the active step 5 is scrolled out of the stepper.
- Bulk bar: '2 seçili' is 12px and its buttons 16px.
- ActionMenu: 'Düzenle' is 14px and 'Sil' 16px.
- The aria-disabled 'Sil' for a category with products keeps cursor:pointer.
Screenshots: screens/urunler-390.jpg, screens/menu-390.jpg.
impact: Rows and toolbars look uneven, with small pills next to big boxes and mixed radii and sizes in one row. This is the opposite of the uniform Filament-style look the operator asked for.
verdict_note: globals.css:267-274 sets `button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; ... }` unlayered, which beats every Tailwind utility (a layer). The admin-root rule (globals.css:6138-6144) reverts only color, background, border, padding and text-decoration, so text-xs, text-sm and font-medium on any <button> inherit 16px/400. The same happens to kit BUTTON_BASE text-sm and disabled:cursor-not-allowed (ui/styles.ts:5), while <a> links keep their sizes, hence the mixed rows. Root cause RC-B, shared with CAT-12 and the bulk-bar part of CAT-26.
fix: globals.css: add `font: revert-layer;` to `[data-admin-root] :is(a, button)`. Do NOT add `cursor: revert-layer`: Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight sets no cursor on buttons (node_modules/tailwindcss/preflight.css), so every admin button would lose its pointer. Instead keep the pointer and add `[data-admin-root] button:is(:disabled,[aria-disabled="true"]) { cursor: not-allowed; }`. Extend tests/admin-root-css.test.ts (it checks with toContain, so it stays green) to require font. Then replace the hand-made pill classes with BUTTON.*.
fix_original: Add font: revert-layer and cursor: revert-layer (or the longhand properties) to the [data-admin-root] :is(a, button) rule (shell). Replace the hand-rolled pill classes in the catalog lists and forms with BUTTON.* variants.
root_cause_fix: globals.css admin-root rule gains `font: revert-layer`; unlayered `[data-admin-root] :is(button:disabled,[aria-disabled=true])` gets cursor:not-allowed. No `cursor: revert-layer` (Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight has no button pointer).

title: Global print CSS blanks every page without [data-print-receipt], incl. legal docs and the legal editor
evidence: globals.css:6149-6171: @media print { body * { visibility: hidden } [data-print-receipt], [data-print-receipt] * { visibility: visible } }, unscoped, from d9fef59 (order detail v2). Only order-detail.tsx and masalar/yazdir carry data-print-receipt; globals.css is imported by the root layout (src/app/layout.tsx:11), so it applies site-wide.
impact: Printing or 'Save as PDF' of the legal editor, fA'L reports, any CONTENT page, and the public /hukuk/* documents this area manages produces an empty page.
verdict_note: globals.css:6149-6171 sets @media print { body * { visibility:hidden } } with only [data-print-receipt] made visible again. The rule is unscoped and comes from d9fef59. globals.css is imported by the root layout (src/app/layout.tsx:11). Only order-detail.tsx:632 and masalar/yazdir/page.tsx:63 carry the attribute. Printing or saving to PDF any other page, including public /hukuk/* and the legal editor, gives a blank page.
fix: Scope the rule to `body:has([data-print-receipt]) *` (and the matching visible rule). order-detail and masalar/yazdir keep working because both pages contain the attribute. Optionally add print styles for .legal-page. Owned by SHELL (globals.css).
fix_original: Scope the rule to receipt pages, e.g. body:has([data-print-receipt]) *, and add a print style for .legal-page. Owned by SHELL (globals.css).
root_cause_fix: Scope the print rule to `body:has([data-print-receipt])`; shell-nav adds print:hidden to the sidebar, top bar and drawer.

title: Kit buttons ignore their size, weight and cursor classes; focus ring is the shop's green
evidence: Unlayered `button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer }` and the unlayered `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); box-shadow: var(--ring) }` beat Tailwind's layered utilities; the admin-root override only reverts color, background, border, padding, text-decoration. Harness computed styles: FilterBar 'Uygula' 16px/400 (text-sm font-medium wanted); booking page action buttons 16px; dialog 'Vazgeç' and submit 16px/400; row-menu items 14px in the desktop table (inherited from table.text-sm) but 16px in phone cards; 'Masayı ekle', 'Kaydet', 'Yazdır' 16px/400; aria-disabled buttons ('İadeyi yeniden dene', menu 'Onayla') keep cursor:pointer; every focused control shows 2px #1d6d56 + green halo instead of ring-[var(--admin-accent)] (out/list-*.json, out/list-focus.json). Links styled as buttons next to them render 14px/500.
impact: Buttons are bigger and lighter than the link-buttons beside them, sizes change between table and phone card, disabled money buttons show a hand cursor, the focus ring is the shop's green.
verdict_note: Confirmed. globals.css:267-274 is an unlayered `button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer }` and :690-700 an unlayered `button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green) (#1d6d56); box-shadow: var(--ring) }`. Both beat Tailwind 4.3.3 utilities, which sit in @layer utilities. The admin override at 6138-6144 reverts only color/background/border/padding/text-decoration. So text-sm/font-medium (styles.ts:5-21, forms.tsx:79,93), aria-disabled:cursor-not-allowed and focus-visible:ring/outline-none all lose. Opacity utilities still apply, and so does the disabled reason text. Shared root cause for the whole panel (SHELL owns globals.css).
fix: Correction: `cursor: revert-layer` would regress. Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight sets no cursor on buttons (node_modules/tailwindcss/preflight.css has none), so every admin button would show the arrow cursor. Instead add `font: revert-layer` to `[data-admin-root] :is(a, button)`, keep cursor:pointer and add `[data-admin-root] button:is(:disabled,[aria-disabled="true"]) { cursor: not-allowed }` (or add cursor-pointer to BUTTON_BASE/menu/link and the forms.tsx buttons and revert cursor).
