title: 2FA setup page replaces the secret on every render, so a QR scanned earlier stops working
evidence: The GET render calls startEnrollment() (page.tsx:85), which generates a new secret and upserts it with enabled:false every time (twofa.ts:77-89). verifyEnrollAction checks the code against whatever secret is now stored (actions.ts:35). Any re-render between scanning and typing (reload, a second tab, leaving via the sidebar and returning through the dashboard quick link, or 'Vazgeç': cancelEnrollAction deletes the draft and revalidates, so the page immediately renders a new draft) leaves the phone with a dead secret. The refusal then reads 'Kod doğrulanmadı. Saatin senkron olduğundan emin ol.' (actions.ts:36-37).
impact: Setup fails permanently after a single reload, with an error that blames the phone's clock; 'Vazgeç' does not cancel, it shows another QR.
verdict_note: 2fa-kurulum/page.tsx:85 calls startEnrollment on every GET render. twofa.ts:77-89 generates a new secret and upserts it with enabled:false each time. verifyEnrollAction (actions.ts:35) checks against whatever is stored now. A reload, a second tab or a revisit kills the QR already scanned, and the refusal blames the clock (actions.ts:36-37). cancelEnrollAction (82-87) deletes the draft and only calls revalidatePath, so the page immediately renders a new QR. A refused code does not re-render (no revalidate), so retyping alone is safe.
fix: src/lib/admin/twofa.ts startEnrollment: if a row exists with enabled=false (optionally younger than about 15 min by updatedAt), return its secret instead of upserting a new one. Keep it called ONLY from the page. The auditor's alternative (a 'Kurulumu başlat' server action) would put `startEnrollment(` in actions.ts and fail tests/admin-2fa-enrollment.test.ts:19, which guards the public-endpoint risk. cancelEnrollAction: redirect to landingPathFor(role) after deleting. Refusal copy: mention re-scanning if the QR changed.
fix_original: Reuse an existing enabled:false draft's secret instead of upserting a new one on render (or create the draft from an explicit 'Kurulumu başlat' server action); make 'Vazgeç' redirect to the landing path; change the refusal copy to say 'QR yenilendiyse yeniden tarat'.

title: A database blip signs every panel user out (redirect to login, typed input lost) instead of showing the panel error screen
evidence: resolveAdminUser swallows every DB error and returns null ('Never throws', users.ts:145-150). getAdminSession → sessionFromToken → currentAccount (auth.ts:196-222) then finds no account for a panel (DB) user and returns null; getAdminSession (519-528) also catches. The layout renders the signed-out wrapper and requireRole (489-495) redirects to /admin/giris; inside a server action the redirect is rethrown (action-form.tsx:58) so the page navigates away. error.tsx:11-16 states such one-second DB stumbles are common and was built for them.
impact: A momentary DB error during a save throws the operator onto the login screen and discards what they typed; only env break-glass accounts survive.
verdict_note: users.ts:142-151 resolveAdminUser catches every DB error and returns null. currentAccount (auth.ts:196-222) then has no account for a panel user and returns null. getAdminSession (auth.ts:519-528) also wraps everything in try/catch returning null. The layout then renders the signed-out shell, and requireRole (480-495) redirects to /admin/giris. Inside a panel action, runPanelAction re-throws the redirect (action-form.tsx:58, unstable_rethrow), so the operator is sent to the login page and loses the form. requireRole's redirect carries no `next`.
fix: In auth.ts currentAccount, use a throwing lookup (fetchRow-based) for panel accounts. Keep the env fallback when the address is an env account. Leave resolveAdminUser as it is for signInAdmin (break-glass). Narrow getAdminSession's catch so that DB-unreachable errors propagate. Important caveat: admin/error.tsx does not catch errors thrown by admin/layout.tsx (same segment); they would fall to the SHOP's src/app/error.tsx. So the layout must catch that error and render the panel shell with a notice, while pages (requireRole) throw into admin/error.tsx.
fix_original: In auth.ts currentAccount, distinguish 'DB unreachable' (throw, so app/admin/error.tsx with 'Tekrar dene' shows) from 'no active row' (null); keep the env fallback for break-glass accounts.

subtasks.what: layout.tsx catches the new DB-unavailable error and renders the panel shell with a notice

title: Bulk selection survives tab/filter/sort/page changes and acts on orders no longer on screen
evidence: useSelection state lives in OrdersList; Next keys page state without search params (node_modules/next/dist/client/components/layout-router.js:549 'no search params'), so status tabs, filters, sort and page links keep it. SelectAllCheckbox keeps out-of-page ids on purpose (bulk.tsx:138-149). The bar shows only 'N seçili' (bulk.tsx:202-207), never which orders.
impact: Select three open orders, click the 'Tamamlandı' tab, press 'İptal et': the three invisible orders are cancelled (the typed confirmation only repeats '3').
verdict_note: layout-router.js:549 builds the state key with createRouterCacheKey(segment, true), which drops search params. So OrdersList (and useSelection, orders-list.tsx:178-179) survives tab, filter, sort and page links. SelectAllCheckbox keeps out-of-page ids (bulk.tsx:138-149). BulkOrderButtons sends every selected id (order-actions-ui.tsx:944-967), and runBulkOrderAction cancels any of them that bulkRefusal allows (stock and coupons returned, collected orders cancelled for owner/manager). The bar shows only 'N seçili'.
fix: In siparisler/page.tsx render `<OrdersList key={JSON.stringify(sp)} …>` so a URL change starts a fresh selection. Do not push the query string through useSelection's resetOn: it only clears on a truthy value, and the plain list's query is "". Optionally list the selected order numbers in the bar.
fix_original: Reset the selection when the query string changes (key OrdersList by the serialized searchParams or pass it as resetOn), or list the off-page selected orders in the bar.

title: New-order poll, sound and banner are switched off on every tab, 'Açık' included
evidence: `narrowed` is true for any tab (`tab !== null`, order-filters.ts:243-248); page passes live={!parsed.narrowed} (siparisler/page.tsx:150); the poll returns immediately when !live (orders-list.tsx:218) and the 'Ses' toggle is hidden (365). New orders land in 'Açık', 'Ödeme bekleniyor' and 'Ödendi'.
impact: A shift working from the 'Açık' tab gets no sound and no 'N yeni sipariş' banner; only the 60 s nav badge changes.
verdict_note: parseOrderListParams sets narrowed=true for any tab (order-filters.ts:243-248). page.tsx:150 passes live={!parsed.narrowed}, and the poll returns early when !live (orders-list.tsx:218-219), which also hides the Ses toggle (365). Every new order starts as pending_payment, paid or preparing (manual), so all of them land in 'Açık'.
fix: Compute live separately: no filters, page 1, default sort, and tab null or 'acik'. countOrdersAfter already counts exactly the orders that appear in Açık. Leave the pending and paid tabs off rather than changing newOrderCountAction's signature.
fix_original: Keep live on page 1 with the default sort for Tümü/Açık/pending/paid and count new orders with the tab's statuses.

title: Kasa: a throw after the stamps landed shows the panel error page
evidence: redeemCounterTokenAction writes the audit row with throwing logAudit after the stamps, outside its try (kasa/actions.ts:72-96 vs 100-107). TillConsole awaits the action inside startTransition with no catch in both submit (till-console.tsx:82-86) and onScan (64-80); React shows the nearest error boundary for a throw in a transition, i.e. app/admin/error.tsx 'Bu ekran yüklenemedi.'. lib/admin/audit.ts:105-114 documents that logAudit after an irreversible write must be safeAudit for this exact reason.
impact: An audit insert failure or a dropped Wi-Fi request after the write tells the cashier the screen failed although the stamps were given; the cashier retries (and on the e-mail path stamps twice, see ORD-13).
verdict_note: kasa/actions.ts:100-107 calls throwing logAudit after redeemCounterToken has burned the token and written the stamps, outside the try at 73-96. till-console.tsx awaits the action inside startTransition with no catch in onScan (64-80) and submit (82-86). React 19 rethrows to app/admin/error.tsx ('Bu ekran yüklenemedi.'). A network drop after the write does the same. audit.ts:105-114 says to use safeAudit here. Related: ORD-M02. Same throwing-logAudit root cause as ORD-28.
fix: Use safeAudit in kasa/actions.ts. Wrap both startTransition bodies in try/catch (unstable_rethrow not needed client-side) and show 'Damga verilmiş olabilir, üyenin kartını kontrol et.' On the QR path mark the scanned value as consumed so it is not re-offered.
fix_original: Use safeAudit; wrap both calls in try/catch and show 'Damga verilmiş olabilir, üyenin kartını kontrol et.' instead of throwing.
root_cause_fix: safeAudit after a write that already landed (kasa, customer stamps, logout, settings ok()).

title: Kasa says 'Damga verilemedi. Tekrar dene.' after the token was burned and stamps were written
evidence: redeemCounterToken burns the token (counter.ts:515), then inserts the stamps one by one (`for (i < stamps) await addCounterStamp`, 532-534; each is a separate insert plus giveMilestones, loyalty.ts:844-866), then re-reads getLoyalty/getCustomerByEmail (536-539). Any throw in that stretch reaches the action's catch (kasa/actions.ts:92-96), which answers MSG.failed 'Damga verilemedi. Tekrar dene.' or MSG.dbDown. Some or all stamps have already landed.
impact: On the QR/code path the member got fewer stamps than chosen and the retry answers 'already used'. On the e-mail path the retry stamps again (free drinks, see ORD-13). Stamps category. Same family as ORD-12.
fix: In redeemCounterToken, catch errors after the burn and return a distinct outcome (e.g. ok:false, reason 'partial', with how many stamps were written). Or in redeemCounterTokenAction answer 'Damga verilmiş olabilir, üyenin kartını kontrol et.' for any error once the token was burned or a stamp written. Admin-only code, so no mobile API change.
root_cause_fix: safeAudit after a write that already landed (kasa, customer stamps, logout, settings ok()).

title: Dashboard card under-counts 'bir işlem bekliyor' vs the Dikkat tab
evidence: readKaraoke loads today's rows plus listKaraokeRefundsOwed only; the card's attention set is built from those, while the Dikkat tab counts attention on any day. Harness with identical fixtures: card '4 rezervasyon bir işlem bekliyor', list tab 'Dikkat 5' (missing: tomorrow's venue_request). By code also missed: paid_unconfirmed_past from yesterday (paid, never confirmed, money still held), confirm_pending/slot_lost on other days, hold_overdue on other days.
impact: The dashboard reports less work than the karaoke page; a paid-but-never-confirmed evening from yesterday never reaches the dashboard.
verdict_note: Confirmed. admin/page.tsx:41-55 readKaraoke loads listReservationsForDate(today) and listKaraokeRefundsOwed, which returns only paymentStatus='refunding' rows and cancelled+paid rows (lib/mobile/karaoke.ts:652-669). The card's attention set is built only from those (karaoke-today-card.tsx:53-56). karaokeAttention (lib/admin/karaoke-panel.ts:333-361) also flags paid+requested rows on any day (paid_unconfirmed_past, slot_lost, confirm_pending), venue_request on future days and hold_overdue, and the Dikkat tab counts those (inKaraokeTab 'dikkat'). The card's docstring promises 'anything that waits for a person'.
fix: Add one targeted query in lib/mobile/karaoke.ts for the attention set: status requested with paymentStatus paid (any day), requested+none from today, pending past paymentDueAt, refunding, cancelled+paid. Use it in app/admin/page.tsx. Do not reuse karaokeList, which reads up to 5000 rows, on the dashboard.
fix_original: One attention query (requested+paid any day, requested+none from today, pending past due, refunding, cancelled+paid) shared by the card and the tab, or reuse karaokeList(...).counts.dikkat.

subtasks.what: dashboard readKaraoke switches to the new attention query

title: Member edit form can switch commercial consent ON and keeps a withdrawn consent date
evidence: CustomerForm offers "Kampanya / pazarlama" and "Bülten" checkboxes; adminUpdateCustomer writes notificationPrefs only, never marketingConsentAt (store.ts:1256-1267), and appends a consent-ledger row {granted:true, source:"admin", textVersion: COMMERCIAL_CONSENT_TEXT_VERSION} (consent-ledger.ts:129-137). The member's own opt-out clears marketingConsentAt (store.ts:1150-1154); the panel's does not, so OFF then ON from the panel puts the member back into the marketing and birthday mail audiences with the old consent date (they only require pref + marketingConsentAt <> '': db/schema.sql:3697-3700, 3755). The app inbox shows campaign items whenever prefs.marketing !== false (lib/mobile/notifications.ts:350-355). The newsletter screen removed its "Aktifleştir" for exactly this reason (bulten/actions.ts:17-22; newsletter/store.ts:320-325).
impact: The panel can manufacture or revive commercial-message consent (6563/KVKK); the ledger records an admin "grant" stamped with the consent text version; the member page shows "Açık" with no consent date behind it.
verdict_note: Confirmed. adminUpdateCustomer (src/lib/customer/store.ts:1249-1283) writes notificationPrefs only and never marketingConsentAt. It then appends ledger rows with source 'admin' (consent-ledger.ts:129-137); grants carry COMMERCIAL_CONSENT_TEXT_VERSION. The member's own path, updateNotificationPrefs (store.ts:1136-1170), stamps the date on opt-in and clears it on opt-out. So panel OFF then panel ON puts the member back in the e-mail audiences with the old date: db/schema.sql:1837, 1919, 3699 and 3755 only need pref + marketingConsentAt <> ''. A panel ON for someone who never consented gives no e-mail (empty date), but the app inbox shows campaign rows because notifications.ts:352 only checks prefs.marketing === false. Legal-adjacent, so medium is fine; a legal review is needed.
fix: Server side in updateCustomerAction / adminUpdateCustomer: refuse or ignore a false->true change for marketing and newsletter (the action is a POST endpoint, so disabling the checkbox alone is not enough). When the panel turns marketing off, set marketingConsentAt = ''. Keep the appendConsentChanges call with source 'admin', because tests/consent-ledger.test.ts finds writers by source. Do NOT route through updateNotificationPrefs: it would stamp a new consent date on a panel opt-in. Show the consent date on the member page, and list the legal implication in the PR.
fix_original: Make marketing/newsletter OFF-only in the panel (as on /admin/bulten), clear marketingConsentAt when the panel turns marketing off, show consent date/source on the member page; legal review.

title: Promo amounts have no ceiling; huge values crash the save to the error page
evidence: valueFixed and minSubtotal go through parseMoneyInput with no upper bound; superRefine checks only > 0; usageLimit is any parseInt >= 0. Columns are integer (db/schema.sql:146-148). audit/people/money-check.mjs: "25.000.000" → 2.500.000.000 kuruş > 2.147.483.647 (Postgres 22003); store check() throws (store.ts:539-544); createPromoAction has no try/catch and PromoForm uses bare useActionState → admin error boundary. The member coupon grant has a 2.000 TL fat-finger cap (musteriler/actions.ts:149, 193-197); promos none. applyPromoCode discount = Math.min(promo.value, subtotalMinor) (store.ts:5727).
impact: "5000" typed for "50" makes every basket up to 5.000 TL free for anyone using the public code; a very large number discards the form and shows "Bu ekran yüklenemedi".
verdict_note: Confirmed. promo-schema.ts:8-23 and 40-62 put no upper bound on valueFixed, minSubtotal or usageLimit (parseInt of any size). The promos columns are integer (db/schema.sql:146-148). createPromo/updatePromo call check() (store.ts:539-544, 5618, 5654), which throws through createPromoAction/updatePromoAction (no try/catch) and bare useActionState to admin/error.tsx. applyPromoCode uses Math.min(promo.value, subtotalMinor) (store.ts:5727). The fat-finger cap exists only for member coupons (musteriler/actions.ts:149,193). Medium stands: a 100% pct code is already allowed on purpose, so the cap is defence in depth. Same family as PEO-M02.
fix: In promoFormSchema.superRefine add: valueFixed <= a ceiling (reuse FIXED_COUPON_MAX_MAJOR*100 or a named PROMO cap), minSubtotalMinor <= CATALOG_MONEY_MAX_MINOR (format.ts:83), and usageLimit <= 1_000_000, each with a field error. Wrap the store calls in try/catch and answer {error}, or move to runPanelAction.
fix_original: Cap fixed value / min subtotal / usage limit in promoFormSchema with field errors (e.g. same 2.000 TL guard); catch store errors and answer actionError (or runPanelAction).

title: Owner cannot see or reset another user's 2FA; deleting a user keeps the old authenticator
evidence: The only 2FA switch-off is disable2FAAction on the signed-in user's own address (2fa-kurulum/actions.ts:54-72 → disable2FA(session.email)). AdminUserRow shows no 2FA state and no reset. deleteAdminUser deletes only admin_users; admin_2fa (db/schema.sql:926-932) is keyed by e-mail with no FK, so the row stays; login demands the code whenever has2FA(email) (auth.ts:334). A re-created account with the same e-mail inherits the lost secret; "Parolayı sıfırla" does not help.
impact: A cashier/manager who loses or changes their phone is locked out; recovery needs a SQL console. Deleted accounts leave TOTP secrets behind.
verdict_note: Confirmed. disable2FA is only reached from 2fa-kurulum/actions.ts, for the signed-in user. deleteAdminUser (lib/admin/users.ts:297-307) deletes admin_users only. admin_2fa (db/schema.sql:926-932) is keyed by e-mail with no FK. Login checks has2FA(matched.email) (auth.ts:334), so a re-created account inherits the old secret. AdminUserRow (user-forms.tsx:134-225) shows no 2FA state.
fix: Add an owner-only reset2FAAction: requireRole('adminUsers'), disable2FA(email), logAudit with no secret in the payload. Expose it as a ConfirmButton on AdminUserRow next to a '2FA açık/kapalı' badge (pass has2FA from the page). Call disable2FA(needle) in deleteAdminUser after the row delete.
fix_original: Show "2FA açık/kapalı" per row and an owner-only "2FA'yı sıfırla" ConfirmButton (requireRole("adminUsers"), audit row, disable2FA(email)); delete the admin_2fa row in deleteAdminUser.
root_cause_fix: Owner-only audited reset2FAAction + 2FA badge on users; deleteAdminUser drops the 2FA row; shell-access fixes the 2FA page copy.

title: Mass commercial e-mail sent behind window.confirm; the list page drops the send result
evidence: CampaignSendForm confirms with `confirm(confirmText)` (55) instead of the kit's ActionModal/ConfirmButton with confirmPhrase, which action-modal.tsx:95-99 prescribes for actions that "touch many records". On the list page the form renders only while `sendable` (`{sendable && <CampaignSendForm …/>}`); queueCampaignEmail flips the row to "queued" in the same request (lib/email/campaigns.ts:704-742), so the revalidated row no longer renders the form and its useActionState message ("N adres kuyruğa alındı…" or "Kitle boş … 0 alıcıyla Gönderildi olarak kapanır", kampanya/actions.ts:332-342) unmounts unseen. Draft "Sil" is a native confirm with no answer at all.
impact: One OK on a browser dialog sends a commercial e-mail to hundreds of people; afterwards the list says nothing (no toast), and an empty audience closing as "Gönderildi" is never explained.
verdict_note: Confirmed. campaign-mail-controls.tsx:52-56 uses a native confirm(). On the list page the form renders only when canSendCampaign (draft|failed; kampanya/page.tsx:120, campaign-status.tsx:27-29). queueCampaignEmail moves the row to queued in the same request and the action revalidates LIST_PATH (actions.ts:330), so the form and its message ('N adres kuyruğa alındı…', or 'Kitle boş … 0 alıcıyla Gönderildi') unmount unseen. On the detail page the message survives: the form stays mounted while resumable ([id]/page.tsx:211). Draft 'Sil' (DeleteRowForm, delete-row-form.tsx:23-25) has a native confirm and answers nothing.
fix: Replace CampaignSendForm with ConfirmButton/ActionModal: recipient count in the description and confirmPhrase (for example the count or 'GÖNDER'). Have sendCampaignMailAction/deleteCampaignMailAction answer ActionResult so the toast (ToastProvider in the layout) survives the unmount. Update tests/admin-campaign-mail-actions.test.ts for the new return shape.
fix_original: ConfirmButton/ActionModal with the recipient count in the description and a typed confirmPhrase; actions answer ActionResult so the toast survives the unmount; same for draft delete.

title: Field errors look like grey help text and nothing is announced
evidence: Field errors are passed through Field's `hint` → `<span className="text-xs text-[var(--admin-text-mute)]">` (forms.tsx:23-25): same grey 12 px as help text, #8A7A64 on white = 4.16:1 (< 4.5:1). Only name and code get aria-invalid; no aria-describedby. No role="alert" on form error boxes or result lines (customer-form.tsx:90-94, promo-form.tsx:146-150, customer-coupons.tsx:153-156, customer-stamps.tsx:82-85, customer-actions.tsx:70-75, campaign-mail-controls.tsx:20-26, campaign-mail-form.tsx:236-245). Focus is not moved to the first bad field (ActionForm does, action-form.tsx:253-263).
impact: The operator reads "Formdaki uyarıları gider." but the warning under the field is indistinguishable from the hint it replaced (and with PEO-02 the field shows the old value); screen-reader users hear nothing after submit.
verdict_note: Confirmed. Field errors go through Field's hint span `text-xs text-[var(--admin-text-mute)]` (forms.tsx:23-25): 4.16:1 on white and the same look as help text. Only name (customer-form.tsx:45) and code (promo-form.tsx:52) get aria-invalid; there is no aria-describedby. There is no role=alert at customer-form.tsx:90-94, promo-form.tsx:146-150, customer-coupons.tsx:153-156, customer-stamps.tsx:82-85, customer-actions.tsx:70-75, campaign-mail-controls.tsx:20-26 or campaign-mail-form.tsx:241-245. (user-forms Notice does have role=alert.) Same root cause as PEO-02/16 (A) and PEO-11 (C).
fix: Merge with PEO-02: move to ActionForm + FormFieldError (danger ink, role=alert, markFieldErrors focus) + FormMessage. Until then, give the error boxes role="alert" and render field errors in --admin-danger-ink instead of the hint.
fix_original: Switch to ActionForm + FormFieldError (danger-ink, role=alert, markFieldErrors) + FormMessage.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Role help text understates what Yönetici and Personel can do
evidence: "Yönetici katalog, içerik ve siparişleri yönetir · Personel sipariş, stok ve kasayı görür" vs SECTION_ROLES (lib/admin/roles.ts): manager also has refunds, customers (all member personal data + "Hesabı sil"), newsletter and campaign sending, promos, reports, tables, karaoke, mobileApp; staff also karaoke and the dashboard.
impact: The owner picks a role from this sentence; giving "Yönetici" for the catalog also gives refunds, member deletion and mass e-mail.
verdict_note: Confirmed. kullanicilar/page.tsx:67-74 says Yönetici manages 'katalog, içerik ve siparişleri' and Personel sees 'sipariş, stok ve kasa'. SECTION_ROLES (lib/admin/roles.ts:55-90) also gives manager refunds, customers (member PII and Hesabı sil), newsletter/campaign sending, promos, reports, tables, karaoke and mobileApp, and gives staff karaoke and dashboard. Raised to medium: this is the text the owner picks roles from, and it hides refunds, member deletion and mass e-mail (roles/PII).
fix: Generate the per-role section list from sectionsFor(role) (roles.ts:100) with Turkish section labels, or show a small permission matrix under the role select.
fix_original: Generate the per-role section list from SECTION_ROLES, or show a small permission matrix under the role select.

title: Closed member accounts reappear in Müşteriler with their real name and phone, while 'Hesabı sil' says orders stay 'anonim'
evidence: deleteMe rewrites customers.email to deleted-<id>@anon.local and blanks name and phone (me.ts:597-630). The orders sweep only patches customerEmail (me.ts ANON_SWEEPS: `patch: (anon) => ({ customerEmail: anon })`), so customerName and customerPhone stay on the orders, which is fiscal retention. summarizeCustomers skips only 'guest@laffogato.local' (store.ts:1598). The list merges the anonymised member row with the order roll-up under the same placeholder key and fills the blank name and phone from the orders (musteriler/page.tsx:91-93). The closed account is therefore listed as Üye/Pasif with the person's real name and phone, and a name search finds it. The modal promises 'Ad, telefon, adresler ve e-posta silinir. Siparişler muhasebe için anonim olarak kalır.' (customer-actions.tsx:119-121), but the orders are not anonymous.
impact: The CRM keeps showing a deleted member's identity to every owner/manager. The deletion copy misstates what is kept, which is a KVKK/purpose-limitation and truthfulness risk.
fix: Leave `%@anon.local` placeholders out of the Müşteriler roll-up and merge (or show them as 'Kapatılmış hesap' without name or phone). Correct the Hesabı sil copy to say orders keep the invoice name/address for fiscal retention. Do not scrub order names without a lawyer (fiscal retention); list the legal-text implication in the PR.

title: No way back in after losing the authenticator; the page's own advice is impossible
evidence: Copy says 'Telefonunu kaybedersen önce bu sekmeden 2FA'yı kapat, sonra yeniden kur.' but disable2FAAction requires a current code from that phone (actions.ts:67) and so does sign-in (auth.ts:334-343, complete2FA). grep: disable2FA is called only from that action; there are no recovery codes and /admin/kullanicilar has no reset-2FA action. has2FA is keyed by e-mail, so an env break-glass owner who enrolled is locked out the same way.
impact: A staff member or the owner who loses or replaces the phone is locked out of the panel; only a manual database edit restores access.
verdict_note: The copy at 2fa-kurulum/page.tsx:40-44 tells the user to turn 2FA off first if the phone is lost. disable2FAAction needs a current code (actions.ts:67), and so does sign-in (auth.ts:333-343, complete2FA). disable2FA is only called at actions.ts:72. kullanicilar/actions.ts has no 2FA reset (its exports are create, save, resetPassword, delete, grant/revokeBarista), and there are no recovery codes. admin_2fa is keyed by e-mail, so an env break-glass owner who enrolled is locked out the same way. Only a database edit helps.
fix: Add an owner-only, audited reset2FAAction in src/app/admin/kullanicilar/actions.ts (requireRole('adminUsers'), disable2FA(email), logAudit '2fa_disable' with the actor), with a button in user-forms.tsx and a confirm. Fix the copy on 2fa-kurulum/page.tsx:40-44. Recovery codes need a schema change; do them later. Document the single-owner DB runbook in docs.
fix_original: Issue recovery codes at enrolment and add an owner-only, audited '2FA'yı sıfırla' action on /admin/kullanicilar (app/admin/kullanicilar/actions.ts + user-forms.tsx); rewrite the copy on 2fa-kurulum/page.tsx.
root_cause_fix: Owner-only audited reset2FAAction + 2FA badge on users; deleteAdminUser drops the 2FA row; shell-access fixes the 2FA page copy.

subtasks.what: fix the impossible advice on 2fa-kurulum/page.tsx:40-44; DB runbook in docs

title: Member page is wider than a 390 px phone for almost any e-mail; cards and the verification badge are clipped
evidence: Profil → KV "E-posta" renders `{email}✓ Doğrulanmış` inside `grid grid-cols-[90px_1fr] gap-2`. The unbreakable e-mail + badge set the 1fr track's minimum, and the page grid (`grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]`, one auto column on phones) widens with every card in it (Profil, Adresler, Favoriler, aside Yönetim/Sadakat/Kuponlar/Davetler). Replica with the real compiled globals.css + Poppins at 390×844 (audit/people/visual/people.html): card right edge 374 px for ali@gmail.com (fits), 403 for ali.kaya@gmail.com, 444 for zeynep.demir@gmail.com, 478 for ayse.yilmaz.1990@hotmail.com, 525 for a 33-char address; screenshot visual/shot-s1-profile-overflow-390.jpg shows "✓ DOĞ…" cut at the edge. Also a guest without a name gets the e-mail as h1 (143,149): 33-char address = 390 px text in a 358 px column.
impact: On a phone the whole member page (including Hesabı sil, +1 damga, Kupon tanımla) is wider than the screen; body overflow-x:hidden clips the right side or the page zooms out; the verification badge is cut off.
verdict_note: Confirmed by cascade reasoning on cf30307. KV is `grid grid-cols-[90px_1fr]` ([email]/page.tsx:551), and `1fr` has an auto (min-content) minimum. The value at :203-214 is `inline-flex items-center gap-2` holding an unbreakable e-mail plus the badge, so the track minimum is e-mail + gap + badge. Every ancestor between there and main is a grid with an auto minimum: Card, then `grid gap-4` (:197), then the page grid `grid gap-4 lg:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr]` (:196, one auto column on phones). Nothing sets min-w-0 or overflow, so the column grows past main's px-4 box. Body overflow-x:hidden (globals.css:250) clips the right side. The 'Davet eden' KV (:304-315) also prints a bare e-mail and hits the same overflow. Severity lowered: buttons are widened and partly clipped but still tappable, so it is not 'cannot use'.
fix: In KV (page.tsx:551) use `grid-cols-[90px_minmax(0,1fr)]` and give the value span `min-w-0 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]`. Make the e-mail wrapper (:203) `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2` so the badge drops under it. Optionally add `break-words` to the PageHeader h1 (forms.tsx:155) for guests whose title is the e-mail.
fix_original: In KV use `grid-cols-[90px_minmax(0,1fr)]`, make the e-mail wrapper `flex flex-wrap` with `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]` so the badge wraps below; add break-words to PageHeader h1 (components/admin/forms.tsx:155).

title: Customer search misses Turkish names starting with İ (toLowerCase without locale)
evidence: `const q = (sp.q ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();` and `c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)`. "İsmail".toLowerCase() is "i̇smail" (i + U+0307, 7 code units). node: "İsmail Yılmaz" with query "ismail" → false (toLocaleLowerCase("tr-TR") → true); query "İSMAİL" → false too. The box echoes the lowercased query (defaultValue={q}).
impact: Typing ismail / ibrahim / irem / ilker finds nobody and shows "Bu filtreyle müşteri bulunamadı."; very common Turkish names cannot be found from a phone keyboard.
verdict_note: Confirmed in node. musteriler/page.tsx:55 `q = (sp.q ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()`; :118-120 `c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)`. Results: 'İsmail Yılmaz' with query 'ismail' -> false, with 'İSMAİL' -> false, and with toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR') on both sides -> true. :161 echoes the lowercased q into the box.
fix: Fold both sides with one helper: toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR'), then strip U+0307 and map ı->i. Keep the raw sp.q for defaultValue. If PEO-13 moves search into SQL, Postgres lower()/ILIKE does not fold İ/ı either, so the fold has to happen there too (for example translate() on both sides).
fix_original: Fold both sides with toLocaleLowerCase("tr-TR") and strip U+0307 (or fold I/İ/ı/i to one letter); keep the raw query for the input value.
root_cause_fix: lib/admin/text-fold.ts foldTr(): toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR'), strip U+0307, map ı->i; SQL side uses translate() on both sides. Used by customers, products, global search.

title: Customer list loads and renders every customer, twice, with a hand-rolled form instead of the kit list
evidence: listAllCustomers (select *, no limit: lib/customer/store.ts:1221-1229) + listCustomers (every order: lib/admin/store.ts:1564-1577) are merged and the whole list is written into both the phone <ul> (229) and the desktop <table> (279). No Pagination, no DataTable, raw GET <form> (150) without FilterBar chips, sort only via a select (no sortable headers), no export, no bulk actions. Tiles mix scopes: "Üye hesap" = all members (130), the other three use the filtered list (131-132, 144-146).
impact: With a few thousand members the page is slow and heavy (every row twice in the HTML) and one endless scroll; with a filter on, the tiles contradict each other.
verdict_note: Confirmed. listAllCustomers is select * with no limit (customer/store.ts:1221-1229). The client is pg (lib/db/index.ts), so there is no PostgREST row cap. listCustomers reads every order (admin/store.ts:1564-1577). The full list renders twice: phone ul at :229 and desktop table at :279. Tile scope is mixed: memberCount = members.length (:130), while :131-132 and :144 use the filtered list. Root cause E (no kit list), shared with PEO-14/15/24.
fix: Rebuild on the kit like /admin/siparisler: server-side search/filter/sort with paging (and the tr fold from PEO-05), DataTable with mobileCard, StatusTabs with counts, Pagination; all tiles in one scope.
fix_original: Rebuild on the kit like /admin/siparisler: server-side search/filter/sort with paging, DataTable + mobileCard, FilterBar, StatusTabs (Hepsi/Üye/Misafir/Pasif/Doğrulanmamış with counts), Pagination; consistent tile scope.

evidence: `<div className="sticky bottom-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">` holds the submit, a `rounded-full bg-red-50` result pill and the footnote, with no background. Replica at 390×844 with an error shown (visual/people-rest.html): bar 190 px tall (638-828 of 844); elementsFromPoint under the footnote = footnote → bar → form card; visual/shot-s7-sticky-bar-overlap-390.jpg shows the "Buton yazısı" label/field hidden behind button + pill and the footnote printed across the next card heading; the 3-line error sits in a pill (radius 1.67e7 px).

verdict_note: Confirmed. campaign-mail-form.tsx:232-250 is `<div className="sticky bottom-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">` with no background, holding the submit, rounded-full result pills and the footnote. Content scrolls visibly under the loose text on every width. It matters most on a phone, where the bar wraps to several lines.

title: Deleting the last product, menu item, hero slide or category is undone on the next cold start, and id counters are reset
evidence: ensureSeed and ensureShopHeroSeed are memoized per server process (memoizeUntilRejected) and seed any table that is empty at the first read. That happens on every Vercel cold start or deploy, not once per database. The seed re-inserts 11 demo products (stock 25, bundled prices, active), the full printed menu and 2 demo slides ('500₺ üzeri ücretsiz kargo, İstanbul içi aynı gün', CTA 'Edible Cups'). setCounter then overwrites the prd, cat and mnu counters with the seed size (555-561), so the next new row reuses an id that a deleted row had (slugifyId, 572-574). restock_order_lines credits stock by items[].productId (db/schema.sql:4850+), so old orders then point at the new product.
impact: The delete dialogs say 'kalıcı olarak silinir' (products-list.tsx:435, menu-list.tsx:412, magaza-hero/page.tsx:107). Yet after removing all hero slides or clearing the demo catalogue, the next deploy brings sellable demo products and a wrong shipping promise back to the live shop. Reused ids cross-wire old orders and stock moves to new products.
verdict_note: store.ts:674-680, 723 and 770: ensureSeed is memoizeUntilRejected (db/health.ts:79-92), so it runs once per server process and seeds any table that is empty at that moment. setCounter (store.ts:555-561) upserts seq = seed size, so a later nextSeq reuses old ids (slugifyId :572-574). The hero seed ensureShopHeroSeed (store.ts:6202-6215) re-inserts the 2 demo slides when the table is empty. This needs a completely empty table: realistic for hero slides (operator removes both), rare for products and menu. Downgraded from high: it is conditional, though resurrected demo products would be sellable.
fix: Gate each seed on a one-time marker written by the first seed (for example a counters/settings row such as seeded_products), not on countRows()==0. Make setCounter never lower a counter (seq = greatest(seq, n), via SQL or by reading first). Keep the products seed out of production entirely, as SEED_DEMO_ORDERS already does for orders.
fix_original: Seed only when a one-time marker (a flag in counters or settings, or a migration) says the database has never been seeded, never because a table is empty. Never lower a counter: use seq = greatest(seq, n).
root_cause_fix: Seeds gated by a one-time marker, never by countRows()==0; setCounter never lowers; products/menu/category seed never runs in production.

title: Product form errors look like help text and are not announced
evidence: Server field errors replace the field hint and use the same style. Measured in Chrome (#urunler-duzenle): the price error is rgb(138,122,100), 12px, with no role and no aria-invalid. That colour is 4.16:1 on white and fails AA. Only the name field sets aria-invalid (line 301). The form-level error sits in the footer at 10px, uppercase, letter-spacing 2.2px, in neutral-500 grey. In wizard mode, errors on steps 1-4 are only visible after navigating to that step, and the step pills do not mark them.
impact: The operator cannot tell which field failed, screen readers announce nothing, and in the wizard the step that holds the error is not shown.
verdict_note: product-wizard.tsx:292-294 and others use hint={fieldError(...) ?? hint}. Field renders the hint in a 12px span with text-[var(--admin-text-mute)] (forms.tsx:23-25): 4.16:1 on the white Card, no role. Only name sets aria-invalid (:301). In tabs mode the form error sits in a 10px uppercase neutral-500 div (:1011-1018). In wizard mode it shows only on step 5 (:907-911), and the step pills do not mark the steps that hold errors. Shares RC-A (no ActionForm) and RC-C (mute token).
fix: Render a FormFieldError-style p with danger ink, role=alert and an id under each Field, plus aria-invalid and aria-describedby (markFieldErrors from action-form.tsx can be reused after each state change). Move the form error above the footer with role=alert, and in wizard mode jump to the first step with an error. Best done in the same change as CAT-01.
fix_original: Reuse FormFieldError and FormMessage (danger ink, role=alert, markFieldErrors and focus). Show the form error above the footer, and jump to and mark the first step that has an error.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Variant stock is invisible and is not kept in step with product stock
evidence: The list, its badges and the Stok page show and adjust only products.stock; adjust_product_stock touches the product only. The wizard says 'Her varyantın kendi stoğu ... olur', yet the product stock field defaults to 0. The order pre-check reads only the variant's stock (store.ts:1915), while claim_order_stock requires both the product stock and the variant stock to be at least the quantity (schema.sql:296, 301).
impact: A variant product entered with only variant stocks shows 'Stoksuz' and its order fails at checkout after the pre-check has passed. The list can show '9 stok' while a size is sold out. Staff cannot correct a variant's stock.
verdict_note: store.ts:1914-1916: the order pre-check uses variant.stock only. claim_order_stock (db/schema.sql:285-305) needs products.stock >= qty AND the variant stock >= qty, and decrements both. The wizard says each variant has its own stock (product-wizard.tsx:530-533) while product stock defaults to 0 (:179). The list and Stok (adjust_product_stock) show and adjust products.stock only. A variant-only stock entry therefore shows 'Stoksuz' and fails at claim. No money is taken: the claim fails before payment. RC-E with CAT-03.
fix: Pick one model. Either derive products.stock = sum of active variant stock on save (server-side in updateProduct/createProduct) and show per-variant stock in the list, or validate that they agree. Extend Stok with variant adjustments through an atomic SQL function plus a stock move. Coordinate with the CAT-03 fix.
fix_original: Show per-variant stock in the list. Derive product stock from the variants, or validate that they agree. Allow variant adjustments with stock moves on the Stok page.
