title: Tapping the 'Alerjen' hint or eyebrow toggles the nut-allergen box, which drives the customer warning
evidence: The Field (a <label>) wraps a grid whose only Checkbox is ALLERGEN_OPTIONS[0] = nuts (59-61). A label with no for attribute activates its first labelable descendant, so a tap on the hint 'Ürün içeriyorsa işaretle. Ürün sayfasında ve sepette uyarı olarak görünür - gizlenmez.' or on the ALERJEN eyebrow fires onChange on the nuts checkbox (404-411). The same mechanism was confirmed in Chrome for the shop switch (SYS-05). CON-05 lists product-wizard.tsx:386 but not this block.
impact: An operator reading the hint on a phone can silently untick the nut allergen. After Kaydet, the product page and cart drop the nut warning: a food-safety risk for allergic customers.
fix: Render this Field as fieldset/legend, the same R-LABEL fix as SYS-05 and CON-05. Do not change Field to a div panel-wide.
root_cause_fix: forms.tsx gets a fieldset/legend variant of Field for groups that hold checkboxes or uploaders; Field itself stays a <label> (inputs keep their names).

title: Product page prints hard-coded allergen, brand, warranty, origin and tasting-note rows per category, ignoring what the operator entered
evidence: DetailGrid adds fixed rows by p.cat. Every 'gift' gets 'Alerjenler: Gluten · süt · soya izi' and 'Saklama: Kuru, serin · 90 gün'. Every 'gear' gets 'Marka: Bialetti × L'Affogato' and 'Garanti: 2 yıl'. Every 'beans' gets 'Köken: Brezilya doğal + Etiyopya yıkanmış' and 'Tat notları: Kakao · kuru incir · esmer şeker'. The admin's 'Marka' (brand) and 'Tat notları' (notes) fields are never read on the web; grep finds no brand or notes in product-detail.tsx. The same 'Ürün detayları' accordion (:321, defaultOpen) sits under a hard-coded '500₺ üzeri ücretsiz kargo' (:313), although the threshold is the editable setting shippingFreeThresholdMinor (/admin/ayarlar, commerce.ts:22-34).
impact: Customers see allergen claims, a brand and a 2-year warranty that may be false for the actual product, and tasting notes that contradict the ones the operator typed. A changed free-shipping threshold is still advertised as 500₺. Warranty, allergen and price-promise statements have consumer-law weight.
fix: Build DetailGrid from product data. SKU, weight and the nuts allergen are already per product. Use p.brand and p.notes when set, and drop the hard-coded Köken, Tat notları, Marka, Garanti and Alerjenler rows, or move them into real per-product fields. Pass the free-shipping threshold from settings into the PDP (formatTRY), or hide the line when the threshold is 0. List it for lawyer review in the PR (warranty and allergen wording).

title: The Kategoriler section changes nothing on the storefront, and '+ Yeni kategori' can only duplicate an existing slug
evidence: listCategories() is called only by admin pages and actions; a grep outside src/app/admin finds no other caller. The shop sidebar uses the constant CATS, /magaza/[kategori] uses SHOP_CATEGORY_ROUTES (seo/pages.ts:320), and the mobile shop feed carries no category labels. Slugs are a fixed set of five, all seeded (store.ts:723-760), and createCategoryAction does not refuse an existing slug. A new category is therefore always a duplicate. Duplicates feed key={c.slug} selects (product-wizard.tsx:379-383, products-list.tsx:387-391, urunler/page.tsx:122-126).
impact: The page copy says it controls 'Mağaza filtre kenar çubuğu' and that a delete removes the category from the shop filter. In practice, label, icon and order edits show a 'kaydedildi' toast and never reach the shop, so the operator believes the shop changed when it did not.
verdict_note: grep finds listCategories only under src/app/admin (kategoriler, urunler pages and actions). shop-page.tsx:32-39 hard-codes CATS, and /magaza/[kategori] uses SHOP_CATEGORY_ROUTES. createCategoryAction (kategoriler/actions.ts:57-74) never checks for an existing slug, and categories.slug has no unique index (db/schema.sql:78-84). The copy at kategoriler/page.tsx:43 and :118 and yeni/page.tsx:16 claims the page controls the shop filter.
fix: Short term: refuse a duplicate slug in createCategoryAction under 'slug', and rewrite the copy to say these are panel labels. Optional: feed listCategories() into the shop sidebar labels and order. Note SHOP_CATEGORY_ROUTES and SEO pages are fixed, so hiding a category would need care.
fix_original: Either feed listCategories() into the shop sidebar (label, icon, order, hiding), or turn the page into panel-only labels without create or delete, with honest copy. Refuse duplicate slugs in createCategoryAction.

title: Menu tags are free text, but the app only knows signature/new/iced/nuts, so an allergen typed another way disappears
evidence: The 'Etiketler' field is free text (hint 'Örn: signature, new, iced, nuts, IGP'), and the server keeps any lowercased word. docs/API-MOBILE.md:85 fixes the vocabulary to signature|new|iced|nuts, and the app's toTags drops anything else (lafmobil src/data/types.ts:52-66). The product form already uses a closed allergen list (product-wizard.tsx:59-61, product-schema.ts:43-75). The menu list shows the raw keys, uppercased under lang=tr, as 'SİGNATURE', 'NEW', 'NUTS' (screens/menu-390.jpg).
impact: 'fındık', 'nut' or the suggested 'IGP' are saved but never shown in the app, so an allergen warning can silently disappear. The list chips are English.
verdict_note: menu-item-form.tsx:153-162 is a free-text 'Etiketler' field with the hint 'Örn: signature, new, iced, nuts, IGP'. menu/actions.ts:104-108 keeps any lowercase word. docs/API-MOBILE.md:85 fixes the vocabulary to signature|new|iced|nuts, and product-schema.ts:56-70 already filters to it. The list shows raw keys uppercased (menu-list.tsx, chips at about :171-178 and :254-261).
fix: menu-item-form.tsx: four checkboxes (İmza, Yeni, Buzlu, Sert kabuklu yemiş) posting the same comma list. menu/actions.ts: filter through PRODUCT_TAG_VALUES, exporting a shared helper from product-schema. menu-list: show Turkish labels. The API output stays unchanged (additive-safe); docs/API-MOBILE.md does not change.
fix_original: Replace the field with checkboxes for the four tags, with Turkish labels (İmza, Yeni, Buzlu, Sert kabuklu yemiş). Filter the tags on the server the same way product-schema tagList does, and show the Turkish labels in the list.

title: On phones the photo grid clips the delete button of every non-primary photo
evidence: In a 2-column grid, each card is 156 px wide with overflow-hidden. The footer row holds ←, →, 'Birincil yap' and ×. 'Birincil yap' renders at 16px (declared 10px, the font: inherit issue), wraps to two lines and takes 112 px. Measured at 390 px (#urunler-duzenle-foto): the × button is squeezed to 10 px at x 376-387, while the card's right edge is at 357, so it is clipped (screens/urun-foto-grid-390.png).
impact: On a phone the operator cannot remove a secondary product photo.
verdict_note: image-upload.tsx:404-442: the footer is flex justify-between with ←, → and 'Birincil yap' (text-[10px] tracking-[0.16em] uppercase, but as a <button> it renders at the inherited 16px, RC-B) plus × (h-7 w-7). The 2-column grid card at 390px is about 156px wide with overflow-hidden. The min-content of 'BİRİNCİL' at 16px with tracking plus the arrows exceeds the inner width, so × is pushed out and clipped. Workaround: 'Birincil yap' first (the primary card has no such button), then ×. Medium rather than high because of the workaround. Same root cause as CAT-11.
fix: Fix RC-B (CAT-11). Then let the footer wrap (flex-wrap) or make 'Birincil yap' an icon button with aria-label 'Görsel N: birincil yap', and give × a fixed shrink-0 44px target.
fix_original: Apply the font fix from CAT-11, and either let the footer row wrap or make 'Birincil yap' an icon button with an aria-label. Give all buttons 44 px targets.
root_cause_fix: globals.css admin-root rule gains `font: revert-layer`; unlayered `[data-admin-root] :is(button:disabled,[aria-disabled=true])` gets cursor:not-allowed. No `cursor: revert-layer` (Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight has no button pointer).

title: Hero form: a double click creates two slides, and a blank title is ignored silently and wipes the form
evidence: The form is a plain <form action={serverAction}> with no pending state. createSlideAction returns nothing for a whitespace-only title (line 42), and updateSlideAction has no title check, so normalizeSlide trims the title to an empty string. Proof in Chrome (#hero-yeni): two clicks produced 2 action calls, and the button was never disabled. With title '   ', no message appeared, and React's form reset wiped CTA yazısı, CTA URL'si and Sıralama, switched the theme from dark to light and re-checked Aktif. On the live hero, an empty title renders a grey 'Başlık' placeholder (shop-hero-slider.tsx:209).
impact: A double click creates duplicate slides. 'Slaytı kaydet' looks dead and erases what was typed. An edit can publish a slide whose visible title is the placeholder 'Başlık'.
verdict_note: slide-form.tsx:131 is a bare `<form action={action}>`, and PrimaryButton at :330 is never disabled, so React starts one transition per click and creates 2 slides (createShopHeroSlide ids use Date.now()+random). The title is `required`, but '   ' passes. createSlideAction (actions.ts:42) returns undefined, and React's form reset restores ctaLabel/ctaHref/sortOrder (uncontrolled defaultValue), the textTheme select to its first option 'light' and isActive to defaultChecked. updateSlideAction (:56-72) has no title check, so normalizeSlide trims the title to ''. shop-hero-slider.tsx:209 then renders the 'Başlık' placeholder. RC-A.
fix: Change the actions to the (prev, formData) => ActionResult shape, refusing an empty trimmed title under 'title' on create and update. Render SlideForm inside ActionForm with FormFieldError and SubmitButton (pending-disabled). The page passes createSlideAction or updateSlideAction.bind(null, id) unchanged.
fix_original: Move to ActionForm with ActionResult, refuse an empty title under the field on both create and update, and use SubmitButton so the button is disabled while saving.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Staff receive every product's cost price through the Stok page
evidence: StockAdjustForm is a 'use client' component and receives products={listProducts()}, the full AdminProduct rows including costMinor, compareAtPriceMinor, images, variants and SEO fields. Next serializes all client props into the page payload. In roles.ts:69 and 87, the stock section includes staff, but products is limited to owner and manager. The wizard itself labels cost 'Müşteriye gizli; raporlama için'.
impact: A Personel account can read the purchase cost and margin of every product from the page source or the network tab.
verdict_note: stok-hareketleri/page.tsx:41-44 and :55 pass listProducts() rows (costMinor, compareAtPriceMinor, images as base64, variants, SEO) as props to the 'use client' StockAdjustForm (stock-adjust-form.tsx:1, 21). RSC serializes them into the payload. roles.ts: stock is owner/manager/staff and products is owner/manager. It is a role-gate data leak of commercial data, not customer PII, so it stays medium. Shared root cause RC-D with CAT-08.
fix: stok-hareketleri/page.tsx: map to {id, name, stock} before passing to StockAdjustForm, and change its prop type from AdminProduct[]. The filter select is server-rendered and only needs id and name.
fix_original: On the server, map products to {id, name, stock} before passing them to StockAdjustForm and to the filter select.

title: Catalog lists send every stored base64 photo to the browser
evidence: Photos are stored as data URLs of up to 2 MB each (image-encode.ts:38), up to 8 per product. ProductsList, MenuList and StockAdjustForm are client components that receive the full rows. The product list renders each first photo twice (mobile card and desktop row; measured 2 with the same data URL for 1 product) and once more in the flight data. MenuList receives every item's image but never displays it. The hero list inlines background-image:url(data:...). kategoriler reads every product, with photos, just to count them. The storefront already avoids this with servedImage/productImagePath (store.ts:5150-5156). There is no loading.tsx under src/app/admin.
impact: Page weight grows by megabytes with every uploaded photo. /admin/urunler and /admin/menu become slow on a phone, and nothing shows that a click was received while the page loads.
verdict_note: products-list.tsx:123 and :262: ProductThumb src={p.images?.[0]} (the data URL) in both the mobile and desktop markup, and the full rows are props of a client component. menu/page.tsx:43-47 passes full items to MenuList, which never renders image. magaza-hero/page.tsx:46-54 inlines url(data:...). kategoriler/page.tsx:25-36 loads all products only to count them (server-only cost). There is no loading.tsx under src/app/admin; find only returns odeme/(checkout)/loading.tsx. /gorsel/urun/[id]/[index] serves any product, inactive ones too, so a served thumbnail path works for the admin. RC-D.
fix: urunler/page.tsx and products-list.tsx: pass a list DTO with thumb = servedImage(images[0], productImagePath(id, 0, imageVersion(images[0]))) and no images, cost or SEO fields. menu/page.tsx: strip image from the MenuList props. magaza-hero/page.tsx: use heroImagePath. kategoriler: count only. Add src/app/admin/loading.tsx.
fix_original: Select only the list columns and pass a served thumbnail URL (reuse productImagePath/heroImagePath) instead of the data URL. Drop image from the menu list props. Add loading.tsx (shell).

title: No preview of a legal draft; 'Önizle ↗' on a 'Taslak' row opens the coded default
evidence: 'Önizle ↗' links to the public page (hukuk/page.tsx:61-67), which reads only getPublishedLegalOverride (src/app/hukuk/[slug]/page.tsx:52). The editor (components/admin/legal-doc-form.tsx) has no preview.
impact: For a draft, 'Önizle' shows the coded default, not the text being prepared; the owner can only see a new legal text by publishing it to customers.
verdict_note: 'Önizle ↗' (hukuk/page.tsx:61-67) opens /hukuk/<slug>, which reads only getPublishedLegalOverride (src/app/hukuk/[slug]/page.tsx:52). For a 'Taslak' row it therefore shows the coded default. legal-doc-form.tsx has no preview.
fix: Add an owner-only preview: either an editor tab rendering the textarea through the existing markdown renderer (lib/legal/markdown.tsx), or /admin/hukuk/<slug>/onizle reading the draft with requireRole('legal'). Label the list link 'Yayındakini aç' for drafts.
fix_original: Owner-only preview (editor tab rendering LegalMarkdown from the textarea, or /admin/hukuk/<slug>/onizle reading the draft); label the list link 'Yayındakini aç' for drafts.

title: Story, press and site texts are cut silently (no maxLength, server .slice); an empty press quote renders as “”
evidence: No maxLength on inputs (hikaye/page.tsx:37,41,47,102,106,112; basin/page.tsx:37,42,97,102; icerik/content-form.tsx:33-41) while the server slices: story year 12/title 120/body 500 (hikaye/actions.ts:19-33), press name 80/quote 300 (basin/actions.ts:19-30), site texts 2000 (lib/admin/site-content.ts:58); the success toast then shows the cut title. createPressAction requires only the name (basin/actions.ts:44-48) and the story page draws “{p.quote}” (story-page.tsx:385).
impact: A pasted 600-char period or 400-char quote is saved shorter with a success toast and the end is lost silently; a press entry without a quote shows empty quotation marks on /hikaye.
verdict_note: No maxLength at hikaye/page.tsx:37,41,47,102,106,112, basin/page.tsx:37,42,97,102 or content-form.tsx:33-41. The server slices silently: hikaye/actions.ts:19-33 (12/120/500), basin/actions.ts:19-30 (80/300), site-content.ts:58 (2000). The success toast then shows the cut title. createPressAction requires only the name (basin/actions.ts:44-48), so an empty quote renders as “” (story-page.tsx:385).
fix: Add maxLength on the inputs. Return actionError with fieldErrors for over-long values instead of .slice (these forms already use ActionForm and FormFieldError). Require the press quote.
fix_original: maxLength on the inputs plus a zod schema returning field errors instead of .slice; require the quote. Files: hikaye/page.tsx, hikaye/actions.ts, basin/page.tsx, basin/actions.ts, content-form.tsx.

title: Legal editor prefills 'Yürürlük tarihi' with the coded date, so a published override records the coded consent version
evidence: hukuk/[slug]/page.tsx:31 sets `effectiveDate: override?.effectiveDate || doc.updatedAt`. For the checkout documents (on-bilgilendirme-formu, mesafeli-satis-sozlesmesi have no own updatedAt in content.ts), doc.updatedAt is LEGAL_UPDATED = '16 Ekim 2026' (documents.ts:104, meta.ts:22). consentVersionFrom (consent-version.ts:108-118) moves the version only when the override's day is strictly greater than the base, and overrideLabel (86-90) prefers a parseable typed date over the save day. The same applies to the karaoke document (KARAOKE_LEGAL_UPDATED).
impact: An owner who publishes a rewritten Mesafeli Satış Sözleşmesi without touching the prefilled date makes every later order record legalConsent.version '16 Ekim 2026'. That is the same string as the coded text, so a chargeback or consumer dispute cannot tell which text the customer accepted, which is the API-13 failure the consent-version module was written to stop. Later edits of a published override also keep the old date, so the version never moves on a text change.
fix: For a new override, prefill effectiveDate blank so the save-day fallback applies, or prefill today's Istanbul day (istanbulDayLabel). When publishing a checkout or karaoke document whose body changed, refuse an effective date that is not later than the currently recorded version, with the message 'Metin değişti: yürürlük tarihini güncelle.'. Show in the editor which version orders will record. Files: hukuk/[slug]/page.tsx, hukuk/actions.ts, lib/admin/legal-schema.ts. Legal-text implication: lawyer review.

title: Slide / announcement / post forms: no pending state (double submit = duplicates), silent no-op, error page on failure
evidence: Plain <form action={serverAction}> with a bare PrimaryButton, no useFormStatus/disabled: slaytlar/slide-form.tsx:60,196-198; duyurular/announcement-form.tsx:44,122-124; gonderiler/post-form.tsx:88-101,268-270. React dispatches every submit without a pending guard (react-dom-client.development.js:19077-19104) and Next queues and runs each server action (node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-instance.js:108-166, no dedupe). Silent returns: slaytlar/actions.ts:52,71,75; duyurular/actions.ts:47,66,70; gonderiler/actions.ts:149,173,177 (whitespace-only title passes HTML required; row deleted meanwhile) and CON-03's reset then empties/reverts the form. No try/catch around createAppSlide/updateAppPost etc., so a DB error replaces the form with app/admin/error.tsx. Duplicate creation not reproduced in a browser.
impact: On a slow connection a second click creates a second slide / announcement / post (a post with the e-mail box off; with it on, a second confirm() appears). 'Kaydet' looks dead on a whitespace title. Any failure loses the whole form.
verdict_note: slide-form.tsx:60 and 196-198, announcement-form.tsx and post-form.tsx:88-101 and 268-270 use a plain <form action> with a bare PrimaryButton: no pending state, no disabled. Next's action queue (app-router-instance.js:144-166) does not dedupe, so a second submit runs after the first with its own FormData, which creates a duplicate row. A whitespace-only title passes `required`, then the bare `return` (slaytlar/actions.ts:52,71,75; duyurular 47,66,70; gonderiler 149,173,177) gives no feedback, and R-RESET wipes the form. Store errors are not caught, so they reach app/admin/error.tsx. Same root cause as CON-03 for the reset.
fix: Move to ActionForm and SubmitButton (pending guard: action-form.tsx `if (pending) return`). Return actionError with fieldErrors instead of a bare return, and keep setAdminFlash plus redirect on success. ActionForm has no pre-submit hook, so add a `confirm`/`beforeSubmit` prop for post-form's member-mail confirm() before migrating it.
fix_original: Move the three forms to ActionForm + SubmitButton (pending label, disabled); make actions return actionError('Formdaki uyarıları gider.', { title: 'Başlığı yaz.' }) / 'Bu kayıt silinmiş; listeye dön.' instead of bare return, keep redirect+flash on success; wrap store calls so failures answer in the form.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Checkbox nested in Field's <label>: a click on the long hint flips 'Üyelere e-posta' (member-wide mail)
evidence: Field renders <label> around children and hint (components/admin/forms.tsx:15-26); Checkbox renders its own <label> (forms.tsx:61-69). Nested at gonderiler/post-form.tsx:197-203 ('Yayında') and 230-253 ('Üyelere e-posta', hint ~330 chars), mobil/ayarlar/app-config-form.tsx:213-219 ('Bakım modu'), components/admin/legal-doc-form.tsx:80-86 ('Yayın durumu'). HTML forbids label inside label; the outer label's labeled control is its first labelable descendant, the checkbox.
impact: A click (or click-to-select) on the outer label text, including the long e-mail hint, toggles the checkbox: in create mode the member-wide campaign mail is switched off silently; elsewhere 'Bakım modu' or 'Yayında' flip. Screen readers read both labels plus the entire hint as the checkbox name.
verdict_note: Field renders <label> around its label, children and hint (forms.tsx:15-26). Checkbox renders its own <label> (forms.tsx:61-69). Nested at gonderiler/post-form.tsx:197-203 and 230-253, mobil/ayarlar/app-config-form.tsx:213-219 ('Bakım modu') and legal-doc-form.tsx:80-86. The outer label has no `for`, so its labeled control is the first labelable descendant, the checkbox. A click on the outer caption or the long hint therefore toggles it. Root cause R-LABEL. The same nesting exists outside CONTENT: ayarlar/settings-form.tsx:412, promo-form.tsx:137, product-wizard.tsx:386.
fix: Render these checkboxes outside Field (a div plus heading, or fieldset/legend) and tie the hint with aria-describedby. Alternatively, change Field to a div with a <label htmlFor> pair, which fixes every caller at once.
fix_original: Render these checkboxes outside Field (fieldset/legend or a heading div) and tie the hint via aria-describedby; optionally make Field a div + label htmlFor pair.
root_cause_fix: forms.tsx gets a fieldset/legend variant of Field for groups that hold checkboxes or uploaders; Field itself stays a <label> (inputs keep their names).

title: Hard-coded neutral / red text in CONTENT fails contrast (2.31-4.34:1), incl. 'YAYINDA DEĞİL' and errors
evidence: text-neutral-400 (#a1a1a1) on white 2.59:1: meta lines with 'YAYINDA DEĞİL', dates, sort order at mobil/slaytlar/page.tsx:116, mobil/duyurular/page.tsx:53, mobil/gonderiler/page.tsx:120; fA'L time/model mobil/fal-bildirimleri/page.tsx:45; save-bar helper mobil/ayarlar/app-config-form.tsx:146. text-neutral-400 on page ground 2.31:1: mobil/canli-durum/venue-status-form.tsx:163. text-red-600 on page ground 4.24:1 (12px): venue error venue-status-form.tsx:159 (row outside any Card). text-neutral-500 on bg-neutral-100 4.34:1 (10px): hukuk 'Varsayılan' pill hukuk/page.tsx:30.
impact: The line telling the operator that content is off the air, its publish window, and the venue-status error are the least readable text on the page.
verdict_note: Measured: text-neutral-400 (#a1a1a1) is 2.58:1 on white at slaytlar/page.tsx:116, duyurular/page.tsx:53, gonderiler/page.tsx:120, fal-bildirimleri/page.tsx:45 and app-config-form.tsx:146. On #F7F1E5 it is 2.30:1 (venue-status-form.tsx:163, a row outside any Card). red-600 #e7000b is 4.24:1 on #F7F1E5 at 12px (venue-status-form.tsx:159). neutral-500 on neutral-100 is 4.35:1 at 10px (hukuk/page.tsx:30). globals.css has no element reset on p/span that changes this. The green-50/700 and amber-50/700 pills pass (4.72, 4.85).
fix: Use --admin-text-soft (#5A4636, 8.88:1) for meta lines and helpers, --admin-danger-ink (5.73:1 on bg) for errors, and Badge with TONE_* for the hukuk status pills.
fix_original: Use tokens: --admin-text-soft (#5A4636, 8.88:1) for meta and helpers, --admin-danger-ink for errors, Badge with TONE_SOFT/TONE_INK for the hukuk pills.
root_cause_fix: Legacy neutral-*/rose/emerald/serif-italic markup moves to kit tokens and pieces in the package that owns the file.

title: App content lists print raw UTC ISO timestamps and no real publish status
evidence: normalizePublishInstant stores new Date(at).toISOString() (lib/admin/publish-window.ts:37-40); lists print it raw: slaytlar/page.tsx:123-125, duyurular/page.tsx:56-58, gonderiler/page.tsx:125-127 (`${s.startsAt || '…'} → ${s.endsAt || '…'}`). Status is only isActive ('YAYINDA DEĞİL'); isPublishWindowOpen is not used on these pages; no badge, no dimming of inactive rows.
impact: A slide starting 17 Eki 09:00 Istanbul reads '2026-10-17T06:00:00.000Z → …' (three hours off, unreadable). An expired or scheduled row looks exactly like a live one, so the operator cannot tell what members see now.
verdict_note: normalizePublishInstant stores ISO with Z (publish-window.ts:37-40). The lists print the raw value at slaytlar/page.tsx:123-125, duyurular/page.tsx:56-58 and gonderiler/page.tsx:125-127. Status is only isActive; isPublishWindowOpen is not used on these pages. Fix correction: formatDateTime (forms.tsx:194-204) throws RangeError 'Invalid time value' on unparsable text (checked in Node), and normalizePublishInstant stores unparsable text as typed. Calling formatDateTime blindly would crash the list.
fix: For each bound: parsePublishInstant(v)===null ? show the raw text with a 'geçersiz tarih' badge : formatDateTime(v). Add a Badge per row from isActive plus isPublishWindowOpen (Yayında / Planlandı / Süresi doldu / Kapalı). Files: the three list pages.
fix_original: formatDateTime (Istanbul) for both bounds and a Badge per row from isActive + isPublishWindowOpen: Yayında / Planlandı / Süresi doldu / Kapalı; StatusTabs with counts once lists grow. Files: the three list pages.

title: 'Bakım modu' and 'En düşük desteklenen sürüm' (whole-app lockouts) save with no confirmation
evidence: app-config-form.tsx:201-219 ('En düşük desteklenen sürüm', 'Uygulamayı bakıma al (tüm ekranlar kapanır)') save via a plain Kaydet; mobil/ayarlar/actions.ts:110-126 writes immediately. The StoreTab hint says the forced-update screen has no button while the App Store address is empty (app-config-form.tsx:788).
impact: One tick closes every app screen for every member; a version typo (2.0.0 for 1.2.0) sends every install to a forced-update screen that, before the store listing exists, offers no way out.
verdict_note: The VersionTab (app-config-form.tsx:192-245) saves minSupportedAppVersion and maintenance.enabled through a plain Kaydet. saveVersionAction (actions.ts:106-123) writes them at once. The StoreTab hint (app-config-form.tsx ~788) confirms the forced-update screen has no button while the App Store URL is empty. CON-05 makes an accidental toggle of 'Bakım modu' easier.
fix: Ask for confirmation in an ActionModal (danger) only when maintenance goes off→on or the minimum version goes up. Show the current and new values, and require a confirm phrase for the version. Show the live state as a badge on the tab.
fix_original: When maintenance turns on or the minimum version rises, confirm through ActionModal (danger tone, current vs new value, confirm phrase for the version); show the live state as a badge on the tab.

title: A refused karaoke settings save silently re-ticks 'Online ön ödeme' and reverts every field
evidence: Both karaoke tabs post via useActionState + <form action={action}>. React 19.2.4 startHostTransition calls requestFormReset(formFiber) before every form action regardless of the result (node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js 8940-8958), so uncontrolled fields return to defaultValue/defaultChecked. Harness with the real SettingsForm (out/settings-karaoke.json): before karaokeCapacity=8, karaokePrepay=true; typed karaokeCapacity=60 and unticked prepay; saveKaraokeAction refuses 'Karaoke kapasitesi 1 ile 50 arasında olmalı.'; after: karaokeCapacity=8, karaokePrepay=true with the error shown. Karaoke kuralları: maxHours typed 5 reverts to 4 (out/appconfig-karaoke.json).
impact: The operator fixes the field the error names and saves again; the prepayment switch they turned off is saved as ON (changes how web and app take karaoke money). Every typed value in the tab is lost on any refusal.
verdict_note: Confirmed. react-dom 19.2.4 node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js:8940-8958: startHostTransition calls requestFormReset$1(formFiber) before every <form action>, whatever the result. settings-form.tsx:335-383 KaraokeTab uses <form action={action}>. The capacity input has no min/max (346-353), so 60 reaches saveKaraokeAction (actions.ts:228-231), which refuses it. The checkbox then resets to defaultChecked=settings.karaokePrepay. The next save sends prepay=on and stores the old value: the operator's change is lost, nothing is corrupted. app-config-form.tsx:407-413 behaves the same way. Same root cause as KAR-14 and as every other tab in settings-form.tsx (164-592) and app-config-form.tsx (192-780).
fix: Dispatch by hand, as ActionModal already does (action-modal.tsx:299-308) and as ActionForm does (onSubmit + preventDefault + startTransition(() => formAction(new FormData(form)))). Apply it once in a shared helper used by all tabs in app/admin/ayarlar/settings-form.tsx and app/admin/mobil/ayarlar/app-config-form.tsx, not only in the karaoke tabs.
fix_original: Dispatch by hand like ActionForm (components/admin/action-form.tsx 212-240: onSubmit + startTransition) or echo submitted values back as defaults; apply to KaraokeTab in both settings-form.tsx and app-config-form.tsx.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

subtasks.what: app-config-form.tsx tabs use the same helper

title: A refused save wipes the tab and silently turns 'Online mağaza açık', 'Yeni siparişte e-posta gönder' and indexing back on
evidence: Every tab is useActionState + <form action={action}> with uncontrolled defaultValue/defaultChecked fields. React 19.2.4 calls requestFormReset$1(formFiber) before every form action whatever it answers (node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js:8940-8958); the repo avoids this in components/admin/action-form.tsx:206-212 but SettingsForm was never moved. Browser harness with the real SettingsForm and actions that refuse like the server (audit/sys/harness, expr/reset.js): Genel: name 'X', phone '0216 000 00 00', shop switch OFF -> after 'Kafe adı en az 2 karakter olmalı.' name='L'Affogato', phone='+90 536 429 09 19', isShopOpen=true. Bildirim: order mail OFF, Kasiyer unticked, ops 'ops@laffogato.net', extra 'mutfak@laffogato.net\nbar@ornek' -> after 'Geçersiz e-posta: bar@ornek' enabled=true, roles owner,manager,cashier, ops='', extra='mutfak@laffogato.net' (the line the error names is gone). Saatler: Mon open 08:00, Tue close cleared, Sun reopened -> all back to 09:00 / 02:00 / closed. SEO: title typed, indexing OFF -> title '', indexable=true. Same for Vergi, Kargo, E-posta and the test form. KAR-02 reported this for the Karaoke tab only.
impact: The operator fixes the one field the error names and saves again: the switches they turned off are saved ON (shop reopened, staff order mail re-enabled to Kasiyer, site re-opened to crawlers), and every other typed value in the tab is lost.
verdict_note: Same root cause as KAR-02 and KAR-14 (React 19 <form action> reset). next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.development.js:9285 calls requestFormReset$1(formFiber) before action(formData), whatever the action returns. settings-form.tsx:164-166, 219-221, 268-270, 290-292, 386-388, 427-433, 519-529 and 592 all use <form action={useActionState dispatcher}> with uncontrolled defaultValue fields. A refused save sends no revalidatePath, so the fields go back to the saved values. Chrome re-run: the auditor's harness reproduces this. Downgraded to medium to match KAR-02: this is loss of unsaved input, and the DB keeps its previous value. Genel can only be refused for a 1-char or whitespace name (the input is required), and SEO only for a non-http OG URL. Bildirim (a bad extra address) and Saatler (an emptied time box) are the realistic cases.
fix: In settings-form.tsx, dispatch each tab form by hand: onSubmit, then preventDefault, new FormData, startTransition(dispatch), the same pattern as action-form.tsx:233-239. Or move the tabs onto useToastAction/ActionForm, adapting the actions to ActionResult. That one change also fixes the SYS-02 throw path (runPanelAction catches and rethrows redirects) and SYS-18 (toast).
fix_original: Dispatch like ActionForm (onSubmit + startTransition(() => formAction(fd)), action-form.tsx:212-240) in all eight tab forms plus the test form, or make the fields controlled; return field errors and show them under the field.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Settings saves throw to the panel error page: a decimal VAT rate, a big amount, a DB blip or a failed audit insert
evidence: saveTaxAction rounds to 2 decimals (165) but settings."taxRatePct" is integer (db/schema.sql:169). Throwaway Postgres 16 + the repo's pg driver with the exact upsert shape compile() emits (audit/sys/taxint.cjs): taxRatePct 20 -> ok; 8.5 -> ERROR 22P02 invalid input syntax for type integer: "8.5"; shippingFlatMinor 2500000000 ("25.000.000" typed) -> ERROR 22003 out of range. raiseDbError turns both into DbQueryError (src/lib/db/health.ts:58-68); updateSettings rethrows (store.ts:5019-5031). The tab forms call the actions directly (no runPanelAction, action-form.tsx:46-60), so the throw reaches app/admin/error.tsx 'Bu ekran yüklenemedi.' and the typed form is gone. parseMoneyMinor has no ceiling (unlike CATALOG_MONEY_MAX_MINOR, utils/format.ts:83). ok() awaits the throwing logAudit (audit.ts:101-102) AFTER updateSettings succeeded, so an audit insert failure shows the error page for a save that went through.
impact: Typing '8,5' or '20,5' into the KDV box (the field opens a decimal keypad, inputMode='decimal') shows the full-page error with no hint why; a slipped zero in Kargo does the same; a saved change can look failed and get retried.
verdict_note: db/schema.sql:169 has "taxRatePct" integer. actions.ts:158-165 accepts '8,5' and stores 8.5. sql.ts:283-306 binds it as a pg parameter in INSERT … ON CONFLICT, which gives 22P02. check() (store.ts:539-544) -> raiseDbError (db/health.ts:58-68) throws DbQueryError. parseMoneyInput (format.ts:62-74) caps only at isSafeInteger, so 2.500.000.000 kuruş overflows the integer column (22003). ok() (actions.ts:37-49) awaits logAudit, which throws on a failed insert (audit.ts:101-102), after updateSettings has already succeeded. No catch anywhere, so app/admin/error.tsx:37 'Bu ekran yüklenemedi.' is shown.
fix: saveTaxAction: accept integers only, with a field error ('8,5' -> 'KDV oranı tam sayı olmalı'). Cap the shipping and courier money at CATALOG_MONEY_MAX_MINOR with MONEY_TOO_LARGE_ERROR. Use safeAudit in ok(). Catch thrown errors on the client through runPanelAction/useToastAction. Do not wrap requireRole in a server-side try/catch: it signals redirect() by throwing.
fix_original: Validate tax as an integer 0-100 (or migrate the column to numeric(5,2)); cap kargo/kurye/eşik like CATALOG_MONEY_MAX_MINOR; wrap the actions with runPanelAction-style catch so a thrown error answers 'Bir hata oldu…' in the SaveBar; use safeAudit in ok().
root_cause_fix: safeAudit after a write that already landed (kasa, customer stamps, logout, settings ok()).

title: 'KDV oranı' changes nothing anywhere, and its hint says it is added to the basket
evidence: Hint: 'Sepet alt toplamına uygulanır. Türkiye'de standart %20.' (274). commerce.ts:14 says prices are KDV DAHİL and the rate is 'yalnızca bilgi amaçlı ayrıştırma'; computeOrderTotals returns taxMinor (75) but nothing reads it: `grep -rn taxMinor src` finds only commerce.ts; checkout uses subtotal/discount/shipping/total and freeShippingRemainingMinor only; no order column, receipt, e-mail or report holds a KDV figure (db/schema.sql has no taxMinor).
impact: The owner believes changing the rate changes what customers pay or what the receipt shows; it changes neither. Combined with SYS-02 a decimal rate crashes the save of a field that has no effect.
verdict_note: settings-form.tsx:274 hint says 'Sepet alt toplamına uygulanır'. commerce.ts:14 says the rate is informational only (prices include KDV). taxMinor is computed at :75 but never read: grep finds only commerce.ts:52,75,85. There is no tax column in db/. Legal texts list a stored 'KDV tutarı' in the order record (legal/content.ts:4908, 5771), so a fix that adds or removes KDV storage needs lawyer review.
fix: Short term: reword the hint ('Fiyatlar KDV dahildir; bu oran şu an hiçbir tutarı değiştirmez') or hide the tab. Long term: store the included KDV per order. Flag the legal texts content.ts:4908/5771/13849 for lawyer review.
fix_original: Either drop the tab, or make it real (print 'içindeki KDV' on the receipt/e-mail and store it per order) and reword: 'Fiyatlar KDV dahil. Bu oran yalnız fiş ve sipariş dökümündeki KDV satırını hesaplar.'

title: Tapping the hint or the label next to 'Online mağaza açık' or 'Siteyi arama motorlarına aç' flips the switch
evidence: Field renders a <label> (forms.tsx:15) and Checkbox renders its own <label> (61), so the switch sits in nested labels; the outer label's labelled control is the checkbox. Chrome (expr/nested.js): clicking the hint 'Yalnızca kargolu mağaza siparişlerini durdurur…' changed isShopOpen true -> false; clicking the 'ARAMA MOTORLARI' eyebrow changed seoIndexable true -> false. The Bildirim tab avoids exactly this with a fieldset (458-459); CON-05 found the same bug on the posts form.
impact: Reading the long hint on a phone and tapping it unticks the shop or the indexing switch with no visual cue; the next 'Kaydet' for any field in that tab closes the online shop or blocks every crawler.
verdict_note: Same root cause as CON-05 (R-LABEL). Field renders a <label> (forms.tsx:15) and Checkbox renders its own <label> (forms.tsx:61). A label with no for attribute labels its first labelable descendant, the checkbox, so a click anywhere in the Field (eyebrow, hint, empty row space) toggles it. Chrome re-run on cf30307 sources: clicking the hint turned isShopOpen true -> false. SEO at settings-form.tsx:412-418 has the same structure.
fix: Use <fieldset><legend> for Fields that wrap checkboxes, as NotificationsTab already does (settings-form.tsx:460-466), for example as a Field variant. Do NOT turn Field into a div panel-wide: every TextInput or Select inside a Field gets its accessible name from that wrapping label, so the whole panel's inputs would lose their labels.
fix_original: Wrap these two checkboxes in a fieldset/legend (as NotificationsTab does) or render Field as a <div> with the label on the text only; add the shop/indexing confirmation from SYS-06.
root_cause_fix: forms.tsx gets a fieldset/legend variant of Field for groups that hold checkboxes or uploaders; Field itself stays a <label> (inputs keep their names).

title: No confirmation or warning before the panel's most dangerous settings take effect
evidence: 'Online mağaza açık' off stops every shop order (store.ts:2669, 3064; mobile/orders.ts:954), 'Siteyi arama motorlarına aç' off makes robots.txt disallow everything (robots.ts:58-61), 'Yeni siparişte e-posta gönder' off or no roles/addresses left silences staff order mail (staff-order-notice.ts:118, 143 returns not_due with zero recipients), and a 'Gönderen adresi' on a domain Resend has not verified stops every customer mail incl. verification links (health.ts:8-13 says /odeme then refuses first orders). All save on a plain 'Kaydet' with no ActionModal/confirm, no domain check before saving the sender (actions.ts:409-436 only regex-checks), no 'nobody will get this mail' warning. The panel has ConfirmButton/ActionModal in the kit for exactly this.
impact: One mis-tick or a typo in the sender domain switches off sales, search traffic or all customer mail until someone notices.
verdict_note: isShopOpen, seoIndexable and orderNotifyEnabled save on a plain submit (settings-form.tsx:205-209, 413-417, 447-451). The effects are real: store.ts:2669 and 3064 refuse shop orders, robots.ts:59-61, and staff-order-notice.ts:118/143 return not_due. saveEmailSenderAction (actions.ts:409-436) checks only a regex. Partial mitigation: forgetEmailHealth() plus revalidate turn the banner rose right after an unverified sender is saved, but that is after the fact. SYS-05 makes an accidental toggle more likely.
fix: Show an ActionModal confirm when the shop or indexing switch goes off, or the order mail goes off. Before saving a new sender domain, check its status via the health lookup and warn when it is not verified. Warn when the recipient list resolves to zero.
fix_original: Use the kit confirm (ActionModal) for shop off, indexing off, order mail off and for a sender whose domain emailHealth does not report verified (or refuse it with a clear message); warn when the notification recipient list resolves to empty.

title: Eight separate forms hide each other, with no unsaved-changes marker or leave guard
evidence: Each tab is its own form and only the visible one is saved; hidden panes keep typed values (74-78) but nothing marks a tab as changed and there is no beforeunload or route-change guard anywhere in the panel (`grep -rn beforeunload src/app/admin src/components/admin` = 0). The only hint is the idle line 'Değişiklikler bu sekme kaydedildiğinde anında uygulanır.' (119).
impact: The owner edits Genel and Kargo, presses Kaydet once (Kargo) and leaves: the Genel edits are lost silently, after a green 'kaydedildi'.
verdict_note: Eight separate forms. No dirty tracking. grep beforeunload in src/app/admin finds 0 (the only hit is paynkolay-page.ts). Correction to the impact: saving Kargo resets only the Kargo form element, so the typed Genel values stay in the hidden pane (Pane hidden, settings-form.tsx:110-111). They are lost when the operator leaves or reloads after seeing the green 'kaydedildi', and nothing warns them.
fix: As proposed: per-form dirty state, a dot on dirty tabs, and a beforeunload guard while any form is dirty.
fix_original: Track dirty state per form, show a dot on dirty tabs, warn on tab-switch-to-leave and beforeunload (Filament unsavedChangesAlerts), or move to one form with one save bar.

title: Settings tabs are not tabs: no ARIA, half of them invisible on a phone, and no URL so every link lands on Genel
evidence: Plain buttons in a <nav> with no role=tablist/tab, aria-selected or aria-controls; panes are div[hidden] without role=tabpanel; selection shown by colour only. Chrome at 390x844 (expr/ayarlar.js): nav clientWidth 366, scrollWidth 652, scrollbar-width none, only Genel, Saatler, Vergi, Kargo fully visible; Karaoke cut at x=418, SEO, Bildirim, E-posta off-screen with no cue. Tab is useState('general') and the page reads no searchParams, so the dashboard mail banner, the karaoke header (SHE-24, KAR-12), every settings row's 'Kayıt' link in Olay kaydı (audit-view.ts:179, entityId 'notifications'/'email-test') and the test mail's 'AYARLARA DÖN' button all open Genel.
impact: Screen-reader users hear eight unrelated buttons; phone users do not know four tabs exist; every deep link costs an extra hunt.
verdict_note: settings-form.tsx:57-71: plain buttons with no role=tablist/tab/tabpanel and no aria-selected or aria-pressed, so the selected state is not exposed. Chrome at 390px: nav is 366px wide with scrollWidth 652. Genel, Saatler, Vergi and Kargo are fully visible, Karaoke is cut, and SEO, Bildirim and E-posta are off screen; the scrollbar is hidden. Tab state is useState('general') (:53) with no URL. These links all land on Genel: admin/page.tsx:180 ('Ayarlar → E-posta'), mobil/karaoke/page.tsx:131 ('Ayarlar → Karaoke'), audit-view.ts:178-179, send.ts:292. Overlaps SHE-24 and KAR-12.
fix: As proposed: ?sekme= synced with the tab (KARAOKE_TAB_PARAM='sekme' already exists in karaoke-panel.ts:509), ARIA tabs with arrow keys, and an overflow cue or a select below sm.
fix_original: role=tablist/tab/tabpanel with aria-selected and arrow keys, a ?sekme= param read by the page (and written on tab change), a visible overflow cue or a <select> under sm; link the audit rows to ?sekme=<entityId>.
root_cause_fix: Settings tab synced with ?sekme= (ARIA tabs); links use ?sekme=email / ?sekme=karaoke.

title: Settings audit rows cannot answer 'who closed the shop' or 'what was the sender before'
evidence: ok()'s own comment says the payload carries before/after of the keys that moved (29-36), but saveGeneralAction logs only { section: 'general' } (111): shop switch, phone, e-mail, address, hero image not recorded; saveSeoAction logs only { section: 'seo' } (278): indexing switch not recorded; saveEmailSenderAction logs { emailFromAddress } after only (433-435), no before, no name/reply-to. Every save writes a row even when nothing changed. The test mail is logged as action 'update' on entity 'settings' (461), not the existing 'send_test' action ('Test gönderimi', audit.ts:62), so the İşlem filter misses it.
impact: After the shop was closed or the site de-indexed, Olay kaydı shows 'Güncelleme · Ayar · general' and nothing else; the owner cannot reconstruct the change or who made which part of it.
verdict_note: actions.ts:111 ok('general', …) has no payload, so isShopOpen, phone and address changes are not recorded. :278 saveSeoAction has no payload (seoIndexable not recorded). :433-435 logs only the new emailFromAddress. ok() always logs, even when nothing changed. :461 logs the test mail as action 'update' although 'send_test' exists (audit.ts:62, audit-view.ts:61).
fix: As proposed: log before/after of the changed keys for general and seo, and the before value of the sender. Skip no-op saves. Log the test mail with action:'send_test' (entity settings or campaign_email, keeping the recipient).
fix_original: Log before/after for every key that moved in General, SEO and E-posta (skip the row when nothing moved), and log the test mail as send_test.

title: Dashboard 'Net ciro' value overflows its card on phones and desktop
evidence: Stat value is `text-3xl` italic with no min-w-0 / truncate / wrapping inside a grid cell (page.tsx:196-206). Rendered dashboard: at 390x844 (grid-cols-2, card 171px) '₺123.456,78' is 171px wide and ends 17px outside the card; at 1280x900 (lg:grid-cols-5 beside the 16rem sidebar, card 182px) it ends 14px outside. Measured with a fallback face; Poppins is wider and a 7-digit revenue is longer.
impact: The headline revenue figure spills over the card border into the gutter on every device, worse with real numbers.
verdict_note: page.tsx:187-210: the stat value is `text-3xl` (30px) with no min-w-0, truncate or wrap, and the text has no break points. At 390px: main px-4, grid-cols-2 with gap-4, so the card is 171px. With Card p-4 (sm:p-6 starts at 640px) the content box is about 137px, and ₺123.456,78 at 30px Poppins is well over that. At lg (5 columns beside lg:pl-64) the content box is about 132px. Net ciro is the last card, so the overflow also runs past the grid edge on desktop.
fix: src/app/admin/page.tsx: use the kit stat size (text-2xl font-semibold, as in karaoke-today-card.tsx), add `min-w-0` to the card and `truncate` plus a title, or make the Net ciro card `col-span-2` below md. Do it together with SHE-14 (who sees the card) and SHE-17 (the serif italic).
fix_original: Use the kit stat style (text-2xl font-semibold as in karaoke-today-card.tsx), add min-w-0 + truncate with a title, or let the Net ciro card span two columns below md.

title: Personel sees the shop's net revenue on the dashboard though revenue reports are owner/manager only
evidence: The cards array always includes 'Net ciro' = getDashboardStats().revenueMinor ('Ödenen siparişler, iadeler düşülmüş') for every dashboard role (dashboard: owner, manager, staff), with no canAccess('reports') check, while roles.ts:88 `reports: ['owner','manager']` hides Raporlar from staff.
impact: Shift staff read the business's total net revenue that the role matrix withholds from them elsewhere (confirm intent with the operator).
verdict_note: page.tsx:109-113 always includes 'Net ciro' (paid minus refunds) for every role that can open the dashboard (roles.ts:56 includes staff), with no canAccess('reports') check. roles.ts:88 limits reports to owner/manager. AUDIT.md:547 locked the order CSV away from staff for the same reason. Staff can still see individual order totals in Siparişler, so the intent needs confirming, but the matrix says no.
fix: src/app/admin/page.tsx: build the Net ciro card only when canAccess('reports', session.role). It can also skip the revenue read for staff, but getDashboardStats is shared, so just hide the card. The grid then has 4 cards, so adjust lg:grid-cols.
fix_original: Render the Net ciro card only when canAccess('reports', session.role) in app/admin/page.tsx (staff can get today's open-order count instead).

title: Revenue chart is unreadable on phones and cuts the ₺ off its axis labels at every width
evidence: Fixed 800x240 viewBox scaled to the card. Chrome (expr/raporlar.js): at 390 px the SVG is 324x97 px (scale 0.405), axis text renders 5 px tall, points r=1.2 px; at 1024 px text is 12 px. Y labels are end-anchored at x=48 inside padL 56 and overflow the SVG's left edge: '₺38.775,00' starts 3 px (390), 5 px (1024) and 7 px (1280) outside, so the ₺ sign is clipped. Y labels fill rgba(0,0,0,.5) = #808080 on white = 3.95:1 (< 4.5). Values only in <title> tooltips (hover only, no touch/keyboard); role=img aria-label 'Ciro grafiği' with no data. Empty period: ticks read '₺0,01, ₺0,01, ₺0,01, ₺0,00, ₺0,00' and the line says 'zirve: 18 Eyl (₺0,00)' (raporlar/page.tsx:48-51).
impact: On the phone the owner sees a 97 px smudge; on desktop the scale reads '8.775,00'; screen-reader and touch users get no numbers at all.
verdict_note: revenue-chart.tsx:15-20 fixes the viewBox at 800x240 with padL=56; labels sit at x=48 with text-anchor end (:72-82), and the svg has overflow hidden. Chrome: chart is 324x97 at 390px with 5px label text; Y labels clipped by 2.5, 5.3 and 7.3px at 390, 1024 and 1280, so the ₺ is cut. Fill rgba(0,0,0,.5) on white is #808080, 3.95:1. Values appear only in <title> (:108-110). With an empty period, max=Math.max(1,…) is 1 kuruş, so ticks read ₺0,01, and the peak falls back to buckets[0] with ₺0,00 (raporlar/page.tsx:48-51).
fix: As proposed: padL sized to the longest label, or HTML axis labels; round ticks with a 'Henüz satış yok' empty state; label colour of at least 4.5:1; an sr-only table of buckets; focusable points.
fix_original: Render text outside the scaled viewBox (HTML axis labels or a viewBox that tracks the container width), compute padL from the longest label, nice round ticks (k notation), --admin-text-soft ink, focusable points with a visible tooltip and an sr-only table of the buckets; hide the peak line when the period is empty.

title: Headline values spill out of their tiles at 1024-1279 px
evidence: Local Stat (text-xl, no min-w-0/truncate) in lg:grid-cols-5 beside the 16 rem sidebar. Chrome at 1024x900 with Poppins: 'Net ciro ₺1.272.103,89' ends 24 px past its content box and 8 px past the card border; 'Brüt ciro ₺1.284.567,89' ends 32 px past, i.e. 4 px inside the next (İade) card; İade 4 px. Fits at 390 and 1280. Same pattern as the dashboard card SHE-06, but a separate component.
impact: On a 13-inch laptop or iPad landscape the main revenue figures run over the neighbouring tile.
verdict_note: raporlar/page.tsx:62 uses grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 (minmax(0,1fr)). Stat value at :262-266 is text-xl, unbreakable, with no min-w-0 or truncation. Chrome at 1024: Net ciro runs 25px past its content box, Brüt 33px, İade 5px. All fit at 1280. Same pattern as SHE-06 (dashboard), but a different component.
fix: As proposed: lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-5, or text-lg with tabular figures at lg, plus min-w-0 and break-words.
fix_original: Use the kit stat tile with min-w-0 and a responsive size (text-lg on lg, text-xl on xl), or lg:grid-cols-3 + xl:grid-cols-5.

title: Report figures do not line up: all-time tiles under a period switch, top-5 sorted by money but drawn by quantity, top-5 not net
evidence: analyticsHeadline() and topProducts(5) take no period (39-44), so 'Net ciro', 'Sipariş', 'Ortalama sepet' and the top-5 are all-time while the 30 gün/12 hafta/12 ay switch sits beside them, with no 'tüm zamanlar' label. topProducts sorts by revenueMinor (5997) but the bar width is qty/maxQty (186, 209): Chrome shows row 2 'Yenilebilir kup 12'li hediye kutusu 35 adet · ₺52.500,00' with a 6% bar under row 1 at 69% and row 3 at 100%. Top-5 revenue is unitPrice x qty (5986): promo discounts are ignored and fully refunded orders still count (isReportableOrder keeps 'refunded', 5796), while Net ciro subtracts refunds, so the list never reconciles with the tiles.
impact: The owner compares this month's chart with a headline that is the café's whole history, and reads a product ranking whose bars contradict its order and whose totals include refunded sales.
verdict_note: analyticsHeadline (store.ts:6014) and topProducts (5976) read all orders and ignore the `g` period (page.tsx:39-44), and the page does not say so. topProducts sorts by revenueMinor (5997), but the bar width is qty/maxQty (page.tsx:52,186). Chrome bars in rank order: 69%, 6%, 100%. Revenue is unitPriceMinor*qty (5986/5991), so no discounts are taken off. isReportableOrder (5796) excludes only cancelled and pending_payment, so refunded orders count.
fix: As proposed: apply the period to the tiles and the top list, or label them 'Tüm zamanlar'; size bars by the sort key; net out refunds and discounts, or label the figure 'liste fiyatıyla'.
fix_original: Apply the selected period to every figure (or label them 'Tüm zamanlar'), size bars by the sort key (or sort by quantity under 'En çok satan'), compute product revenue net of line discounts and refunds.

title: CSV export of customer names/e-mails and money is not audited
evidence: GET streams up to 5,000 orders with customer name, e-mail and amounts (lib/admin/order-csv.ts:21-39) and writes no audit row; AuditAction has no export kind (lib/admin/audit.ts:45-62).
impact: A bulk export of the customer list (KVKK personal data) leaves no trace in Olay kaydı.
verdict_note: siparisler/csv/route.ts:38-84 streams up to ORDER_CSV_MAX_ROWS orders with names, e-mails and money, and writes no audit row. AuditAction (audit.ts:45-62) has no export kind. Owner/manager only (mayExportOrders), so it is about traceability, not exposure.
fix: Add 'export' to AuditAction and to AUDIT_ACTION_LABELS plus the tone map in lib/admin/audit-view.ts (Record<AuditAction> forces both, tsc fails otherwise). In the route call safeAudit({action:'export', entity:'order', actor: session.email, payload:{filters: parsed.values, tab: parsed.tab, rows: rows.length}}) before returning. Keep the response unchanged.
fix_original: Add an 'export' AuditAction and safeAudit({action:'export', entity:'order', payload:{filters, rows}}) in the route before returning.
plan_note: Lives with the audit owner: AuditAction 'export' + labels in audit.ts/audit-view.ts, and siparisler/csv/route.ts.

title: The 'Ayrıntı' column prints raw internals: English dotted keys, role and status ids, section ids as record numbers
evidence: Nested keys keep their raw path as the label (312: label = key when prefixed). Rendered rows (harness payload-dump.json): 'before.shippingFlatMinor: ₺49,00', 'after.courierFeeMinor: ₺75,00', 'before.orderNotifyRoles: owner, manager, cashier', 'changed.orderNotifyEmailsAdded: 1', 'after.openingHours: mon 09:00-02:00 · tue …' (English day codes from actions.ts:140), 'transition: cancel / Yeni: cancelled / Önceki: paid', 'restock: evet', 'needs2FA: hayır', 'op: delete / updated: 5'. The test mail row reads 'Yeni: okan@laffogato.com' because KEY_LABELS maps to -> 'Yeni' (215). The 'Kayıt' cell shows 'general', 'notifications', 'email-test' as the record number. Filter options include 'Reel' (21, never written: 0 logAudit calls), 'Mağaza Hero' (17), '2FA aktif' vs '2FA kapatma' (58-59).
impact: The owner cannot read what changed without knowing the code: which fee moved, which roles were removed, what a status id means.
verdict_note: audit-view.ts:312 `label: prefix ? key : (KEY_LABELS[k] ?? k)` prints nested keys raw. Chrome render on cf30307 sources shows labels such as 'section', 'before.shippingFlatMinor', 'changed.orderNotifyEmailsAdded' and 'before.openingHours', the test mail's `to` shown as 'Yeni', and Kayıt ids such as 'general' and 'email-test'. 'reel' appears only in the audit.ts:21 type and nothing writes it. These raw keys also cause the 219px label column in SYS-11.
fix: As proposed: Turkish labels per nested path (before./after./changed. become Önceki/Yeni/Değişti, plus field names), ROLE_LABELS for role lists, Turkish order status names, section names for settings, a separate key for the test recipient, and drop 'reel' from the filter options.
fix_original: Label nested keys ('Önce · Kargo ücreti'), map role ids via ROLE_LABELS and order statuses via the order labels, render settings sections with Turkish names, give the test mail its own key ('Alıcı'), Turkish day names in the hours summary, drop 'Reel', 'Mağaza vitrini', '2FA açma'.

title: At 1024-1279 px the log squeezes the actor to 25 px and the values to 34 px; one event is 565 px tall
evidence: Chrome, real page in the real layout with the sidebar (expr/olay.js, olay2.js) at 1024x900: columns Zaman 129, Kim 59, İşlem 148, Kayıt 85, Ayrıntı 297 px; the actor 'okan@laffogato.com' renders 25 px wide over 7 lines (break-all); the payload <dt> labels take 219 px so each <dd> value gets 34 px ('owner, manager, cashier' wraps to 5 lines); the notifications row is 565 px tall (293 px at 1280). At 390x844 the same event is a 757 px card and 10 events are 2,931 px.
impact: On a laptop or iPad landscape the log is a column of broken e-mail fragments and one-word lines; scanning who did what is slow.
verdict_note: Re-measured in Chrome at 1024px. Columns: Zaman 129, Kim 59, İşlem 148, Kayıt 85, Ayrıntı 297. The actor span is 25x117px because of break-all (olay-kaydi/page.tsx:154). In the tallest row, dt is 219px and dd 34px. Row heights: 565px at 1024, 293px at 1280. Partly the same root cause as SYS-10 (long dotted labels).
fix: As proposed: min-w on Kim (or truncate with a title), stack label above value in PayloadCell, collapse long payloads, and give a compact mobileCard. Fixing SYS-10's labels shrinks the dt column by itself.
fix_original: Give Kim a min-width (or truncate with title), stack the payload as label above value in narrow cells, collapse long payloads behind 'Ayrıntı' (SYS-09 detail view), and pass a compact mobileCard.
root_cause_fix: DataTable: scroll wrapper `relative`; actions th/td `sticky right-0` with a background that follows hover/selected rows. Areas then trim their own columns.

title: 'Değiştirilemez' audit log is not protected: no append-only guard, app-supplied timestamps
evidence: The page says 'Admin mutasyonlarının değiştirilemez tarihçesi' (115) and the published retention policy sentence the code quotes says 'Kayıtlar değiştirilemez (append-only) olarak tutulur' (retention.ts:132). audit_logs is a plain table (schema.sql:179-191): no trigger or rule blocking UPDATE/DELETE (`grep audit_logs db/schema.sql` shows only indexes and RLS), RLS is enabled with no policies but the app connects as the owner role that bypasses it (db/migrations/20260601120000_initial_schema.sql:7-9), createdAt is text written by the app clock (audit.ts:98), ids come from a counter, no hash chain.
impact: Anyone with the app's DB credential, a future buggy query or a compromised server action can rewrite or delete history without trace, which breaks the published KVKK undertaking the log exists for.
verdict_note: db/schema.sql:179-191 audit_logs has no trigger or rule. The only append-only trigger in the schema is customer_consents_no_update (schema.sql:3824-3837). The initial schema says the app uses a single owner connection, which bypasses RLS (initial_schema.sql:7-9). createdAt is text set from the app clock (audit.ts:98). The page says 'değiştirilemez' (olay-kaydi/page.tsx:115) and the published retention basis says 'append-only' (retention.ts:126-133).
fix: Write a new migration (and regenerate schema.sql/schema-sql.ts via db:bundle) mirroring customer_consents_append_only: BEFORE UPDATE raises P0001. BEFORE DELETE is allowed only when OLD."createdAt" is older than the 10-year retention, so retention.ts keeps working. If createdAt moves to a DB default, keep the same ISO-8601 'Z' text format, because the filters (audit.ts:157-158) and ordering compare strings. The hash chain is optional.
fix_original: Add a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger that raises unless called by the retention function (security definer, cutoff-checked), default createdAt to now() in the DB, optionally chain a sha256 of the previous row; reword the page copy until then.

title: Genel and Saatler edits do not reach most places the page promises; 'Kafe adı' and 'Slogan' are not shown to customers at all
evidence: Page description: 'Müşteri sitesindeki footer ve Visit sayfasını besler.' settings.name is read only by the dashboard eyebrow (app/admin/page.tsx:157) and the printed receipt (order-detail.tsx:638, 764); settings.tagline only by the receipt (639). Site title, header, JSON-LD and the app use SITE.name (app/layout.tsx:64-92; menu-mapper.ts:606 'the site constants carry what the tax certificate fixes (name...)'). /ziyaret keeps SITE.phone in three places (visit-page.tsx:473 'ara' button, 494 'Rezervasyon yalnızca telefonla: <SITE.phone>', 629). 24 e-mail templates hard-code the footer 'Her gün 09:00 - 02:00 · +90 536 429 09 19' and the address (text.ts:17; templates/*.html). The legacy openingHours string written by saveHoursAction (140-145) is read nowhere (only SITE.openingHours exists). A cleared phone renders an empty tel: link in the footer (chrome.tsx:920 uses ?? not ||) while the app falls back to the site phone (menu-mapper.ts:611).
impact: The owner renames the café, changes the slogan, phone or closing time and believes the site and mails follow; mails, the reservation button on /ziyaret and the café name keep the old values.
verdict_note: settings.name is read only by admin/page.tsx:157 and order-detail.tsx:638,764; tagline only by order-detail.tsx:639. visit-page.tsx:473, 494 and 629 use SITE.phone / SITE.phoneE164 while :29 has visit.phone. menu-mapper.ts:606 uses name: site.name. text.ts:17-21 and 21 HTML templates hard-code 'Her gün 09:00 - 02:00 · +90 536 429 09 19'. The auditor's '24' is a miscount: 21 of 22 templates, plus the text signature. openingHours (actions.ts:144) has no reader. chrome.tsx:920 uses settings?.phone ?? …, so a blank phone gives an empty tel: link. Same root cause as SYS-M01.
fix: As proposed. Also: pass visit.phone into the visit-page CTAs, use || in chrome.tsx:920-921, relabel 'Kafe adı / Slogan' as receipt fields, and correct the ayarlar/page.tsx:23 description. Feeding the mail footers from settings touches 21 templates plus templates.generated.ts (regenerate, do not hand-edit).

title: Buttons ignore their size / weight / cursor utilities (`button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer }` not rolled back)
evidence: Unlayered button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer } (globals.css:267-274) beats layered Tailwind utilities; the admin-root override rolls back only color/background/border/padding/text-decoration (6138-6144). So text-sm/text-xs/font-medium on PrimaryButton, GhostButton, SubmitButton, ConfirmButton, the app-config tab buttons, and disabled:cursor-not-allowed (ui/styles.ts:6) do nothing: buttons render 16px/400/line-height 1.6 while link-buttons render 14px/500. hukuk/page.tsx:61-81 shows 'Önizle ↗' (12px pill), 'Varsayılana döndür' (className text-xs, renders 16px, 44px tall), 'Düzenle' (12px) side by side. Derived from the cascade, not measured in a browser.
impact: Mixed type sizes inside one row and between '+ Yeni ...' links and 'Kaydet' buttons; disabled buttons still show a pointer.
verdict_note: The unlayered `button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer }` (globals.css:267-274) beats Tailwind v4's layered utilities. [data-admin-root] :is(a, button) (6138-6144) reverts only color, background, border, padding and text-decoration. So text-sm, text-xs, font-medium and disabled:cursor-not-allowed do nothing on admin <button>s, which inherit 16px/400/1.6 from body (globals.css:234-239). Root cause R-BTN, shared with SHELL. Fix correction: Tailwind v4 preflight sets no cursor on button (node_modules/tailwindcss/preflight.css has only font: inherit at 243-249). `cursor: revert-layer` would therefore drop the pointer cursor from every admin button, since BUTTON_BASE and the forms.tsx buttons have no cursor-pointer.
fix: Add only `font: revert-layer;` to [data-admin-root] :is(a, button). For the cursor, add `cursor-pointer` to BUTTON_BASE (ui/styles.ts) and the forms.tsx buttons, keeping disabled:cursor-not-allowed, or add `[data-admin-root] button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed }`. Extend tests/admin-root-css.test.ts. Expect every admin button to shrink to its utility size.
fix_original: Add font: revert-layer; cursor: revert-layer; to [data-admin-root] :is(a, button) (Tailwind preflight then supplies font: inherit and utilities win); extend tests/admin-root-css.test.ts. Owned by SHELL.
root_cause_fix: globals.css admin-root rule gains `font: revert-layer`; unlayered `[data-admin-root] :is(button:disabled,[aria-disabled=true])` gets cursor:not-allowed. No `cursor: revert-layer` (Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight has no button pointer).

title: Printing a karaoke page gives blank sheets
evidence: The global print rule hides `body *` unless inside [data-print-receipt]; karaoke pages have none. Chrome print-to-PDF of the booking page: 2 blank pages (audit/karaoke/render/out/print/detail-101.pdf). The table-card sheet prints fine: 9 cards on 2 pages, none split (out/print/yazdir-9.pdf).

fix: Scope it as `body:has([data-print-receipt]) *` (and the matching body rule). The order receipt and masalar/yazdir keep working; other pages then print normally. Optionally add print styles that hide the sidebar.
fix_original: Scope the rule with body:has([data-print-receipt]) and add simple print styles for the karaoke list/booking page.
root_cause_fix: Scope the print rule to `body:has([data-print-receipt])`; shell-nav adds print:hidden to the sidebar, top bar and drawer.

title: Admin input/select/textarea ignore text-sm: unlayered `font: inherit` reset beats the layered utilities
evidence: globals.css:280-291 is an unlayered `input, textarea, select { font: inherit; color: inherit; min-width: 0 }`. The admin override `[data-admin-root] :is(a, button)` (6138) does not include fields. So `text-base sm:text-sm` in forms.tsx:31 (baseInput), components/admin/ui/filter-bar.tsx:23 (INPUT) and action-modal.tsx:407 (confirm box) never applies: on desktop every admin field inherits 16px from body (globals.css:238) instead of 14px. The colour also inherits but resolves to the same #2C1D11, so only size and weight are off.
impact: Admin fields are larger than the 14px labels and buttons the kit designs for, which adds to the mixed sizes in KAR-04/05.
fix: Add `[data-admin-root] :is(input, textarea, select) { font: revert-layer; }` in app/globals.css. Keep min-width:0 and do not revert it. On phones the fields stay at 16px through text-base, so iOS does not zoom.
root_cause_fix: `[data-admin-root] :is(input,textarea,select) { font: revert-layer }`; min-width:0 stays; iOS 16px guard untouched.

title: Site-green focus ring replaces the kit's focus style on every orders control
evidence: Unlayered `a/button/input/textarea/select/summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: var(--ring) }` beats the layered kit utilities `focus-visible:ring-[var(--admin-accent)] focus-visible:outline-none` (ui/styles.ts:6, ui/action-menu.tsx:160, ui/data-table.tsx:166-189); text fields match :focus-visible on mouse focus too.
impact: Focus is visible but off-brand (green outline + halo instead of the admin gold ring); inputs show a double border on click.
verdict_note: globals.css:690-700 sets an unlayered `a/button/input/textarea/select/summary/[tabindex]:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); box-shadow: var(--ring) }`. It beats the layered focus-visible:outline-none and ring utilities (box-shadow), and text inputs match :focus-visible on mouse focus. Same unlayered-reset root cause as ORD-04.
fix: Add `[data-admin-root] :focus-visible { outline: revert-layer; box-shadow: revert-layer; }` in globals.css next to the admin-root rule (specificity 0,2,0 beats 0,1,1). Legacy inputs with only `outline-none focus:border-*` then show only the border change, which is acceptable or a reason to move them to kit fields.
fix_original: Add `[data-admin-root] :focus-visible { outline: revert-layer; box-shadow: revert-layer; }` or define the admin focus style there.
plan_note: Its revert-layer fix is not used; see SHE-16.
root_cause_fix: Unlayered `[data-admin-root] :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--admin-primary); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: none }` (12.46:1). Not revert-layer: the kit's gold /45 ring is 1.59:1.

title: PEOPLE buttons render 16 px / 400 instead of text-sm font-medium
evidence: Unlayered `button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer }`; the admin-root override (globals.css:6138-6144) reverts only color/background/border/padding/text-decoration. Measured in the replica: PrimaryButton "Kaydet" 16px/400/25.6px; "Uygula" 16px next to the "Sıfırla" link at 14px; text-xs on ConfirmButton/DangerButton triggers ignored (inherit the table's 14 px).
impact: Buttons look heavier and looser than the links beside them; small row buttons are not small.
verdict_note: Confirmed. The unlayered `button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; … }` (globals.css:267-274) beats the layered Tailwind utilities. The admin-root override (globals.css:6138-6144) reverts color, background, border, padding and text-decoration only, so text-sm, font-medium and text-xs on every admin <button> are ignored (for example forms.tsx:79, musteriler/page.tsx:206, bulten/page.tsx:142,151, delete-row-form.tsx:21). Root cause B, a SHELL rule. The proposed fix is partly wrong: Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight has no button cursor rule, so `cursor: revert-layer` would turn every button without a cursor-pointer utility into the default arrow.
fix: globals.css: add `[data-admin-root] button { font: revert-layer; }` (or add `font: revert-layer;` to the existing :is rule) and leave cursor alone. The change is additive, so tests/admin-root-css.test.ts still passes; optionally extend it to assert font.
fix_original: Add `font: revert-layer` (and cursor) to the [data-admin-root] :is(a, button) override in globals.css (SHELL file).
root_cause_fix: globals.css admin-root rule gains `font: revert-layer`; unlayered `[data-admin-root] :is(button:disabled,[aria-disabled=true])` gets cursor:not-allowed. No `cursor: revert-layer` (Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight has no button pointer).

title: Every <button> ignores its text size, weight, line-height and disabled cursor; links with the same classes look different
evidence: The admin-root rule reverts only color/background/border/padding/text-decoration. CSSOM dump on a kit button: utilities .text-sm, .font-medium, .disabled\:cursor-not-allowed lose to unlayered `button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer }`. Computed (390px): BUTTON.primary on <button> ('Uygula', 'Kaydet', modal submit) = 16px / 400 / line-height 25.6px; same classes on <a> ('+ Yeni sipariş') = 14px / 500 / 20px. FilterBar: 'Sıfırla' link 14px beside 'Uygula' button 16px (filter-bar.tsx:201-207); one ActionMenu mixes ActionMenuLink 'Detay' 14px and ActionMenuButton 16px (action-menu.tsx:197-203 vs 258-267); error.tsx:46-58 'Tekrar dene' 16px vs 'Panele dön' 14px; Primary/Ghost/DangerButton 45.6px tall vs 44px links; disabled primary and aria-disabled menu rows keep cursor: pointer; toast close (toast.tsx:214) 14px instead of text-lg; 'Seçimi temizle' (bulk.tsx:211) 16px instead of text-xs; sidebar 'Çıkış' (admin-sidebar.tsx:375) 16px instead of 13px.
impact: Controls meant to be identical differ in size, weight and height side by side on every screen (header actions, filter bars, row menus, modals); disabled buttons still look clickable.
verdict_note: Same root cause as SHE-01/SHE-16 (unlayered resets). globals.css:267-274 `button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer }` is unlayered, and the admin-root rule (6138-6144) does not revert font or cursor. So `text-sm`, `font-medium`, leading and `disabled:cursor-not-allowed` on <button> lose: BUTTON_BASE in ui/styles.ts:6, forms.tsx:79,93,107. A button inherits its parent's font (body 16px/1.6, globals.css:238-241). Example: filter-bar.tsx:201-207 shows 'Sıfırla' (Link, 14px) next to 'Uygula' (button, inherits 16px from the form). How big the mismatch is depends on the parent; in containers with text-sm the button inherits 14px. aria-disabled ActionMenu rows (action-menu.tsx:237-245) keep the pointer cursor. Cosmetic, nothing hidden, so lowered to low.
fix: globals.css admin-root rule: add `font: revert-layer;` (Tailwind preflight in @layer base already sets `font: inherit` on buttons, so buttons without utilities do not change). Do NOT use `cursor: revert-layer`: Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight (node_modules/tailwindcss/preflight.css) has no button pointer, so every kit button would lose its pointer cursor. Add an unlayered `[data-admin-root] :is(button:disabled, button[aria-disabled="true"]) { cursor: not-allowed; }` instead. Extend tests/admin-root-css.test.ts. Leave the input font-size 16px rule (globals.css:5577-5593, iOS zoom) as is.
fix_original: Add `font: revert-layer; cursor: revert-layer;` to the `[data-admin-root] :is(a, button)` rule in globals.css (or do the layer move from SHE-01) and assert font/cursor in tests/admin-root-css.test.ts.
root_cause_fix: globals.css admin-root rule gains `font: revert-layer`; unlayered `[data-admin-root] :is(button:disabled,[aria-disabled=true])` gets cursor:not-allowed. No `cursor: revert-layer` (Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight has no button pointer).

title: The site's green focus ring overrides the panel's gold ring on every control
evidence: Unlayered `a, button, input, textarea, select, summary, [tabindex] :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); box-shadow: var(--ring) }` (--green #1d6d56). CSSOM dump for a kit button: utilities focus-visible:ring-2 (box-shadow) and focus-visible:outline-none lose to it. Text inputs match :focus-visible on mouse focus too, so a focused field shows espresso border + green outline + green halo instead of forms.tsx:31 `focus:ring-[var(--admin-accent)]/25`.
impact: Off-brand focus styling everywhere in the panel; the designed gold focus states never appear (focus stays visible, 6.22:1 on white).
verdict_note: Same root cause as SHE-01/03. globals.css:690-700 is unlayered `a/button/input/textarea/select/summary/[tabindex]:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); box-shadow: var(--ring) }`. It beats the utilities' focus-visible:ring-* and outline-none, and text inputs match :focus-visible on mouse focus. It is off-brand but it IS a compliant indicator: #1d6d56 is 6.22:1 on white. The auditor's fix is wrong: the 'designed' gold ring (ring-[var(--admin-accent)]/45) measures 1.59:1 on white (1.52 on --admin-bg), so reverting to it would weaken focus visibility below WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1.
fix: Do not simply revert-layer. Add an unlayered `[data-admin-root] :focus-visible { outline-color: var(--admin-primary); box-shadow: none; }` (12.46:1), or revert and change the kit ring to full-opacity accent (3.10:1) or primary. Check that inputs still show focus (border-primary).
fix_original: Inside [data-admin-root] revert outline/outline-offset/box-shadow for :focus-visible (revert-layer) or move the site rule into @layer base (SHE-01).
plan_note: Planner resolution: the SHE-16 verdict wins over ORD-23/KAR-04 (revert-layer would bring back the 1.59:1 gold ring).
root_cause_fix: Unlayered `[data-admin-root] :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--admin-primary); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: none }` (12.46:1). Not revert-layer: the kit's gold /45 ring is 1.59:1.
