title: Sidebar karaoke badge stays stale for up to 60 s after an action on the same page
evidence: useNavCount re-reads only when pathname changes or on the 60 s timer; karaoke actions revalidate the page but stay on the same path.
impact: After cancelling tonight's booking the nav still shows the old count.
verdict_note: Confirmed. useNavCount (admin-sidebar.tsx:222-256) re-reads only when pathname changes or on the 60 s timer. The karaoke actions revalidate on the same path. The orders badge shares the same root cause.
fix: Have useToast/ActionModal fire a small window event (e.g. 'admin:changed') after a successful action, and listen for it in useNavCount to re-poll. Files: components/admin/admin-sidebar.tsx, components/admin/ui/action-modal.tsx.
fix_original: Re-poll after a successful panel action (event from the action/toast helpers).
root_cause_fix: Kit fires 'admin:changed' after a successful action (shell-kit); useNavCount listens and re-polls (shell-nav).

subtasks.what: kit dispatches 'admin:changed' after a successful action

title: No loading or pending state anywhere: clicking a sidebar entry shows nothing until the server answers
evidence: `find src/app/admin -name loading.tsx` → 0; 55 of 58 admin pages export force-dynamic and read Postgres on every request; sidebar Links have no pending UI (Next 16 ships useLinkStatus, docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs/.../use-link-status.md); no progress bar in the layout.
impact: On a slow connection or DB, clicks look dead; operators click again or think the panel froze (Filament shows a loading indicator).
verdict_note: `find src/app/admin -name loading.tsx` returns nothing. Sidebar Links (admin-sidebar.tsx:317-350) have no pending UI. Small correction: 53 of 58 pages export force-dynamic, not 55. The other 5 read cookies and are dynamic anyway. Lowered to low: navigations are idempotent GETs, and the mutating controls already show pending states (ActionButton, ActionForm, ActionModal, forms).
fix: Add src/app/admin/loading.tsx (a skeleton inside the layout) and a useLinkStatus indicator in admin-sidebar.tsx. Caveat: once a loading boundary exists, requireRole redirects inside the streamed page become client-side redirects (status 200 with a redirect marker). That still works, and the proxy keeps doing the unauthenticated 307.
fix_original: Add src/app/admin/loading.tsx (skeleton rendered inside the layout so the sidebar stays) and a pending indicator on nav links via useLinkStatus in admin-sidebar.tsx.
root_cause_fix: FilterBar router.push inside useTransition with pending 'Uygula'; useLinkStatus marks on StatusTabs, Pagination and sort headers; shell-nav adds admin/loading.tsx and sidebar link status.

title: Mobile menu drawer is not a dialog: no aria-modal, no focus move/trap, no Escape, toggle has no aria-expanded
evidence: Toggle button (426-444) has aria-label only (no aria-expanded/aria-controls). Drawer (465-500) is a plain div + aside without role='dialog'/aria-modal; focus stays on the hamburger behind the overlay; no keydown handler for Escape; the page behind stays focusable and scrollable (no inert, no scroll lock).
impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users on phones/tablets tab through the hidden page behind the open menu and cannot close it with Esc.
verdict_note: admin-sidebar.tsx:426-444: the toggle has aria-label only, with no aria-expanded or aria-controls. The drawer (465-500) is a plain div + aside with no role=dialog or aria-modal and no Escape handler (no keydown in the file). Focus is not moved and the page behind is not inert. Lowered to low: internal tool, and touch and mouse users can close it by the overlay or the × button.
fix: Render the drawer as a native <dialog> opened with showModal() (as ActionModal does), or add role=dialog + aria-modal, focus the first link, close on Escape, return focus to the toggle, and add aria-expanded/aria-controls. Do it together with SHE-M03 (target sizes).
fix_original: Render the drawer as a native <dialog> opened with showModal() (as ActionModal does) or add role='dialog' aria-modal='true', move focus to the first link, close on Escape, return focus to the toggle, and add aria-expanded/aria-controls to the toggle.
root_cause_fix: 44px targets for hamburger, drawer close and toast close (toast close in shell-kit).

title: Sidebar uses the site's green --brand and cool greys instead of the panel tokens; six entries share one icon
evidence: Active item style `color: var(--brand, #43301D)` (330) with --brand = #1d6d56 green (globals.css:96): computed rgb(29,109,86) on hard-coded #F3EADB (329), while hover is espresso (324); text-neutral-400/600/700/800 and hover:bg-neutral-100 throughout (296, 307, 324, 362, 366, 375, 430, 477). All six Mobil Uygulama entries have section 'mobileApp' and render the same phone glyph (ICONS.mobileApp).
impact: Navigation is out of palette with the rest of the panel; the Mobil Uygulama group is a column of identical icons.
verdict_note: admin-sidebar.tsx:292,452 (brand mark) and :330 (active item) use `var(--brand, #43301D)`, but --brand is defined as #1d6d56 green (globals.css:96) and admin does not override it. The active item is green on hard-coded #F3EADB (5.22:1, passes) while hover is espresso. neutral-* and hover:bg-neutral-100 are used throughout. All six Mobil Uygulama entries share section 'mobileApp', so NavIcon draws one phone glyph (ICONS.mobileApp :99-104).
fix: admin-sidebar.tsx: use --admin-primary, --admin-primary-soft and --admin-text-soft tokens, and give each nav item its own icon key (an optional `icon` on NavItemDef in layout.tsx). Do it together with SHE-05.
fix_original: Use --admin-primary / --admin-primary-soft / --admin-text-soft tokens in admin-sidebar.tsx and add an icon key per nav entry (not per section).
root_cause_fix: Legacy neutral-*/rose/emerald/serif-italic markup moves to kit tokens and pieces in the package that owns the file.

title: Mistyped or stale /admin URLs show the shop's 404 without the panel
evidence: admin/not-found.tsx only renders for notFound() calls; Next 16 docs (node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md:133) route unmatched URLs to the ROOT app/not-found.tsx, which is the shop page with SiteChrome; there is no catch-all route under src/app/admin.
impact: An operator following an old bookmark (e.g. /admin/karaoke) lands on the storefront 404 with Menü/Mağaza links and no sidebar.
verdict_note: admin/not-found.tsx only renders for notFound() calls. node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/not-found.md:133 says the root app/not-found handles unmatched URLs. src/app/not-found.tsx exists (shop), and there is no catch-all under src/app/admin. A signed-in user on /admin/typo gets the shop 404 outside the panel layout.
fix: Add src/app/admin/[...rest]/page.tsx that calls notFound(). Static routes and the route handlers (siparisler/csv, masalar/[id]/qr) still win. Optionally adjust the not-found copy ('Bu sayfa ya da kayıt bulunamadı').
fix_original: Add src/app/admin/[...rest]/page.tsx that calls notFound() (so admin/not-found.tsx renders inside the layout), optionally redirecting known old paths.

title: Cashier: /admin links bounce silently to /admin/kasa?denied=1; 2FA setup is unreachable from the UI
evidence: Sidebar logo, error and 404 'Panele dön', and the 2FA success link all point to /admin; for a cashier requireRole('dashboard') redirects to landingPathFor(cashier)?denied=1 = /admin/kasa?denied=1 (roles.ts:112-126), and kasa/page.tsx never reads denied. The only link to /admin/2fa-kurulum is the dashboard quick link, which a cashier never sees; no sidebar/user-menu entry.
impact: A cashier clicking the logo or 'Panele dön' is bounced without explanation and cannot discover 2FA setup at all.
verdict_note: requireRole (auth.ts:490-494) sends a cashier who opens /admin to /admin/kasa?denied=1, and kasa/page.tsx never reads `denied` (no searchParams), so the bounce is silent. The only /admin/2fa-kurulum link is the dashboard quick link (page.tsx:148), which a cashier cannot open. There is nothing in the sidebar, and ayarlar/kullanicilar have no 2FA entry. The sidebar logo (admin-sidebar.tsx:285,446), error.tsx:54, not-found.tsx:27 and the enroll success link (twofa-enroll-form.tsx:30) all point to /admin.
fix: Point those links to landingPathFor(role) (pass the role or landing path into the sidebar). Show the denied notice from the layout (a toast or flash) instead of only on the dashboard. Add a 'Güvenlik / 2FA' link in the sidebar footer for every role.
fix_original: Link to landingPathFor(role); show the 'yetkin yok' notice from the layout (e.g. a toast driven by useSearchParams) instead of only on the dashboard; add a 'Güvenlik / 2FA' entry to the sidebar footer for every role.

subtasks.what: enroll success link and denied flash source in auth/requireRole

title: Shell lacks Filament basics: global search, breadcrumbs, user menu/profile, collapsible nav, dashboard widgets, clickable rows
evidence: No search input or breadcrumb component in layout.tsx, admin-sidebar.tsx or the kit; the sidebar footer has only e-mail, role and Çıkış (360-394): no profile, password change (none exists for panel users) or 2FA link; nav groups are always expanded (~30 entries for the owner); dashboard stat cards are not links and there are no charts/trends; DataTable links only the first cell, Pagination offers no page size.
impact: Operators cannot jump to an order or customer from anywhere, cannot see where they are on deep pages, and must hunt for account settings.
verdict_note: These are feature gaps, not defects. No search or breadcrumb component in layout.tsx, admin-sidebar.tsx or the ui kit. The sidebar footer (admin-sidebar.tsx:359-394) has only e-mail, role and Çıkış, and there is no self-service password change for panel users. Groups are always expanded, the stat cards (page.tsx:187-210) are not links, and Pagination has no page size.
fix: Backlog: top bar with global search, breadcrumbs, user menu (2FA, password), collapsible groups, linked stat cards. Not a bug-fix item.
fix_original: Top bar with global search (order no / name, customer e-mail), breadcrumbs from PageHeader, a user menu (Profil, Şifre değiştir, 2FA, Çıkış), collapsible groups with persisted state, linked stat widgets with a revenue sparkline, clickable DataTable rows.
plan_note: Not a defect: delivered as the P2b shell work (global search, breadcrumbs, collapsible groups, user menu with 2FA link); linked stat cards in system-insights.
root_cause_fix: P2b: list screens move to DataTable + FilterBar + StatusTabs + Pagination + ActionMenu with server-side paging.

title: Hamburger 36px, drawer close 32px and toast close 32px break the panel's 44px target rule
evidence: Menüyü aç is `grid h-9 w-9` (36px, admin-sidebar.tsx:430). Menüyü kapat is `h-8 w-8` (32px, :477). The toast close is `h-8 w-8` (toast.tsx:214). Everywhere else the panel holds 44px: BUTTON_BASE min-h-[44px] (ui/styles.ts:6), forms.tsx buttons min-h-[44px], Checkbox min-h-[44px]. These pass WCAG 2.5.8 (24px) but are the main navigation controls on a phone.
impact: The one control that opens the navigation on the köşk phone is smaller than every other button, so mis-taps are likely. This is the phone-shell counterpart of SHE-32 (pagination cells).
fix: h-11 w-11 for the hamburger and drawer close, and h-11 w-11 (or a 44px hit area with negative margins) for the toast close. Merge with SHE-13/SHE-32.
root_cause_fix: 44px targets for hamburger, drawer close and toast close (toast close in shell-kit).

title: Login footer tells users to ask 'the admin with access to environment variables'
evidence: 'Şifreni unuttuysan, ortam değişkenlerine erişimi olan yöneticiyle iletişime geç.' Panel passwords are reset by the owner on /admin/kullanicilar (resetAdminPasswordAction); env accounts are only break-glass (auth.ts:64-67).
impact: Staff are pointed at a developer concept instead of the owner who can actually reset their password.
verdict_note: giris/page.tsx:47-50 tells the user to contact 'the admin with access to environment variables'. Panel passwords are reset by the owner (kullanicilar/actions.ts:91 resetAdminPasswordAction). Env accounts are break-glass only (auth.ts:64-67).
fix: giris/page.tsx: 'Şifreni unuttuysan işletme sahibinden sıfırlamasını iste.' (no long dashes).
fix_original: 'Şifreni unuttuysan işletme sahibinden sıfırlamasını iste.'

title: 2FA code fields have no label, 2FA errors are not announced, login page has no heading
evidence: TwoFAVerifyForm and TwoFAEnrollForm TextInput have only placeholder '123456' (no label/aria-label); their error divs lack role='alert' (login-form.tsx:57 has it); the login page renders no h1.
impact: Screen readers announce the field as '123456' and stay silent on 'Doğrulama kodu yanlış.'
verdict_note: twofa-verify-form.tsx:22-37 and twofa-enroll-form.tsx:45-60 TextInputs have only the placeholder '123456', with no label or aria-label. Their error divs (verify :38-42, enroll :61-65) have no role=alert, while login-form.tsx:57 has one. giris/page.tsx renders no h1 (brand mark img + a div).
fix: Add aria-label='6 haneli doğrulama kodu', role='alert' on both error boxes, and an sr-only h1 'Panele giriş' on giris/page.tsx.
fix_original: aria-label='6 haneli doğrulama kodu', role='alert' on both error boxes, an sr-only h1 'Panele giriş'.

title: Turning 2FA off gives no confirmation; errors ride in the URL; controls are off-kit
evidence: disable2FAAction returns nothing on success (revalidatePath only); the page just switches to the setup view with a fresh QR. Refusals redirect to ?hata=kod / ?hata=kilit and are rendered from searchParams, so the error persists on reload. The form uses rounded-full pills and red-* text-xs (rendered 16px, see SHE-03) instead of DangerButton.
impact: The operator is not told that a security setting changed; stale errors reappear on reload.
verdict_note: disable2FAAction (actions.ts:54-80) only revalidates on success. The page then silently re-renders the setup view with a fresh QR, and startEnrollment writes a draft (SHE-09). Refusals redirect to ?hata=kod|kilit and render from searchParams (page.tsx:14-17,26-27), so they persist on reload. The button's `text-xs` (page.tsx:63) is lost to `button{font:inherit}` (same root cause as SHE-03). It also uses red-* and rounded-full instead of the kit.
fix: On success: setAdminFlash('İki adımlı doğrulama kapatıldı.', 'warning') + redirect(landingPathFor(role)). Use a flash for errors too. Use forms.tsx TextInput/DangerButton (or ConfirmButton). Keep the current-code requirement and the rate limits.
fix_original: setAdminFlash('İki adımlı doğrulama kapatıldı.', 'warning') + redirect on success, flash for errors, kit/forms.tsx controls.
root_cause_fix: globals.css admin-root rule gains `font: revert-layer`; unlayered `[data-admin-root] :is(button:disabled,[aria-disabled=true])` gets cursor:not-allowed. No `cursor: revert-layer` (Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight has no button pointer).

title: Login accepts an unbounded e-mail string and writes it verbatim to audit_logs and the rate-limit key
evidence: email = String(formData.get('email')).trim() with no format/length check; next.config.ts:118 sets serverActions bodySizeLimit '12mb'; logAudit stores it as actor and entityId (audit.ts:91-97, actor indexed by audit_logs_actor_idx, db/schema.sql:189); bucketKey embeds it (rate-limit.ts:268-270). Unproven: exact Postgres behaviour for multi-MB values (the btree row-size limit may turn it into a thrown error and the generic error page).
impact: Unauthenticated requests can push very large strings into audit_logs (olay kaydı view) or get the error screen instead of a validation message.
verdict_note: giris/actions.ts:17 only trims, with no length or format check. The bodySizeLimit is 12mb (next.config.ts:118, Vercel caps at 4.5MB). Impact is overstated: auth_attempts.key is a text primary key (schema.sql:944-950) and audit_logs.actor is btree-indexed (:189). A value past the btree row limit (about 2.7KB after compression) errors: reserveLoginAttempt then fails open (rate-limit.ts:391-394), but such an address cannot match a real account, and the per-IP budget (admin-login-ip) is counted first. So the worst case is error pages or moderately large audit rows, rate-limited per IP.
fix: giris/actions.ts: reject an email over 254 chars or without '@' before signInAdmin (no new dependency needed). Optionally truncate actor/entityId in logAudit.
fix_original: Validate with zod (email, max 254) before signInAdmin; truncate actor/entityId in logAudit.

title: After re-login the operator loses the filters / page they were on
evidence: proxy sets next = pathname only (query dropped); requireRole redirects to /admin/giris with no next when the cookie signature is valid but the account check fails (revoked, reset, DB blip).
impact: An expired or revoked session on a filtered list returns to the unfiltered list or to the dashboard.
verdict_note: proxy.ts:104-106 clones nextUrl, which keeps the original search, and sets next=pathname. The query is lost from `next`, AND the original query (e.g. ?q=<customer e-mail>) stays on the /admin/giris URL, which GTM sees per SHE-02. requireRole (auth.ts:487-488) redirects without `next`.
fix: proxy.ts: `url.search = ''` and then `url.searchParams.set('next', path + request.nextUrl.search)`. The login action and page already require startsWith('/admin') (giris/actions.ts:53, page.tsx:20). Optionally pass `next` from requireRole when the path is known.
fix_original: Use pathname + search for next in proxy.ts; pass next from requireRole when the request path is known.

title: A refused login wipes the typed e-mail (React 19 form auto-reset)
evidence: LoginForm uses `<form action={formAction}>` with useActionState. react-dom 19.2.4 startHostTransition calls requestFormReset$1(formFiber) before every form action (node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js:5263-5276), whatever the result. The email input is uncontrolled with no defaultValue, so after 'E-posta veya şifre hatalı' both fields are empty. The repo already knows this: action-form.tsx:206-210 explains why ActionForm dispatches by hand. The 2FA forms reset too, which is harmless for a code.
impact: Every mistyped password makes the operator retype the e-mail on the köşk phone. Same root cause as the 'React 19 form reset on refused saves' findings in other areas.
fix: Dispatch by hand as ActionForm does (onSubmit with preventDefault, then startTransition(() => formAction(new FormData(form)))). Or return the email in LoginState and render `defaultValue={state.email}`. Never echo the password.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Çıkış fails when the audit insert fails, leaving the session signed in
evidence: logoutAction awaits logAudit(...) before signOutAdmin(). logAudit throws on any failure (audit.ts:84-103: nextSeq raises via raiseDbError in db/counters.ts:16-19, and the insert error throws). With the database unreachable, an env break-glass account still has a session (currentAccount falls back to env, auth.ts:215-221), so logAudit throws, the action errors, and the cookie is never deleted. audit.ts:105-128 already provides safeAudit for writes that must not depend on the audit row.
impact: On a shared köşk device the operator presses Çıkış, sees an error, and the panel stays signed in. Narrow trigger: DB down or audit insert failing.
fix: In src/app/admin/actions.ts, call signOutAdmin() first (or regardless), then use `safeAudit` for the logout row, then redirect('/admin/giris').
root_cause_fix: safeAudit after a write that already landed (kasa, customer stamps, logout, settings ok()).

title: Manual order 'Vazgeç' is a button inside a link; every 'Kaldır' has the same name
evidence: `<Link href="/admin/siparisler"><GhostButton type="button">Vazgeç</GhostButton></Link>` (317-319): invalid nesting, two tab stops (measured), no navigation before hydration (button activation wins). Line 'Kaldır' buttons all aria-label 'Satırı kaldır', disabled with no reason when only one line (211-219).
impact: Keyboard/screen-reader users hit a double stop and ambiguous buttons.
verdict_note: manual-order-form.tsx:317-319 nests GhostButton inside Link: invalid, two tab stops, and the button swallows activation before hydration. 211-219: every remove button has aria-label 'Satırı kaldır' and is disabled with no reason when only one line is left.
fix: `<Link href="/admin/siparisler" className={BUTTON.ghost}>Vazgeç</Link>`; aria-label `${n}. satırı kaldır` (or the product name).
fix_original: `<Link className={BUTTON.ghost}>Vazgeç</Link>`; aria-label with the line number/product.
root_cause_fix: 'Vazgeç' is a Link styled with BUTTON.ghost, never a <button> inside <a>.

title: Manual order started as 'Ödendi' records no payment method or payment row
evidence: insertOrderRow only sets paidAt for a paid/preparing manual order (store.ts:2233-2236); 'Ödendi olarak işaretle' asks 'Nasıl ödendi?' and writes a manual:<method> payment row (store.ts:4628-4668). The order page then says 'Bu siparişte ödeme kaydı yok.' (order-detail.tsx:282-285).
impact: Cash vs card-terminal vs transfer is unknown for counter/phone sales; payment section looks empty.
verdict_note: insertOrderRow only sets paidAt for a paid or preparing manual start (store.ts:2234-2236). No manual:<method> payment row, unlike markOrderPaidManually (store.ts:4640-4668), so PaymentSection says 'Bu siparişte ödeme kaydı yok.' (order-detail.tsx:282-285). Refunds still work: collected comes from paidAt in moneyFrom (store.ts:3783-3796).
fix: When the start status is paid or preparing, require 'Nasıl ödendi?' (ManualPaymentMethod) in the manual form and write the same manual payment row right after the insert. Never write one for pending_payment.
fix_original: Ask 'Nasıl ödendi?' in the manual form when the start status is paid/preparing and write the same manual payment row.

title: Three different 'open orders' numbers
evidence: 'Açık' tab = pending_payment+paid+preparing+shipped (order-filters.ts:102-107); nav badge (countOpenOrders, store.ts:1333-1337) and dashboard 'Aktif sipariş' (store.ts:5082) exclude shipped; the badge links to Tümü (app/admin/layout.tsx:147).
impact: Badge says 5, 'Açık' says 8; clicking the badge does not show what it counts.
verdict_note: Two numbers, not three. The badge (countOpenOrders, OPEN_ORDER_STATUSES store.ts:1332-1336) and the dashboard (store.ts:5082) both count pending/paid/preparing, and the badge tooltip says so (admin-sidebar.tsx:260). The Açık tab adds shipped (order-filters.ts:102-107). The badge links to /admin/siparisler (Tümü).
fix: Export one OPEN_ORDER_STATUSES constant from order-filters.ts and use it for the tab, badge and dashboard, or keep the sets and link the badge to a view that matches. Link the badge with ?durum=acik.
fix_original: One shared constant; link the badge to /admin/siparisler?durum=acik.

title: Consent IP address and browser string shown to Personel
evidence: ConsentSection renders accepted.ip and accepted.userAgent with no role check on a page gated `orders` (incl. staff); the CSV leaves consent evidence out on purpose (csv/route.ts:33-36).
impact: Personal data shown to a role that does not need it for the shift.
verdict_note: ConsentSection renders accepted.ip and accepted.userAgent (order-detail.tsx:546-558) on a page gated `orders` (staff included). The CSV deliberately leaves consent evidence out (csv/route.ts:33-36).
fix: Pass canSeeEvidence = canAccess('customers', role) from [id]/page.tsx into OrderDetail and ConsentSection. Otherwise show 'Kayıtlı' for IP and browser. Stored data is unchanged (legal evidence kept).
fix_original: Show IP/user agent only when canAccess('customers') (owner/manager); otherwise 'Kayıtlı'.

title: Manual order form gets stock for each product/variant but never shows it or blocks sold-out choices
evidence: yeni/page.tsx:20-35 passes `stock` for products and variants. ManualProduct and ManualProductVariant declare it, but the form never reads it. Options show only name and price (145, 166-170), and qty allows 1-99 regardless. Out-of-stock lines are found only by the server refusal 'Yetersiz stok' (siparisler/actions.ts:545-548), which also wipes the customer block and resets the status to Ödendi (ORD-03).
impact: Operators routinely hit the refusal path that loses their typing and can turn a later submit into a wrongly paid order.
fix: Show '(stok: N)' in each option, disable options with stock 0, cap qty at the chosen product or variant's stock, and keep the server check as the authority.

title: Sticky 'N yeni sipariş' banner slides under the sticky mobile top bar
evidence: Banner `sticky top-2 z-20` (orders-list.tsx:349); mobile top bar `sticky top-0 z-30`, 61px tall (admin-sidebar.tsx:425). Measured at 390px: banner 106px tall, so once stuck its top 53px (the '2 yeni sipariş geldi...' sentence) are behind the bar; applies below lg.
impact: On phones/tablets the arrival message is hidden; only a floating 'Listeyi yenile' button shows.
verdict_note: Banner is `sticky top-2 z-20`, measured 106px at 390 (orders-list.tsx:349). The mobile top bar is `sticky top-0 z-30 lg:hidden`, 61px (admin-sidebar.tsx:425). Once stuck, the banner's top ~53px (the sentence) is under the bar. The 'Listeyi yenile' button stays visible and it only happens below lg, so downgraded to low.
fix: Banner `top-[4.25rem] lg:top-2` in orders-list.tsx:349.
fix_original: Use `top-[4.25rem] lg:top-2` (or z-40) for the banner, or raise arrivals through the toast stack.

title: Order page 'Müşteri' and 'Teslimat adresi' cards are the old look inside the kit page
evidence: Uses legacy Card + 10px grey mono titles (text-neutral-500, measured 4.74:1, 197-206) next to kit Section titles (16px semibold #2C1D11); neutral-50/300/400/600/800 colours; rounded-full pill buttons ('Düzenle' 36px tall, 136-142; 'Vazgeç' 114); red-50/200/700 error box (98); rounded-md bg-neutral-50 inputs (94, 233). Save shows no toast (state only). 'Teslimat adresi' card (181-192) duplicates the kit 'Teslimat' section (order-detail.tsx:323-386) and says 'Teslimat adresi yok. Düzenle ile ekleyebilirsin.' on pickup/table orders.
impact: Two visual languages on one page; the right column looks unfinished; saving gives no confirmation.
verdict_note: order-customer-editor.tsx uses the legacy Card, 10px neutral-500 titles, rounded-full neutral-300 pill buttons, red-* error box and rounded-md neutral-50 inputs (59-237), and no toast on save. Contrast passes (neutral-500 4.74:1), so it is purely visual: low. The 'duplicates the kit Teslimat section' claim is wrong: DeliverySection (order-detail.tsx:323-386) has no address, the two complement each other. The 'Teslimat adresi yok. Düzenle ile ekleyebilirsin.' copy on pickup/table orders is real (188-190).
fix: Rebuild with kit Section/KeyValueGrid, forms TextInput/Textarea and BUTTON variants, toast.fromResult on save. Show the address inside the 'Teslimat' section only for shipping/delivery orders.
fix_original: Rebuild as a Section with KeyValueGrid, kit TextInput/Textarea and BUTTON variants, toast on save, and move the address into the 'Teslimat' section.

title: Kasa camera reticle does not mark the decoded square on landscape cameras and is clipped
evidence: Reticle = 78% of the box WIDTH, square (camera-scanner.tsx:318-330); decoded square = 78% of the frame's SHORT edge (scan-engine.ts:69-80); box maxHeight 340 + object-fit cover (305-311). iPad landscape / laptop (card ~670px, 1280x720 stream): reticle 523px, taller than the 340px box so its top and bottom edges are cut off; the decoded square is only 294px on screen. Comment at 312-313 says the reticle is exact; that holds only for portrait phones.
impact: On the till device the code calls likeliest (iPad, often landscape) a QR held inside the drawn frame but outside the middle 294px is never read; the frame shows only two vertical bars.
verdict_note: The reticle is 78% of the box width, square (camera-scanner.tsx:318-330), in a video with maxHeight 340 and object-fit cover (305-311). The decoded square is 78% of the frame's short edge (scan-engine.ts:69-80). Math for a 670px card and a 1280x720 stream: scale 0.523, decoded square 294px on screen, reticle 523px, clipped by the 340px box. Exact on portrait phones (254 vs 254). Scanning still works in the centre and nothing is lost, so low.
fix: Size the reticle from the visible video: 0.78 x min(sourceW, sourceH) x the object-fit scale, read from videoWidth/videoHeight and the element rect. Or decode the region the reticle covers.
fix_original: Size the reticle from the visible video rect (0.78 x shorter visible side, accounting for object-fit crop) or decode the region the reticle actually covers.

title: Order page turns read failures into 'Kayıt yok' / 'e-posta kaydı yok'
evidence: orNothing returns [] on error; the page then shows 'Kayıt yok.' in Zaman çizelgesi (order-detail.tsx:589-595) and 'Bu sipariş için e-posta kaydı yok.' (414-417), which also hides every 'Yeniden gönder' button.

(order-detail.tsx:414-417) shows and the resend buttons disappear. The timeline part does not: orderTimeline always adds the created stage plus paidAt/shippedAt stages (order-timeline.ts:198-217), so 'Kayıt yok.' never appears. Audit-derived rows (notes, refunds, attention) just vanish with no warning.
fix: Return {rows, failed} from orNothing and show 'E-posta kaydı okunamadı, sayfayı yenile.' and an 'Olay kaydı okunamadı' note above the timeline when failed.
fix_original: Return a failed flag and show 'Olay kaydı / e-posta kaydı okunamadı, sayfayı yenile.'
plan_note: Timeline 'Kayıt yok' part refuted; mail part and silent audit-row loss fixed.

title: Copy errors and inconsistencies
evidence: 'İçsel not (opsiyonel)' (manual-order-form.tsx:300) vs 'İç not' on the order page; 'opsiyonel' (259, 267, 271, 296; till-console.tsx:131) vs 'isteğe bağlı' (order-actions-ui.tsx:456, 716); English placeholder 'SUMMER25' (297); 'Hazır - teslime hazır' says ready twice (lib/admin/order-channel.ts:70); 'Kargoda / Hazır' for courier/table orders (order-actions-ui.tsx:932, order-ui.ts:30); Italian 'buon appetito!' and Title Case 'Sipariş Fişi' on the printed receipt (order-detail.tsx:643, 764); eyebrow 'E-ticaret' on a list of café/app orders (siparisler/page.tsx:106, yeni/page.tsx:40) while the nav group is 'Satış'; the attention band tells Personel to use 'Dikkat işaretini kaldır', which needs the refunds role ([id]/page.tsx:140-142, order-actions.ts:388). No U+2013/U+2014 in orders files.
impact: Mixed register and wording; one instruction staff cannot follow.
verdict_note: Real: 'İçsel not (opsiyonel)' (manual-order-form.tsx:300) vs 'İç not' (order-detail.tsx:608). 'opsiyonel' (259,267,271,296; till-console.tsx:131) vs 'isteğe bağlı' (order-actions-ui.tsx:451,711). 'SUMMER25' placeholder (297). 'Hazır - teslime hazır' (order-channel.ts:70). 'Kargoda / Hazır' bulk label (order-actions-ui.tsx:925). Eyebrow 'E-ticaret' (page.tsx:106, yeni/page.tsx:40). The attention band tells everyone to use 'Dikkat işaretini kaldır' ([id]/page.tsx:140-142), which staff see disabled (needs refunds). fix_original: Unify to 'İç not' and 'isteğe bağlı', Turkish placeholder, 'Teslime hazır', 'Sipariş fişi', Turkish receipt footer, eyebrow 'Satış', role-aware band text.

title: 'Ses' toggle double-states; customer order table header is a bare '-'

title: Masalar card rows mix 12 px links and 16 px buttons that are meant to look the same
evidence: linkButton has text-xs on <a> ('SVG indir', 'Düzenle', 'Yazdır (2)') and applies (12px); ConfirmButton/ActionButton/GhostButton get className='text-xs' but are <button>s and inherit 16px (globals.css 267-274). Harness at 390 and 1280: 'SVG indir' 12px, 'Düzenle' 12px, 'Bağlantıyı kopyala' 16px, 'Pasifleştir' 16px, 'Kodu yenile' 16px, 'Etkinleştir' 16px, all the same ghost look in one row; header 'Yazdır (2)' 12px next to '+ Yeni masa' 14px/500 (out/tables-owner-*.json).
impact: Every table card shows two text sizes in one button row; looks broken.
verdict_note: Confirmed. masalar/page.tsx:17-18 linkButton `text-xs` on <a>/<Link> applies (12px). ConfirmButton/ActionButton className='text-xs' (69-90) and CopyTableLink GhostButton text-xs (table-row-actions.tsx:13) are <button>s, and globals.css:267-274 `font: inherit` overrides them. Cosmetic only, so medium is too high. Same root cause as KAR-04: once KAR-04 is fixed, all of them render at 12px.
fix: Fix KAR-04 first. Then use one size per row: BUTTON.ghost (text-sm) for the links and drop the text-xs overrides in masalar/page.tsx and table-row-actions.tsx.
fix_original: One size for the row: render the links with BUTTON.ghost (text-sm) and drop the text-xs overrides; KAR-04's override makes the buttons honour it.
root_cause_fix: globals.css admin-root rule gains `font: revert-layer`; unlayered `[data-admin-root] :is(button:disabled,[aria-disabled=true])` gets cursor:not-allowed. No `cursor: revert-layer` (Tailwind 4.3.3 preflight has no button pointer).

title: 'Fiyat ve ön ödeme: Ayarlar → Karaoke' lands on the Genel tab; managers are pointed at an owner-only page
evidence: The link is href='/admin/ayarlar'; SettingsForm starts with useState('general') and the page reads no searchParams, so there is no way to open the Karaoke tab directly. The Karaoke kuralları intro (mobileApp: owner+manager) says 'Saatlik ücret ve kapasite Ayarlar → Karaoke'de', but /admin/ayarlar is owner-only.
impact: The promised destination is one more click away; a manager is told to edit prices on a page that bounces them.
verdict_note: Confirmed. karaoke/page.tsx:130-135 links to href='/admin/ayarlar'. settings-form.tsx:53 is useState<TabId>('general') and ayarlar/page.tsx reads no searchParams. app-config-form.tsx:416 points managers (mobileApp: owner+manager) at Ayarlar → Karaoke, but roles.ts:93 has settings: ['owner'].

title: Past evenings still offer İptal et / İptal et ve iade et and mail the customer; the server also confirms a past request
evidence: Cancel is offered for any non-cancelled row without the `ended` check that confirm has (406 vs 417-421). setReservationStatus cancels a pay-at-venue row and calls notifyReservationStatus (805) with no time check; the dialog copy says 'Saat boşa çıkar ve müşteriye iptal e-postası gider'. confirmReservationAction relies on the UI for `!ended`; setReservationStatus accepts confirming a requested row whatever its date.
impact: 'İptal et' on last week's booking mails the customer a cancellation after the evening; a crafted POST can confirm a past request and send a confirmation mail.
verdict_note: Confirmed. karaokeActionPlan offers cancel for any non-cancelled row with no ended check (lib/admin/karaoke-panel.ts:416-421), while confirm has one (406). For staff, cancelKaraokeReservation applies no lateness rule (karaoke-payment.ts:1388-1392 binds members only). The pay-at-venue path calls setReservationStatus(...,'cancelled') (1452-1453), which mails via notifyReservationStatus (karaoke.ts:805). confirmReservationAction (actions.ts:135-145) and setReservationStatus have no time check. The comment at karaoke.ts:688-692 itself calls 'a completed evening could be cancelled days later' a bug the transitions fix, but RESERVATION_TRANSITIONS still allows confirmed→cancelled. A refund for a past paid booking is by design (business cancellation, paid_unconfirmed_past text).
fix: Correction: put the ended check in confirmReservationAction only (app/admin/mobil/karaoke/actions.ts), not in setReservationStatus, because the payment's own confirmation also calls it (karaoke-payment.ts:895). For ended pay-at-venue bookings, cancel without the customer mail (pass a no-notify flag) and change the dialog copy. A new 'Gelmedi' status would reach the mobile API, so keep it additive or skip it.
fix_original: For ended bookings offer 'Gelmedi' (no mail) instead of plain cancel; reject confirm for ended bookings in confirmReservationAction / setReservationStatus.

title: Masa forms: a refusal wipes the typed name; a DB hiccup replaces the page with the panel error screen
evidence: useActionState + <form action> resets fields after any result. Harness with the real CafeTableForm and a refusal (out/form-tables-new.json, out/form-tables-edit.json): new typed 'Yeni ad 0' -> after ''; edit 'Yeni ad 0', 77 -> 'Pencere önü uzun masa…', 1 while the error shows. A DB error makes createCafeTable/updateCafeTable throw (raiseDbError), the action has no try/catch, and useActionState rethrows into app/admin/error.tsx.
impact: The operator retypes the name after every refusal; a one-second DB blip loses the form behind 'Bu ekran yüklenemedi.'
verdict_note: Confirmed. table-form.tsx:32-35 uses useActionState + <form action={formAction}>, so the React 19 reset applies (same root cause as KAR-02). createCafeTable/updateCafeTable/nextSeq throw through raiseDbError (cafe-tables.ts:61-63, counters.ts:19). createCafeTableAction/updateCafeTableAction (actions.ts:44-93) have no try/catch, so the error reaches app/admin/error.tsx. Refusals are rare because the client-side required/maxLength/min/max catch most input; the DB-throw path is the realistic one.
fix: Use ActionForm + runPanelAction (components/admin/action-form.tsx), which already converts a throw into PANEL_ACTION_FAILED and keeps the values. The redirect plus setAdminFlash success path can stay (runPanelAction rethrows redirect via unstable_rethrow).
fix_original: Use the ActionForm + runPanelAction pattern (inline error, values kept, success toast via flash).
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: The booking page fails entirely when its history (audit) read fails
evidence: listKaraokeAudit raises on a DB error and is awaited in the page's Promise.all with no catch; the list page guards the same table read (page.tsx 57-72, 'rather than taking the page down').
impact: A secondary read takes the whole booking page (and its money actions) down to the error screen.
verdict_note: Confirmed. karaoke/[id]/page.tsx:85-89 awaits listKaraokeAudit inside Promise.all with no catch. listKaraokeAudit raises on a DB error (karaoke-audit.ts:36-38). The list page guards the same table (page.tsx:57-72). Note that `audit` also feeds staffReleased/unverified (90-99), so a silent fallback would hide the rule-29 hint 'POS'a sorulamadan saat bırakıldı'.
fix: Wrap listKaraokeAudit in try/catch and fall back to []. Show 'Geçmiş okunamadı' in the Geçmiş section and, for an expired row, add a hint that the release state could not be checked (look in PayNkolay). File: app/admin/mobil/karaoke/[id]/page.tsx.
fix_original: try/catch around listKaraokeAudit; show 'Geçmiş okunamadı' in the Geçmiş section and keep the rest.

title: neutral-*/emerald-* palette and italic serif headings next to the kit

title: Empty state has no reset action; back link drops the tab and filters; only the first cell is clickable
evidence: EmptyState says 'Filtreleri değiştir ya da sıfırla.' without an action; the back link is the bare KARAOKE_PANEL_PATH; DataTable links only the first column's cell.

The EmptyState hint shows only when filters exist (page.tsx:189-193), and in that case FilterBar already renders a 'Sıfırla' link right above it (filter-bar.tsx:200-204, shown whenever chips.length > 0). So a reset action does exist. Still real: the back link is the bare KARAOKE_PANEL_PATH ([id]/page.tsx:260-265), and DataTable links only the first cell (data-table.tsx:339).

title: Raw slug under 'Belgeler', eyebrow 'Rezervasyon' vs sidebar 'Satış', mekân/köşk mix, comma-in-comma amount hint
evidence: 'Belgeler' prints consent.documents, i.e. the slug 'karaoke-odasi-rezervasyon' (lib/legal/meta.ts 57) in mono; eyebrow 'Rezervasyon' while the nav group is 'Satış'; 'Mekânda ödeme' and 'Eski mekânda ödeme talebi' while the rest says 'köşk'; Tutar hint '₺3.300,00, indirim ₺300,00'.

verdict_note: Confirmed. [id]/page.tsx:229-233 joins consent.documents, which is the slug KARAOKE_CONSENT_DOCS=['karaoke-odasi-rezervasyon'] (lib/legal/meta.ts:57). :190-193 hint is `${formatTRY(price)}, indirim …`. karaoke/page.tsx:121 has eyebrow 'Rezervasyon' while the nav group is 'Satış' (admin/layout.tsx). lib/admin/karaoke-panel.ts:198, 285 and 571 say 'Mekânda'/'mekânda' while the rest says 'köşk'.

fix_original: Map document slugs to titles (or link to /hukuk/<slug>), eyebrow 'Satış · Karaoke', one word for the venue, hint 'Liste ₺3.300,00 · indirim ₺300,00'.

title: Masalar buttons repeat the same name on every card; 'Kopyalandı' is not announced
evidence: 'Bağlantıyı kopyala', 'SVG indir', 'Düzenle', 'Pasifleştir', 'Kodu yenile' have no table-specific accessible name (only 'Etkinleştir' has ariaLabel, line 78; ConfirmButton has no ariaLabel prop). Copy feedback only changes the button text, no live region.
impact: Screen-reader users hear a list of identical buttons and get no confirmation of the copy.
verdict_note: Confirmed. ConfirmButtonProps (action-modal.tsx:446-479) has no ariaLabel. masalar/page.tsx:52-94 buttons and links carry no table name; only ActionButton 'Etkinleştir' has ariaLabel (78). CopyTableLink (table-row-actions.tsx:24-28) only swaps the button text and has no live region.
fix: Add an optional ariaLabel to ConfirmButton/ActionModal trigger (components/admin/ui/action-modal.tsx) and pass `${verb}: ${table.name}`. Add a visually hidden aria-live='polite' span in CopyTableLink.
fix_original: aria-labels with the table name (add ariaLabel to ConfirmButton), aria-live='polite' status for the copy result.
root_cause_fix: ConfirmButton/ActionModal trigger gets an optional ariaLabel ('Sil: <ad>'); callers pass it.

title: Masa forms have no back/cancel link; one table's card cannot be printed alone
evidence: Both form pages render PageHeader + form with only the submit button; the print page prints every active table.
impact: Leaving a form needs the sidebar or browser back; after 'Kodu yenile' the operator reprints every card or downloads the SVG.
verdict_note: Confirmed. masalar/yeni/page.tsx and [id]/duzenle/page.tsx render only PageHeader + CafeTableForm, with no back or cancel link. yazdir/page.tsx:36 prints every active table. Per-card 'SVG indir' is the existing workaround.
fix: Add a '← Masalar' link or 'Vazgeç'. Add a ?masa=<id> filter to yazdir/page.tsx and link it from each card.
fix_original: '← Masalar' link and 'Vazgeç'; a ?masa= filter on the print page linked from each card.

title: 5000-row in-memory list: older Dikkat items drop out and every request reads up to 5000 rows
evidence: listReservationsForAdmin orders newest day first with limit 5000; tabs, counts, search, sort and paging all run in memory on that set.
impact: Each click re-reads thousands of rows; past 5000 rows an old owed refund disappears from the Dikkat tab (the dashboard reads it separately).
verdict_note: Confirmed. KARAOKE_ADMIN_LIST_LIMIT=5000 (lib/mobile/karaoke.ts:609), with listReservationsForAdmin ordering and limiting at 618-631. Tabs, counts, search and paging run in memory (lib/admin/karaoke-panel.ts karaokeList). The page already shows a truncation note (page.tsx:225-230). Only a far-future risk for a single room.

fix_original: SQL-side filters and paging per tab, or a separate attention query for Dikkat.

title: addCounterStampAction stamps any client-supplied address with no member check
evidence: Gate is `orders` (Personel too); the e-mail comes from a client `.bind(null, email)` (customer-stamps.tsx:48), and the action never checks a member exists/is active, unlike the till (kasa/actions.ts:79-83). Uses throwing logAudit after the stamp (63-68).
impact: A crafted call writes stamp ledger rows for any address; an audit failure after the stamp shows the error page.
verdict_note: addCounterStampAction gates on `orders` (staff included) while its only UI, the customer page, needs `customers` (musteriler/[email]/page.tsx:94). The e-mail is a client-bound argument (customer-stamps.tsx:48). There is no member existence or isActive check, unlike kasa/actions.ts:79-83. Throwing logAudit runs after the stamp (63-68), the same root cause as ORD-12.
fix: Gate on `customers` (or keep `orders` and check it), look the member up with getCustomerByEmail and refuse a missing or closed account, and use safeAudit.
fix_original: Look up the member (getCustomerByEmail, isActive) before stamping; use safeAudit.
plan_note: Owned by PEOPLE because the file is musteriler/[email]/actions.ts.

title: Actions that answer nothing, claim success blindly, or throw to the full-page error
evidence: deleteCampaignMailAction returns void; removed===false (no longer a draft) and DB errors give no message (DeleteRowForm has no state). deactivateNewsletterAction ignores the write (deactivateNewsletterSubscriber returns void) and always answers "Abone pasif". updateCustomerAction and createCampaignMailAction redirect without setAdminFlash (no success toast). CustomerForm, PromoForm, CustomerCoupons, CustomerStamps, user-forms and DeleteRowForm call actions via bare useActionState / form action: a thrown store error (grantCoupon coupons.ts:304, addCounterStamp loyalty.ts:863, users.ts checkErr) replaces the page with the error boundary, unlike runPanelAction (action-form.tsx:50-61).
impact: The operator cannot tell whether a delete happened; a stale tab is told "done"; a DB hiccup during "Kupon tanımla" discards the page.
verdict_note: Confirmed. deleteCampaignMailAction returns void (kampanya/actions.ts:219-234). deactivateNewsletterAction always answers 'Abone pasif' (bulten/actions.ts:30-38), and deactivateNewsletterSubscriber returns void (newsletter/store.ts:326-340). updateCustomerAction (musteriler/actions.ts:79) and createCampaignMailAction (kampanya/actions.ts:166-168) redirect without setAdminFlash. Bare useActionState forms send thrown store errors to admin/error.tsx; ConfirmButton/ActionModal catch them (action-modal.tsx:269-279). Same root cause A as PEO-02/09.
fix: setAdminFlash before both redirects; make deactivateNewsletterSubscriber return whether a row changed (.select('id')) and answer an error when not; route PEOPLE forms through runPanelAction/ActionForm (merge with PEO-02).
fix_original: Answer ActionResult from these actions, setAdminFlash before redirects, route all PEOPLE forms through runPanelAction / ActionForm / ConfirmButton.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

Style the Link itself with BUTTON.ghost (ui/styles.ts); render Checkbox without Field; use KeyValueGrid or

title: Coupon grant 'Min. sepet' has no ceiling: integer overflow throws to the panel error page
evidence: minMinor = parseMoneyInput(minText) is checked only for null (171-176), and value is capped only for fixed kind (193). customer_coupons.minSubtotalMinor is integer (db/schema.sql:570). '25.000.000' becomes 2.500.000.000 kuruş, Postgres raises 22003, and grantCoupon throws (lib/customer/coupons.ts:296-305). The form is bare useActionState (customer-coupons.tsx:39,112), so the throw reaches admin/error.tsx. Same family as PEO-06 and PEO-16.
impact: A slipped key in Min. sepet discards the member page instead of naming the field.
fix: Refuse minMinor > CATALOG_MONEY_MAX_MINOR (lib/utils/format.ts:83) with 'Tutar en fazla 1.000.000 TL olabilir.'; catch grantCoupon errors and answer {error} (or merge into the PEO-02 runPanelAction move).

title: updatePromo writes the whole promo row back, including a stale usageCount, losing concurrent redemptions
evidence: updatePromo reads `existing = await getPromo(id)` (5628), runs a conflict query, then `update(next)` where next = {...existing, …} (5642-5656). That write includes usageCount from the earlier read. Redemptions increment usageCount atomically in the DB (redeem_promo RPC, store.ts:5741-5751), and cancellations decrement it (release_promo_usage). A redemption landing between the read and the write is overwritten. The path is dormant today only because PEO-01 crashes the edit page; fixing PEO-01 re-enables it.
impact: A limited code can be used one or more times past its usageLimit (or never get a cancelled use back) when edited while orders come in.
fix: Build the update payload from the editable fields only (code, kind, value, minSubtotalMinor, usageLimit, expiresAt, isActive, updatedAt), never usageCount, id or createdAt; return the row via .select('*'). Ship it with the PEO-01 fix.

evidence: "Lifetime value" ×5; source label "Footer"; template "Happy hour" while the app settings tab says "Mutlu saatler"; the app-links error shows NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_STORE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAY_STORE_URL to the operator; birthday printed raw ISO ("1990-05-14"); "Bana test gönder" although other panel addresses are allowed. evidence: The tile uses customerLifetime(orders) (reportable orders only); the heading counts orders.length including abandoned checkouts and cancellations; nothing on the page explains the rule (only the list page description does).

title: Newsletter list: no search, tabs, paging or phone layout; consent proof only in a hover tooltip
evidence: Every subscriber row is read (lib/newsletter/store.ts:308-318) into one table: no search, no Aktif/Onay bekliyor/Pasif tabs (counts only as tiles), no paging, no bulk actions, no export with consent evidence (only a textarea of active e-mails, 51-57). Replica at 390 px: table 681 px wide in a 324 px scroller, "Sil" starts at x=665. The 6563 consent wording exists only as `title={s.consentText}` (124).

title: Promo list has no tabs, search, sort or usage view; past expiry dates accepted silently
evidence: listPromos returns every code into DataTable without sort, StatusTabs, FilterBar or Pagination; no view of which orders used a code; no bulk pause/delete. promo-schema only checks that expiresAt parses (a past date is accepted); grantCustomerCouponAction accepts a past date and answers "Kupon tanımlandı" for a coupon born expired.

title: A thrown error during a catalog save replaces the page with the error screen and drops the operator's input
evidence: These forms call the server action directly, without runPanelAction (action-form.tsx:50-61), which is what turns a thrown error (such as a check() failure or a database timeout) into an in-place message elsewhere in the panel.
impact: A database hiccup wipes a five-step product with its photos, or the bulk selection, and shows the generic error page.
verdict_note: product-wizard.tsx:138 calls useActionState(action) with a raw server action. products-list.tsx:72-85 and menu-list.tsx:40-53 call bulkProductsAction and bulkMenuAction directly. slide-form.tsx:131 is a bare form. None go through runPanelAction (action-form.tsx:50-61), so a thrown check()/raiseDbError reaches admin/error.tsx and the input is lost. Same root cause as CAT-01 and CAT-13 (RC-A).
fix: Wrap the wizard's and the bulk callbacks' action calls in try/catch with unstable_rethrow, returning PANEL_ACTION_FAILED in place, or route them through runPanelAction. The hero form is covered by the CAT-13 move to ActionForm.
fix_original: Route these forms through runPanelAction or ActionForm and show the FAILED message in place.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: The automatic SKU is always '-00001' and drops Turkish initials
evidence: skuFromName always uses n = 1, and the form always posts the prefilled value, so the server's unique deriveSku(name, seq) never runs. There is no unique index on sku. Proof in Chrome: 'Espresso Fincanı' and 'Espresso Blend 1 kg' both became ESPR-00001, 'Çay Bardağı' became AYBA-00001 and 'Şeker Kutusu' became EKER-00001.
impact: Products get duplicate stock codes, and the codes do not match the product names.
verdict_note: product-wizard.tsx:88-95: skuFromName always uses n=1 and strips non-ASCII letters. Verified in node: 'Espresso Fincanı' and 'Espresso Blend 1 kg' both give ESPR-00001, 'Çay Bardağı' gives AYBA-00001 and 'Şeker Kutusu' gives EKER-00001. The prefilled value is posted, so createProduct's `input.sku || deriveSku(name, seq)` (store.ts:1011) never derives. schema.sql has no sku index.
fix: Leave sku empty unless typed (show the would-be code as a placeholder), so the server derives it with seq. Fold Turkish letters in both deriveSku and skuFromName (reuse the TR map).
fix_original: Leave SKU empty unless the operator types one, so the server derives it from the sequence, and fold Turkish letters the way slugify does.

title: Bulk deletes and updates are logged without saying what they touched
evidence: The bulk logAudit payload is {op, value, updated, idCount}, with no entityId, ids or names. The hero delete is logged with its id only, not its title.
impact: Olay kaydı cannot show which products or menu items an irreversible bulk delete removed.
verdict_note: urunler/actions.ts:215-219 and menu/actions.ts:325-329 log bulk payloads {op, value, updated, idCount} with no entityId or ids. magaza-hero/actions.ts:88 logs the delete with the id only (no title; the slide is gone afterwards).
fix: Log ids (capped) and names in the payload, or one audit row per record. Read the slide before deleting so its title can be logged.
fix_original: Log the ids and names, or write one audit row per record.

title: Update actions report success for a record that no longer exists
evidence: updateProduct returns null when the product is gone, but the action ignores it and still flashes '... kaydedildi' and writes an audit row. updateSlideAction does the same. The menu and category actions already refuse in this case (menu/actions.ts:225, kategoriler/actions.ts:104).

fix_original: Return actionError('Bu ürün silinmiş; listeye dön.') when the update finds no row, as the menu and category actions do.

title: A variant row without a name is dropped on save, together with its stock and price
evidence: variantsJson returns null for a variant whose name is empty, so the row disappears without an error. The wizard still shows the row, and its summary prints '?' for it.
impact: A variant the operator added (with stock and price filled in) silently does not exist after saving.
verdict_note: product-schema.ts:201-202: a variant with an empty trimmed name returns null and is filtered out (:233) with no issue. The wizard still shows the row, and the summary prints '?' (product-wizard.tsx:886-890).

fix_original: Refuse the save under 'Varyantlar' with a message such as '2. varyantın adını yaz.'

title: Weight defaults to 250 g 'for shipping' but is published to customers, and the low-stock hint hides its customer-facing effect
evidence: weightGrams starts at 250 for every new product, with the hint 'Kargo hesabı için.'. Shipping is a flat fee: computeShippingMinor (commerce.ts:22-34) never reads weight. The weight is shown as 'Ağırlık 250 g' on the PDP (product-detail.tsx:418) and emitted in the Product JSON-LD (structured-data.ts:658-664). The 'Düşük stok uyarısı' hint says 'Bu seviyenin altına düşünce admin tabloda turuncu görünür', but the same threshold shows customers '● Son N adet - acele et' (product-detail.tsx:222-223) and the 'Son N' card badge (ui.tsx:94-98, 123).
impact: A mug, apron or moka pot saved with the default publishes a false 250 g weight to customers and to Google. The operator sets a threshold not knowing it triggers an urgency badge in the shop.

title: The menu photo uploader sits inside a <label>, so clicks on the label, hint or caption open the file picker
evidence: <Field label='Fotoğraf'> renders a <label> that wraps the whole ImageUpload. The label's control is therefore the hidden file input. Proof in Chrome (#menu-yeni), counting clicks that reached the file input: hint text 1, the 'FOTOĞRAF' title 1, the 'URL ile ekle' caption 1, the dropzone 2. The URL field inside the label has labels.length 0. The label also contains other labelable elements, which is invalid HTML.
impact: The OS file dialog opens when the operator clicks near the URL field or on the hint text, and the dropzone triggers the picker twice.
verdict_note: menu-item-form.tsx:122-135: Field renders <label> around ImageUpload. The label's labeled control is its first labelable descendant, the hidden file input (image-upload.tsx:325-333), so clicks on the hint, the title or the 'URL ile ekle' caption activate the file picker. A click on the role=button dropzone fires its own inputRef.click() and then the label activation. The URL input has no label. It is an annoyance, not a blocker, so downgraded to low.
fix: menu-item-form.tsx: render ImageUpload outside Field, as the product wizard does, with its own heading id and aria-labelledby, and give the URL input an aria-label.
fix_original: Render ImageUpload outside Field, as the product wizard does, with its own heading and aria-labelledby.
root_cause_fix: forms.tsx gets a fieldset/legend variant of Field for groups that hold checkboxes or uploaders; Field itself stays a <label> (inputs keep their names).

title: The hero image URL and CTA are not validated, and the image goes into an unquoted CSS url()
evidence: parseInput accepts any string. Checked with React SSR (renderToString): url(https://cdn.example.com/hero (1).jpg) is emitted unchanged and is invalid CSS, so no image shows. An image URL ending in ');position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483647;background:#c00;(' is written verbatim into the style attribute. servedImage passes https URLs to the live slider unchanged.
impact: A URL containing a space, parenthesis or quote shows no image in the panel or the shop. An owner or manager can inject CSS into the storefront hero.
verdict_note: magaza-hero/actions.ts:21-35 parseInput accepts any imageUrl and ctaHref. normalizeSlide only trims and slices. The url() is unquoted in magaza-hero/page.tsx:49, slide-form.tsx:184 and :355, and shop-hero-slider.tsx:200-203. servedImage passes non-data URLs unchanged (image-url.ts:78-80). A space or ')' breaks the image, and ');…' injects declarations into the SSR style attribute (owner/manager only). The CTA is not an XSS: React 19 replaces javascript: hrefs.
fix: Server: accept imageUrl only as data:image/ (existing limits) or https: with no whitespace, quote or paren characters (or encodeURI them); accept ctaHref only as /path, #anchor or https:. Emit url("…") with CSS escaping (a shared helper) in all four places, the storefront slider included.
fix_original: Accept only https: URLs or uploads, and emit them quoted and escaped as url("..."). Validate the CTA as a /path or an https: URL.

fix: Add a total count and a 'son 500 hareket gösteriliyor' notice, then kit Pagination/FilterBar with a date range. CSV export is optional.
fix_original: Add kit Pagination and FilterBar (product, reason, date range), show the total count, and add a CSV export for owner and manager.
root_cause_fix: P2b: list screens move to DataTable + FilterBar + StatusTabs + Pagination + ActionMenu with server-side paging.

title: Product search misses the Turkish letters İ, I and ı
evidence: The search uses toLowerCase() without a locale. Checked in node: 'italyan' does not find 'İtalyan Kavrum Espresso', 'ırmak' does not find 'IRMAK Çekirdek', and 'FINDIK' does not find 'Fındık Kreması'. The search box then shows the lowercased query ('i̇talyan', with a combining dot).
impact: Common Turkish searches return 'Bu filtreyle ürün yok' for products that exist.
verdict_note: urunler/page.tsx:49 and :61-66 use a locale-free toLowerCase on the query and the fields. Verified in node: 'italyan' misses 'İtalyan…' (lowercases to i + U+0307), 'ırmak' misses 'IRMAK', and 'FINDIK' misses 'Fındık'. :112 echoes the lowercased q as defaultValue.
fix: Fold both sides the same way: toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR'), then map ı/İ/i̇ to i and strip combining marks. toLocaleLowerCase alone still makes 'irmak' miss 'IRMAK'. Keep the raw query for the input's defaultValue.
fix_original: Use toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR') on both sides and fold ı/i. Show the query as the operator typed it.
root_cause_fix: lib/admin/text-fold.ts foldTr(): toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR'), strip U+0307, map ı->i; SQL side uses translate() on both sides. Used by customers, products, global search.

title: Site Metinleri: a cleared field is saved as "" and blanks the live site / app copy; no way back to the default
evidence: icerik/actions.ts:21-24 keeps '' for an emptied field; lib/admin/site-content.ts:54-60 stores it; getSiteContent overlays it (35-38) despite its header promising the site 'never shows an empty string' (12-14). Consumers: components/laffogato/story-page.tsx:20 (content?.[k] ?? fallback keeps ''), home-page.tsx:237-238 (intro band disappears), lib/mobile/story.ts:61-67 (app founder card blank).

verdict_note: icerik/actions.ts:21-24 keeps ''. site-content.ts:54-60 stores it, and 35-38 overlays it despite the header comment at 12-14. story-page.tsx:20 keeps '' (?? fallback), so /hikaye loses its lede. lib/mobile/story.ts:61-67 blanks the founder card in the app. However, home-page.tsx:257-261 hides the intro band on an empty lede on purpose ('renders only when the panel has something to say'), so part of the impact is by design. title: Legal editor feedback: effectiveDate error never shown, field errors styled as hints, no success toast, <a><button>
evidence: hukuk/actions.ts:41-46 builds fieldErrors for every path, but legal-doc-form.tsx shows only title/summary/bodyMarkdown (44, 54, 67); an effectiveDate over 60 chars (no maxLength; legal-schema.ts:16 has no message) yields 'Formdaki uyarıları gider.' with nothing marked. title: Posts list says 'e-posta gönderildi' when the mail failed or reached nobody; a skipped mail gets no word
evidence: gonderiler/actions.ts:102 marks the post (setAppPostEmailCampaign) before startCampaignSend (109); if that throws, the catch (122-127) keeps the mark and returns failed; a queued send with total 0 also keeps it. page.tsx:128 prints ' · e-posta gönderildi' for any emailCampaignId. A ticked box on a scheduled/inactive post returns skipped (actions.ts:87-94) and listPathAfter (131-144) shows nothing.
impact: After a failed or empty send the list claims members were mailed, and the hook never fires again for that post, so the draft is easily forgotten. An operator who ticked and confirmed 'TÜM üyelere' on a scheduled post is not told nothing was sent.
verdict_note: gonderiler/page.tsx:128 prints ' · e-posta gönderildi' for any emailCampaignId. emailMembersForPost (actions.ts:96-127) keeps the mark on 'failed', and a zero-recipient queue keeps it too. The banner the save redirects to (page.tsx:32-72) does state 'kuyruğa alınamadı' or 'üye bulunamadı; e-posta çıkmadı' at that moment, and the confirm text and hint already say a scheduled post is not mailed. So only the lasting list label misleads: downgraded to low. The never-cleared mark is the idempotency guard (actions.ts:70-76) and must stay.
fix: Derive the list label from the campaign's own status (Taslak / Kuyrukta / Gönderildi, 0 alıcı) and link it to /admin/bulten/kampanya/<id>. Do not clear the mark. Optionally redirect with ?eposta=atlandi when the box was ticked but the post was not live.
fix_original: Derive the label from the campaign's state (Taslak / Kuyrukta / Gönderildi) linked to /admin/bulten/kampanya/<id>; return a 'yayında değil, e-posta gitmedi' notice for skipped when the box was ticked.

title: Inconsistent controls and colour sources: Düzenle vs Sil, Tailwind palette, faux-italic headings, six identical nav icons
evidence: 'Düzenle' link min-h-[40px] rounded-lg border-[var(--admin-border)] no fill next to ConfirmButton 'Sil' (BUTTON.danger 44px rounded-xl): slaytlar/page.tsx:130-142, duyurular/page.tsx:62-74, gonderiler/page.tsx:132-144. Tailwind neutral/emerald/amber/red/green instead of --admin-*/tone tokens on 43 lines across 12 files (e.g. icerik/content-form.tsx:26,54,59; hikaye/page.tsx:68; basin/page.tsx:63; canli-durum/page.tsx:38-49; gonderiler/page.tsx:35,48; hukuk/page.tsx:30-36,44,54,64; legal-doc-form.tsx:89; app-config-form.tsx:71,139-146,674). Six Mobil Uygulama entries share section mobileApp (layout.tsx:110-142) and NavIcon is keyed by section (admin-sidebar.tsx:182-197, 335).

fix_original: BUTTON.ghost for 'Düzenle' links, Badge/TONE_* for pills and banners, upright Poppins 600 section headings, an icon key per NavItemDef.

title: Uygulama ayarları tabs are not tabs (no role / aria-selected), hidden overflow on phones, no URL state
evidence: app-config-form.tsx:62-77: a nav of plain buttons; selected state only by colour (no role=tablist/tab, aria-selected, aria-controls, aria-current). On phones the row is overflow-x-auto with the scrollbar hidden ([scrollbar-width:none], [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden) and no cue, so about 2 of 9 tabs show at 390px. Tab is useState('version') (line 58), not in the URL.
impact: Screen-reader users are not told which section is open; phone users miss seven sections; reload/back always opens 'Sürüm ve bakım' and no page can deep-link a tab.
verdict_note: app-config-form.tsx:58 keeps the tab in useState('version'). Lines 62-77 are plain buttons with no role=tablist/tab or aria-selected; selection shows only as colour. Overflow-x-auto has a hidden scrollbar.
fix: Add tablist/tab/tabpanel roles with aria-selected and aria-controls, sync the tab with ?bolum= via useSearchParams and router.replace, and add a visible overflow cue or a Select below lg.
fix_original: Tablist with ARIA roles and a ?bolum= search param, a visible overflow cue (or a Select on phones).

title: Reminders: pattern invalid under the v flag (ignored), blank-id rows silently dropped, error does not name the row
evidence: app-config-form.tsx:546 pattern="[a-z0-9-]{1,24}": browsers compile pattern with the v flag; Node 22/V8 new RegExp('^(?:[a-z0-9-]{1,24})$','v') throws 'Invalid character class', so the attribute is ignored. mobil/ayarlar/actions.ts:290-292 skips rows with a blank Kimlik and still answers 'Kaydedildi'. Sales-word errors read 'Başlık: Hatırlatma metninde ...' (actions.ts:246-247, lib/mobile/app-config.ts:331-346) without the row number.
impact: A reminder written without a Kimlik (a developer concept) vanishes on save with a success message; with four rows the operator cannot tell which one was refused, and CON-03 resets all four.
verdict_note: Verified in Node 22.11: new RegExp('^(?:[a-z0-9-]{1,24})$','v') throws 'Invalid character class', so pattern at app-config-form.tsx:546 is ignored. The server regex still guards. Rows with a blank id are skipped (actions.ts:288-292), though the hint at app-config-form.tsx:540 says so. Sales-word errors carry no row number. Combined with R-RESET (CON-03), one refusal resets all four rows.
fix: Use pattern="[a-z0-9\-]{1,24}". The JSX string keeps the backslash, which is valid under both v and u. Refuse a row that has a title or body but no id ('Hatırlatma 2: kimlik yaz'). Prefix messages with 'Hatırlatma n'.
fix_original: pattern="[a-z0-9\-]{1,24}"; refuse a row with title/body but no id ('Hatırlatma 2: kimlik yaz') or derive the id from the title; prefix messages with 'Hatırlatma n'.

title: Save results not announced, repeated 'Sil' / 'Kaydet' / 'Düzenle' without context, h1 → h3
evidence: Result text without role=status/aria-live: icerik/content-form.tsx:53-62, mobil/canli-durum/venue-status-form.tsx:157-167, mobil/ayarlar/app-config-form.tsx:140-151, legal-doc-form.tsx:88-92. Rows repeat 'Kaydet'/'Sil' (hikaye/page.tsx:63,69-75; basin/page.tsx:58,64-70) or 'Düzenle'/'Sil' (three app lists) with no aria-label naming the item (ConfirmButton has no ariaLabel prop, ui/action-modal.tsx:446-479); hukuk repeats 'Önizle ↗ / Varsayılana döndür / Düzenle'. Headings jump h1→h3: content-form.tsx:26, hikaye/page.tsx:94, basin/page.tsx:89.
impact: Screen-reader users hear nothing after Kaydet and a list of identical 'Sil, düğme'.
verdict_note: No role=status or aria-live at content-form.tsx:53-62, venue-status-form.tsx:157-167, app-config-form.tsx:140-151 or legal-doc-form.tsx:88-92. ConfirmButton has no aria-label prop (action-modal.tsx:493-507). Rows repeat 'Kaydet'/'Sil' (hikaye/page.tsx:63,69-75). Headings jump h1→h3 (content-form.tsx:26, hikaye/page.tsx:94, basin/page.tsx:89).
fix: Add role=status on result lines and role=alert on errors, an ariaLabel prop on ConfirmButton passed to the trigger ('Sil: <başlık>'), and h2 for card titles.
fix_original: role=status on result lines (role=alert for errors), an ariaLabel prop on ConfirmButton ('Sil: <başlık>'), h2 for card titles.
root_cause_fix: ConfirmButton/ActionModal trigger gets an optional ariaLabel ('Sil: <ad>'); callers pass it.

title: Copy leftovers: 'Story', raw tone keys, 'karar 20' dead switch, 'Founder & Roaster', owner-only hints, 'hemen kalkar' vs 60 s cache
evidence: hikaye/page.tsx:90 'Story sayfasındaki ...'; mobil/slaytlar/page.tsx:103 prints raw tone keys (PREMIUM/INVERSE/BRAND/PAPER) while the meta line uses Turkish labels; app-config-form.tsx:637-641 'ABONELİK kartı - şu an hiçbir ekranda çizilmiyor (karar 20)' (internal decision number, switch that changes nothing on current builds); content-fields.ts:55 default 'Founder & Roaster'; app-config-form.tsx:416 and venue-status-form.tsx:72 send managers to owner-only 'Ayarlar → Karaoke / Saatler'; delete dialogs say 'hemen' (slaytlar/page.tsx:141, duyurular/page.tsx:73, gonderiler/page.tsx:143) and toasts 'uygulamadan kalktı' while /api/mobile/v1/app-content is s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=600 (app-content/route.ts:71); 'Yasal Belgeler' (hukuk/page.tsx:21) vs sidebar 'Yasal belgeler'; 'kodlu varsayılan' jargon (hukuk/page.tsx:22, [slug]/page.tsx:45).

verdict_note: All quoted strings are present on cf30307: hikaye/page.tsx:90 'Story sayfasındaki', slaytlar/page.tsx:103 raw tone key, app-config-form.tsx:637-641 '(karar 20)', content-fields.ts:55 'Founder & Roaster', app-config-form.tsx:416 and venue-status-form.tsx:72 pointing managers to owner-only Ayarlar (roles.ts:94 settings:[owner], 73 mobileApp includes manager), and 'hemen' while app-content/route.ts:71 sends s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=600.

fix_original: Turkish page names, tone labels in the swatch, drop '(karar 20)' (hide the switch or say 'eski sürümler için'), Turkish default title, show Ayarlar hints only to roles that can open it, 'birkaç dakika içinde kalkar'.
