title: A post save mass-mails members under the mobileApp gate, not newsletter (same roles today)
evidence: gonderiler/actions.ts:147 requireRole('mobileApp') then emailMembersForPost → createCampaignEmail + startCampaignSend (157-161, 97-109). Campaign pages require newsletter (bulten/kampanya/actions.ts); app/admin/layout.tsx:158-159 states composing a commercial mail is newsletter trust.
impact: No escalation today (both sections are owner, manager); granting mobileApp to Personel (e.g. for Canlı durum) would let staff mass-mail every consenting member.
verdict_note: gonderiler/actions.ts:147 and 168 gate on requireRole('mobileApp'), then createCampaignEmail and startCampaignSend (97-109). Campaign pages require newsletter. Both sections are owner and manager today (roles.ts:73,83), so there is no escalation now; the risk is latent.
fix: In the create and update actions, mail only when canAccess('newsletter', session.role). Otherwise return skipped, and hide or disable the e-mail box for roles without newsletter (pass a prop from the page).
fix_original: Also require canAccess('newsletter', session.role) before mailing and hide the e-mail box for roles without it.

title: Legal Markdown box at 13px (iOS zoom), 'mono' fields are Poppins, version field opens a decimal pad
evidence: legal-doc-form.tsx:76 style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--mono, monospace)', fontSize: 13 }}: inline 13px beats the 16px iOS guard (globals.css:5577-5593). --mono is var(--sans) (Poppins) at :root, so Markdown, Apple Team ID and SHA-256 fields (app-config-form.tsx:829, 841) are proportional. Version field inputMode='decimal' (app-config-form.tsx:209): iOS decimal pad shows the region separator (',' in Turkey), not '.' (known iOS behaviour, not tried on a device).
impact: iOS Safari zooms into the legal editor; fingerprints do not line up for checking; a Turkish-region iPhone cannot type '1.2.0'.
verdict_note: legal-doc-form.tsx:76 sets inline fontSize 13, which beats the unlayered 16px iOS guard (globals.css:5578-5593). --mono is var(--sans) (globals.css:136), so the 'mono' Markdown, Team ID and SHA fields (app-config-form.tsx:829,841) are Poppins. The inputMode='decimal' claim (app-config-form.tsx:209) is iOS behaviour and was not verified on a device.
fix: Drop the inline fontSize. Use an explicit ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace stack on these three fields. Use inputMode='text' for the version, keeping the server regex (any pattern attribute must be v-flag safe).
fix_original: Drop the inline font size; use ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace for these three inputs; inputMode='text' (with a pattern) for x.y.z.
root_cause_fix: styles.ts NUMERIC_STYLE (ui-monospace stack) for amounts, codes and POS refs only; --mono untouched.

subtasks.what: legal-doc-form inline fontSize 13 and mono stack

title: Gönderiler mail banner lives in the URL: comes back on reload and survives deletes
evidence: gonderiler/actions.ts:131-144 redirects to ?eposta=kuyrukta&adet=N / ?eposta=hata...; page.tsx:97-101 renders the banner from the query alone, no dismiss; deletePostAction revalidates the same URL (actions.ts:205).
impact: 'Gönderi kaydedildi. N üyeye ... kuyruğa alındı' reappears on every reload and stays after the operator deletes posts on that page.
verdict_note: actions.ts:131-144 redirects with ?eposta=…. page.tsx:97-101 renders the banner from the query alone, with no dismiss. deletePostAction revalidates in place (actions.ts:205), so the banner survives deletes and reloads.
fix: Carry the outcome in setAdminFlash (warning tone) instead of the URL, or router.replace(LIST_PATH) once shown.
fix_original: Carry the outcome in the flash toast (warning tone stays until closed) or strip the params with router.replace once shown.

title: 'Ayarlar → E-posta' link opens the Genel tab
evidence: The mail-health banner links to /admin/ayarlar; SettingsForm always starts with useState<TabId>('general') and reads no URL param or hash.
impact: The operator follows a link that promises the E-posta tab and has to find it themselves.
verdict_note: page.tsx:179-183 links to /admin/ayarlar. ayarlar/settings-form.tsx:53 is `useState<TabId>('general')` and reads no URL param or hash. The e-mail tab exists (:41).
fix: ayarlar/page.tsx reads searchParams.sekme and passes an initialTab prop to SettingsForm. The dashboard link becomes /admin/ayarlar?sekme=email.
fix_original: Read the initial tab from ?sekme=email in SettingsForm and link to it.
root_cause_fix: Settings tab synced with ?sekme= (ARIA tabs); links use ?sekme=email / ?sekme=karaoke.

title: Save results are a 12 px line: not announced, no toast, and 'kaydedildi' stays while you keep editing
evidence: SaveBar shows state.error/state.message in a span with no role=status/aria-live (Chrome: 0 live regions in the settings page after a refused save); the panel's ToastProvider (app/admin/layout.tsx:206) is not used; useActionState keeps the last message until the next submit, so a green 'Genel bilgiler kaydedildi.' stays beside fields edited afterwards.
impact: Screen-reader users get no answer to Kaydet; sighted users get a small grey/green line instead of the toast the rest of the panel uses and can mistake stale success for the current state.
verdict_note: SaveBar (settings-form.tsx:129-137) renders plain spans with no role=status/alert. There is no role or aria-live anywhere in ayarlar. ToastProvider is mounted in layout.tsx:206 but unused here. The message stays until the next submit. The idle text is neutral-400 (2.58:1), already covered by KAR-06/KAR-17.
fix: Fixed together with SYS-01 by moving to useToastAction (toast plus an inline role=alert for errors). Clear the message on input.
fix_original: Announce via role=status (error: role=alert), fire the kit toast on success, clear the message on the next input in the form.
root_cause_fix: action-form.tsx exports one tested helper (useNoResetSubmit) that dispatches by hand (preventDefault + new FormData(form, submitter) + startTransition) with a pending guard, plus withPanelCatch for legacy state shapes; ActionForm gains beforeSubmit. Each package switches its forms to it.

title: Saatler: 14 time fields without a label and seven identical 'Kapalı' boxes
evidence: <input type='time' name='mon-open'> etc. have no <label>, aria-label or aria-labelledby; the day name is a sibling <span> (231-233). Each day's checkbox is labelled only 'Kapalı' (248-256). The inputs are off-kit (rounded-md bg-neutral-50, py-1.5 from sm = about 34 px tall) unlike forms.tsx baseInput.
impact: A screen reader announces 'saat, düzenlenebilir' fourteen times and 'Kapalı, onay kutusu' seven times with no day; tablet taps hit 34 px targets.
verdict_note: settings-form.tsx:235-246: time inputs with no label or aria-label. :248-256: seven checkboxes all labelled 'Kapalı'. The inputs use sm:py-1.5 sm:text-sm, about 34px tall, off-kit.
fix: As proposed: aria-label like `${DAY_LABELS[day]} açılış` / `kapanış` / `kapalı`, or a fieldset per day with the day as legend; use baseInput at 44px.
fix_original: aria-label 'Pazartesi açılış' / 'Pazartesi kapanış' / 'Pazartesi kapalı' (or a fieldset per day with a legend), baseInput styling, min-h 44 px.

title: SEO tab promises site-wide control it does not have
evidence: 'Site başlığı (meta title)' hint: 'Tüm sayfaların varsayılan başlığı. Ürün/yazı sayfaları üstüne yazar.' The value is read only in app/page.tsx generateMetadata (28); every other page uses the layout default/template (app/layout.tsx:64-65). 'Open Graph görsel URL' is likewise home-only (page.tsx:29, 41). Unticking 'Siteyi arama motorlarına aç' only returns a Disallow-all robots.txt and an empty sitemap; page meta stays indexable (store.ts:459-461 says so), and robots Disallow does not remove pages Google already indexed.
impact: The owner expects every page title or share card to change, or the site to disappear from Google, and none of that happens.
verdict_note: seoTitle and seoOgImageUrl are read only in app/page.tsx:28-29, while the hint at settings-form.tsx:393 says every page. With indexing off, robots.ts:59-61 serves Disallow-all and sitemap.ts:26 returns []. store.ts:457-461 confirms there is no page-level noindex, and Disallow stops crawlers from ever seeing a noindex.
fix: As proposed: rename to 'Ana sayfa başlığı / görseli' and say plainly that this blocks crawling but does not remove pages already indexed.
fix_original: Say 'Ana sayfa başlığı' / 'Ana sayfa paylaşım görseli', and for indexing explain 'Yeni tarama durur; dizindeki sayfalar kendiliğinden düşmez' (or add a noindex header when off).

title: Settings copy is developer jargon, partly false, and mixes 'siz' into a 'sen' panel
evidence: 'Hero görsel URL' / 'tasarımdaki SVG placeholder' (191-192; empty actually shows the first slider photo, home-hero-slider.tsx:90), 'meta title', 'Open Graph', 'sitemap yayınla', page description 'footer ve Visit sayfasını besler' (page.tsx:23, also outdated: the page now holds 8 tabs), 'sunucudaki EMAIL_FROM' (568), 'docs/EMAIL-RESEND.md §3' (610), 'Vercel → Environment Variables'a SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ekleyip yeniden dağıt' (identity-status.tsx:37-39), 'RESEND_API_KEY tanımlı değil' (health.ts:133-134), 'Resend → Domains' (health.ts:74). Placeholder 'siz@ornek.com' (602) is formal; placeholder 'info@nextgenlab.com.tr' (443) looks like a set value. Idle line 'anında uygulanır' (119) is false for the app: bootstrap (hours, courier fee, shop switch) is cached s-maxage=300 + swr 3600 (api/mobile/v1/bootstrap/route.ts:18). 'Sepet bu tutarın üstündeyse' (307) while the code frees shipping at >= (commerce.ts:28-29); '0 = kapalı' appears only in the error (actions.ts:188).
impact: A café owner meets env-var names and file paths, is told changes are instant when the app lags up to 5 minutes, and misreads the free-shipping rule.
verdict_note: Jargon is present: settings-form.tsx:191-192, 392, 415, 568, 610, and identity-status.tsx:37-39. 'siz@ornek.com' at :602, 'info@nextgenlab.com.tr' at :443. 'anında uygulanır' (:119) is false: api/mobile/v1/bootstrap/route.ts:18 sends s-maxage=300. 'üstündeyse' (:307) vs commerce.ts:29 `>=`. '0 = kapalı' appears only in the error at actions.ts:188. 'SVG placeholder' is outdated: home-hero-slider.tsx:90 falls back to a photo.
fix: As proposed.
fix_original: Plain Turkish ('Ana sayfa görseli', 'Paylaşım görseli', 'Arama motorlarına açık'), move env/deploy instructions behind 'Geliştiriciye ilet' text, 'sen@ornek.com', a neutral placeholder, 'Uygulamada 5 dakikaya kadar gecikebilir', 'Sepet bu tutar ve üstündeyse kargo ücretsiz; 0 yazarsan kapalı'.

title: 'Test gönder' tests the saved sender, not the one typed above it; failures come back in raw English; the banner never refreshes
evidence: The sender form and the test form are separate (529, 592); sendTestEmail reads emailIdentity() from the DB (send.ts:279-280), so typing a new 'Gönderen adresi' and pressing 'Test gönder' before 'Kaydet' tests the OLD sender and passes. A provider refusal is shown as 'Gönderilemedi - ' + Resend's English message or '403: {json…}' (resendMessage, send.ts:262-273). sendTestEmailAction calls forgetEmailHealth() but no revalidatePath, so the green/red banner above (536-555) keeps the old verdict after a failed test. The hint 'ulaşmazsa sağlayıcının verdiği hata burada görünür' only covers send-time refusals, not spam/bounce. No rate limit on the test send.
impact: The owner can 'prove' a new sender works, save it, and silently stop all customer mail (see SYS-06); error text is unreadable for a Turkish operator.
verdict_note: sendTestEmail (send.ts:279-280) uses emailIdentity(), which reads the saved settings (send.ts:87-115), not the typed fields. sendTestEmailAction (actions.ts:445-462) calls forgetEmailHealth() but never revalidatePath, so the banner stays stale until navigation. resendMessage (send.ts:262-273) passes Resend's English text or 'status: body'. No rate limit (owner only).
fix: Disable 'Test gönder' while the sender form is dirty (needs SYS-07's dirty state), or send the typed sender to a test-only path. Map common Resend errors to Turkish. Call revalidatePath('/admin/ayarlar') after the test.
fix_original: Disable 'Test gönder' while the sender form is dirty (or send the typed values with the test), map common Resend errors to Turkish, revalidatePath('/admin/ayarlar') after a test, reword the hint, add a small per-session rate limit.

title: Genel accepts anything server-side: hero URL, e-mail, phone, unbounded lengths
evidence: Only name.length >= 2 is checked. heroImageUrl goes to the home hero unvalidated (SEO validates http(s) at 269-271, Genel does not); email is not checked though it becomes the reply-to and karaoke-notice fallback (send.ts:97, 856); phone/address/tagline/name have no max length (body limit 12 MB, next.config.ts:118). The browser's type=url/type=email are the only guards.
impact: A crafted or pasted value breaks the home hero image, sends replies to a malformed address or stores an oversized row; nothing tells the operator.
verdict_note: saveGeneralAction (actions.ts:93-112) checks only name length >= 2: no URL or email check and no max lengths. A concrete failure: an http:// hero URL passes type=url and the server, home-hero-slider.tsx:237-246 renders it as a plain , and CSP img-src 'self' data: blob: https: (next.config.ts:55) blocks it, so the hero is broken with no message. A malformed email only gets past the browser through a hand-made POST.
fix: A zod schema with field errors: heroImageUrl must be https only, a valid email, and max lengths (name 80, tagline 160, address 500).
fix_original: zod schema like notificationsSchema: http(s) URL, e-mail, Turkish phone pattern, sensible max lengths, field errors under the fields.

title: Dashboard date label and greeting use the server clock (UTC on Vercel), not Istanbul time
evidence: turkishGreeting() uses `new Date().getHours()` and todayLabel() uses `new Intl.DateTimeFormat('tr-TR', {day, month, weekday})` with no timeZone. No TZ is set in next.config.ts, vercel.json or package.json, while lib/mobile/venue.ts:27 defines VENUE_TIMEZONE='Europe/Istanbul' and the karaoke card uses istanbulClock(now).date. On a UTC runtime, 00:00-03:00 Istanbul shows yesterday's date in the eyebrow above a card listing today's bookings. The greeting is also 3 h off ('İyi geceler' until 09:00, 'Günaydın' until 15:00).
impact: A köşk shift working past midnight sees a header date that does not match the karaoke card under it. The greeting is wrong for much of the day.
fix: Pass timeZone: VENUE_TIMEZONE to the Intl formatter. Take the hour from istanbulClock(now), or use Intl with hour:'numeric', hourCycle:'h23', timeZone VENUE_TIMEZONE.
root_cause_fix: Dashboard greeting and date from istanbulClock / timeZone Europe/Istanbul.

title: Greeting and date label use the server's UTC clock
evidence: turkishGreeting() uses new Date().getHours(); todayLabel() formats without timeZone; vercel.json sets no TZ and forms.tsx:186-188 documents the server runs UTC. Istanbul (UTC+3) 07:00-08:59 shows 'İyi geceler', 12:00-14:59 'Günaydın', 18:00-20:59 'İyi günler'; 00:00-02:59 the eyebrow shows yesterday's date while the karaoke card (line 77, istanbulClock) uses today.
impact: The first line of the landing page greets wrongly 9 hours a day and shows the wrong date after midnight.
verdict_note: page.tsx:29-35 uses `new Date().getHours()` and :57-63 uses Intl.DateTimeFormat without timeZone. vercel.json sets no TZ, and no process.env.TZ exists in src. Istanbul is UTC+3, so the greeting is wrong in 3 three-hour bands, and between 00:00 and 02:59 the eyebrow shows yesterday while the karaoke card uses istanbulClock (line 77/80).
fix: src/app/admin/page.tsx: take the hour from Math.floor(istanbulClock(now).minutes / 60) (already imported) and add timeZone: 'Europe/Istanbul' to todayLabel.
fix_original: Derive hour and date from istanbulClock(now) (already imported) or Intl.DateTimeFormat with timeZone 'Europe/Istanbul'.
root_cause_fix: Dashboard greeting and date from istanbulClock / timeZone Europe/Istanbul.

title: Dashboard, login and 2FA screens still use the old look (faux-italic serif, neutral/amber/rose/red palettes, mixed radii) next to kit pieces
evidence: Stat values and h2s use `var(--serif), 'Playfair Display', serif` + italic; --serif is Poppins in the admin and neither Poppins call loads an italic cut (admin layout.tsx:19-24, root layout.tsx:27-32), so it is a synthesized oblique. Labels text-neutral-500, rows border-neutral-100 (296), notices rounded-md amber/rose (163, 177) instead of tone tokens; the KaraokeTodayCard on the same page uses the kit (text-lg font-semibold, EYEBROW). iki-asama h1 italic; login inputs rounded-md bg-neutral-50 + red-* error vs kit rounded-xl surface-2 + danger tokens; 2FA disable uses rounded-full pills. Poppins is downloaded twice (root --font-display 6 cuts + admin --font-poppins 4 cuts).
impact: The landing page and sign-in screens look like a different product from the list/detail pages.
verdict_note: Same root cause as SHE-05/18 (legacy markup). page.tsx:196-206,229-236,327-334 and iki-asama/page.tsx:22-31 use `var(--serif), 'Playfair Display'` + italic. --serif is Poppins in admin (layout.tsx:34), and neither Poppins call (layout.tsx:19-24, root layout.tsx:27-32) loads an italic style, so the italic is synthesised. Also neutral-500 labels, border-neutral-100 rows (:296), amber/rose rounded-md notices (:163,:177), login inputs in rounded-md bg-neutral-50 (login-form.tsx:34,51) and 2FA disable pills (2fa-kurulum/page.tsx:59-66).
fix: Rebuild the dashboard, login and 2FA screens with kit pieces and tone tokens (forms.tsx primitives, Badge, the kit stat style). Optionally reuse the root Poppins variable in admin/layout.tsx; check weight 700 in the root set (it is).
fix_original: Rebuild the dashboard with kit pieces (Section, kit stat tiles, Badge, DataTable for recent orders) and move login/2FA forms to forms.tsx primitives and tone tokens; reuse the root Poppins variable in app/admin/layout.tsx.
root_cause_fix: Legacy neutral-*/rose/emerald/serif-italic markup moves to kit tokens and pieces in the package that owns the file.

title: One failing dashboard widget takes the landing page down; the Resend check has no timeout
evidence: Promise.all of getDashboardStats, listRecentOrders, getSettings and emailHealth; only karaoke is wrapped (readKaraoke, 41-55). emailHealth → lookup() fetches https://api.resend.com/domains with no AbortSignal/timeout, cached only 120 s per instance.
impact: A slow Resend API delays the landing page for every role; one failing read shows 'Bu ekran yüklenemedi' instead of a dashboard with one empty card.
verdict_note: Partly real. email/health.ts:86-91 fetches api.resend.com with no AbortSignal. lookup() catches errors but a hang blocks the dashboard render, cached only 120s per instance. The Promise.all at page.tsx:70-78 throwing on a DB failure is error.tsx's designed path, and those reads share the same DB, so 'single point of failure' is mostly by design.
fix: lib/email/health.ts: add `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000)` to the fetch (the existing catch maps it to 'unknown'). Optionally wrap emailHealth in the dashboard so a throw from emailIdentity does not take the page down.
fix_original: Guard each widget like readKaraoke; add AbortSignal.timeout(3000) to the Resend fetch in lib/email/health.ts.

title: Reports lack a date range, comparison, export and breakdowns; the 'Dönüşüm' card is permanently empty

'Dönüşüm' always shows '-' (226-231): conversionRatePct is hard-coded null (store.ts:6054) and no analytics source is wired, yet the card says 'Vercel Analytics / GA / Plausible bağlandığında bu kart otomatik aktif olacak.'
impact: The owner cannot answer basic questions (last weekend vs this, which channel sells, what to export for the accountant) and sees a dead card that promises to fill itself.
verdict_note: Only the 3 G_OPTIONS presets (page.tsx:22-30); no custom range, comparison, export or breakdowns; topProducts(5). conversionRatePct is hard-coded null (store.ts:6054), yet the card promises it will turn on by itself (page.tsx:232-235); that copy duplicates SYS-22. Downgraded: feature-parity gaps, and nothing shown is wrong.

title: Olay kaydı has no pagination, no detail view and no export: every visit renders 500 events twice
evidence: LIMIT 500 newest rows, no Pagination; older rows only by narrowing filters (181-186). Server render with 500 rows (audit/sys/harness/entry-olay500.tsx): 2,449,392 bytes of HTML and 32,890 elements (DataTable renders each row as a phone card AND a table row, data-table.tsx:209-350), against 7,917 bytes for an empty page; the RSC payload carries it again. Payload values are clipped at 300 chars with '…' (audit-view.ts:227, 253-255) and there is no row view to read the rest; times have no seconds (forms.tsx:196-203), so same-minute events look identical. No CSV export, actor filter is free text only.
impact: The unfiltered log is a multi-megabyte page that grows slow on phones; long payloads (legal text, bulk ids) cannot be read in full; an investigation cannot be exported for an accountant or lawyer.
verdict_note: olay-kaydi/page.tsx:26 LIMIT=500, no Pagination. DataTable renders both the card list (data-table.tsx:209) and the table (:268) for every row. clip() caps values at 300 characters (audit-view.ts:227,253-255). formatDateTime has no seconds, there is no export, and the actor filter is free-text search (audit-view.ts:88). I did not re-measure the 2.45 MB size. Downgraded: the page tells the owner to narrow the date range (:181-186), and the filter reaches older events.
fix: As proposed: kit Pagination with a page offset in listAuditLogs, a row detail drawer for the full payload, and a formula-safe CSV export (owner only).
fix_original: Paginate with the kit Pagination (offset/limit or keyset on createdAt,id), add a row detail drawer/page with the full JSON and seconds, an 'Dışa aktar (CSV)' with formula-safe cells (prefix ' for = + - @), and an actor select fed by distinct actors.
root_cause_fix: P2b: list screens move to DataTable + FilterBar + StatusTabs + Pagination + ActionMenu with server-side paging.

title: No new booking, reschedule, resend mail, CSV export or check-in / no-show for karaoke
evidence: The action file exports only confirm, cancel, retry refund, settle refund and the today count; there is no app/admin/mobil/karaoke/yeni or csv route. Orders have yeni, csv (role-gated) and resendMailAction. The booking page labels the code 'Girişte sorulan kod' but there is no check-in action.
impact: Phone or walk-in bookings cannot be entered; moving a booking means cancel + refund + new online payment; a failed confirmation mail (warning toast) cannot be resent; no export to reconcile with PayNkolay; the door cannot mark Geldi/Gelmedi.
verdict_note: The absence is confirmed: app/admin/mobil/karaoke/actions.ts exports only confirm, cancel, retryRefund, settleRefund and todayCount, and there is no yeni or csv route under app/admin/mobil/karaoke. These are feature requests, not defects. A failed mail is designed to say 'E-posta GÖNDERİLEMEDİ, müşteriye kendin ulaş.' (lib/admin/action-result.ts:80-81) and the toast stays. Low.
fix: Plan these as features. If built: the CSV route needs role gates (orders-style plus refunds for money columns); resend mail must keep notifyReservationStatus idempotency; new booking and reschedule must not bypass the prepay rule (setReservationStatus never confirms unpaid while prepay is on) or the slot clash checks. Any app-visible status must be additive in /api/mobile/v1.
fix_original: Add 'Yeni rezervasyon', 'Saat/tarih değiştir' (same clash checks), 'E-postayı yeniden gönder', a role-gated CSV route mirroring siparisler/csv, and a check-in / no-show action.
plan_note: Feature requests; backlog. Constraints recorded in the verdict fix.

title: 7-day stateless admin session with no idle timeout; logout only deletes the cookie
evidence: COOKIE_MAX_AGE_SECONDS = 7 days; the token is a stateless HMAC (email|role|exp|fingerprint); signOutAdmin deletes the cookie and nothing server-side, so a copied token stays valid until expiry or a password change.
impact: On a shared köşk tablet a forgotten session stays open for a week (actions attributed to the wrong person); a leaked cookie survives 'Çıkış'.
verdict_note: auth.ts:27 has a 7-day max age, with a stateless HMAC token (signToken :230-234). signOutAdmin (:497-500) only deletes the cookie, and there is no idle timeout. Partly mitigated already: the credential fingerprint is checked on every request (sessionFromToken :531-544), so a password reset, deactivation or demotion does revoke (AUDIT.md:391). Only logout does not revoke.
fix: Product decision. Either a shorter absolute lifetime plus an idle timeout (beware köşk shift re-logins), or a per-user session version column bumped on logout and checked in sessionFromToken (needs a schema migration in db/schema.sql + schema-sql.ts).
fix_original: Shorter absolute lifetime plus an idle timeout (e.g. 12 h), and a per-user session version bumped on logout and checked in sessionFromToken.
plan_note: Product decision; default keeps 7-day cookie + per-request fingerprint. If the operator wants logout revocation, it goes to shell-access with a migration.
